jobs.title: Registered Nurse Diagnostic Imaging Part Time Days
jobs.description:
The Staff Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The registered professional nurse assumes accountability and responsibility for the individualized, age-specific care of a patient along the continuum from admission to discharge. She/He gives direct care to assigned patients and assists with other patient care when necessary. The registered professional nurse’s decisions and actions on behalf of the patient/family are determined in an ethical manner. She/He collects and analyzes the assessment data in determining nursing diagnoses, collaborates with the patient/family and other health care team members, develops a plan of care to attain realistic outcomes, provides education founded on evidence-based practice, and systematically evaluates the quality and effectiveness of nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and records patient status and identifies patient care needs upon admission/point of care entry.
• Organizes the assessment health data so that it is accurate, complete and accessible.
• Identifies problems that need immediate attention.
• Validates diagnoses with patient/family and other health care team members.
• Documents diagnoses in a manner that facilitates the determination of expected outcomes and plan of care.
• Initiates Problem List at the time of admission and updates as needed. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the patient’s plan of care.
• Documents that the patient’s individualized plan of care has been discussed with and agreed upon by the patient/family.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with patient/family and health care team members regarding discharge plan.
• Identifies patient teaching needs on admission and throughout hospital stay.
• Arranges conferences with patient and/or family and other members of health team when indicated to plan care.
• Prioritizes and organizes nursing interventions that are evidence based and reflective of established standards of care.
• Provides individualized, mutually agreeable, patient and family education that is founded on evidence-based practice and research guidelines.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient responses.
• Reviews consistently the patient’s health data to keep the Plan of Care updated.
• Assures that revisions to the plan of care are systematic and ongoing and are driven by measurable realistic goals.
• Documents the patient’s progression toward identified outcomes
• Identifies unmet outcomes and provides direction for continuity of care.
• Reassesses nursing actions for effectiveness in achieving desired outcomes.
• Communicates with patient/family and health care team members re: patient care and nursing’s role in the provision of care.
• Collaborates with patient/family and healthcare team members re: the patient’s progress/plan of care.
• Presents relevant patient information at multidisciplinary meetings/conferences for feedback from peers.
• Makes appropriate referrals as needed for continuity of care.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area.

Education/Experience

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Ability to use hand operated and power tools, and perform tasks with precision and manual dexterity. Basic mechanical and mathematical skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division), and ability to apply form of measurement and other work material calculations utilizing a calculator. Ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification.
• Computer/Applications Skills. Basic computer skills and ability to use a variety of software applications systems and scanning technology to clock in and out of jobs, record labor hours, and track material usage.

While performing the functions of this position, the Team Member is continuously required to talk, hear, and see, regularly required to stand, walk, bend and reach, use hands and fingers to grasp, handle and feel.  Frequently lift and/or move materials weighing up to 40 pounds, and occasionally lift, maneuver, or handle materials weighing up to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate (Contract)
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions—and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.



As a Marketing Operations Associate, you’ll own the operational and administrative work that supports NerdWallet’s Student Loans business. Reporting to the Senior Staff Marketing Lead as an individual contributor, you’ll work across the full Student Loans portfolio, handling the recurring execution that keeps our marketplace running—from lender compliance and external partner communications to revenue and cost reporting, affiliate campaign operations, partner contracts, and invoice reconciliation.



Your work will provide a reliable operational foundation that enables the team to scale marketing channels and pursue growth initiatives while helping consumers make informed financial decisions.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Process lender-initiated compliance updates, including APRs, disclosures, and regulated content, across landing pages and internal systems. Coordinate with external partners to maintain marketplace accuracy and regulatory compliance.

 - Build and maintain marketing reports and Google Sheets dashboards, including ad hoc month-over-month and year-over-year analyses, campaign and partner performance breakdowns, and monthly billing sheet accuracy reviews.

 - Manage the partner contract pipeline in Ironclad, tracking contracts through each workflow stage, identifying next steps, and following up with internal and external stakeholders to keep onboarding and renewals moving.

 - Coordinate across lenders, traffic partners, Finance, Marketing, and internal teams to keep operational work moving from start to finish.

Relevant backgrounds include marketing operations, affiliate or performance marketing, financial reconciliation, project coordination, account management, or other operational or administrative roles.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Proficiency in Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and dashboard creation.

 - Comfort working with numerical data, reconciling figures, spotting discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial and operational records.

 - Ability to quickly learn and use new platforms and internal tools, such as Voluum, Ironclad, WordPress, Amplitude, Databricks, and custom internal systems.

 - Clear, professional written communication for correspondence with lenders, traffic partners, and internal teams.

 - Exceptional attention to detail when working with regulated content, financial reconciliation, contracts, and external communications.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams and follow through on outstanding items.

 - A proactive approach to following up with external partners and internal teams to keep work moving.

 - Sound judgment about when to act independently and when to ask questions or escalate.

 - Adaptability and comfort switching between compliance, content, reporting, billing, contracts, and affiliate operations.

 - Initiative in learning systems and processes and a willingness to seek and incorporate feedback.

 - A collaborative approach, with open communication that supports shared decision-making.

 - An ability to connect day-to-day operational work to broader business goals and NerdWallet’s mission of helping consumers make smart financial decisions.

 - A commitment to building a team environment grounded in trust, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Estimated engagement period: November 2026 through April 2027

WHERE:

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

We are seeking a Data Scientist as a foundational member of our new "Applied Measurement" team.  In this role, you will help scale Northbeam's incrementality and measurement products directly with customers, to help customers answer some of their most important marketing measurement questions.  You’ll work at the intersection of data science, causal inference, predictive modeling, and customer problems, contributing across Northbeam’s measurement products.  This can include experimentation and incrementality products, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and other predictive or machine learning products.

This is an applied Data Science role with direct exposure to real-world customer problems.  You’ll work closely with experienced Data Scientists and cross-functional partners across Media Strategy, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.  As you develop deeper product and methodological expertise, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to new methodology, tooling, and scalable measurement capabilities.  You will also act as a trusted technical partner to clients: explaining statistical methodology, diagnosing measurement issues in their specific account, and clearly communicating experimentation results to drive actionable recommendations.

This role emphasizes customer partnership and applied communication as much as statistical methodology and production rigor.  The ideal candidate combines strong statistical foundations with a service-oriented mindset, and is comfortable moving between modeling, software development, and direct customer conversations.

Your Impact

• Partner with customers and internal teams to understand important marketing measurement questions and translate them into data science problems.

• Work with real-world customer data to ensure it is reliable and appropriate for modeling and measurement.

• Analyze model and experiment results, investigate unexpected outcomes, and identify potential data, modeling, or measurement issues.

• Translate complex statistical and modeling results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

• Partner with Senior Data Scientists on more complex methodological and modeling problems. Collaborate with cross-functional peers to support clients with the practical application.

• Identify recurring challenges and opportunities to improve our models, diagnostics, tooling, and processes.

• Build reusable analysis and diagnostic tools that make measurement more reliable and scalable.

• As you grow in the role, contribute to the development of new methodologies, models, and production measurement capabilities.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree (MS preferred) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another highly quantitative field.

• 2+ years of experience building and deploying data science, machine learning, or AI systems in production, ideally including direct client- or customer-facing work.

• Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and causal inference, with genuine enthusiasm for explaining these methods to non-technical audiences.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills—comfortable leading a customer conversation, explaining a modeling tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder, and writing up findings clearly.

• Strong coding and debugging skills, with the ability to write production-quality code and diagnose issues across the full stack, including source data, pipelines, model logic, and customer-facing outputs.

• A service-oriented mindset: energized by direct, hands-on customer problem-solving, not only methodology for its own sake.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and driving projects from concept to production with a high degree of autonomy.

• Growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to learn new domains, customer verticals, and measurement methodologies.

• Strong preference for candidates with a robust statistical background and prior experience in digital marketing or eCommerce analytics.

Base Salary Range

$130,000—$160,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

As a Sales Planner (Client Associate), you own the operational engine of the campaign lifecycle from pre-sale planning support through IO close, programmatic deal setup, trafficking, launch, and reporting - across Direct IO (DIO), Sponsorship, Programmatic Guaranteed (PG), and Private Marketplace (PMP). Embedded in a client-facing pod alongside Account Managers and Account Executives, you are the person who keeps campaigns moving and people informed. When a campaign goes live on time and is set up correctly, it is because you drove the details across every team that touched it.

For New York only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $65,000 and $85,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact.

Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

• This role spans the full campaign lifecycle. On any given day you may be supporting proposal development, managing a campaign launch, troubleshooting a trafficking issue, supporting wrap report creation and more

• Pre-sale support: Owning avails pull and inventory checks, targeting and audience segment creation in our data management platform (DMP), flight line item creations in our order management systems, supporting Account Managers in media plan creation and planning revisions across all deal types

• Deal close and billing: Verify plan details against signed IO terms, own billing case submission and communications with offshore partners through final approval, confirm systems and contract match before an opportunity moves forward and owning closing out cases

• Programmatic setup: Own the configuration details that make programmatic deals work - SSP, seat ID, and demand system setup for Programmatic Guaranteed; flight creation, deal ID requests, and deal delivery to the client for PMP

• Launch management: Own end-to-end launch readiness: build launch cases, verify flight accuracy, map and QA tags and measurement details, and drive every open item to closure so campaigns go live on schedule. Ensuring campaigns are launched on time is a major KPI

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

Bonus Points

• Working knowledge of programmatic deal types (PG, PMP, open auction), DMP platforms, or campaign trafficking tools

We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. jobs.title: Retail Store Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Cresco Labs is one of the largest public, vertically integrated, multistate operators in the cannabis industry. Our portfolio of in-house cultivated and manufactured brands features some of the highest quality, most awarded and most popular cannabis products in America. With dozens of locations nationwide, our owned and operated Sunnyside® dispensaries provide a welcoming, positive, judgement-free place to shop for anyone at any point on their cannabis journey.

Founded in 2013, Cresco Labs’ mission is to normalize and professionalize cannabis through our passionate employees. As stewards of the cannabis industry, our teams are constantly focused on supporting the needs of our fellow colleagues, consumers, customers, and communities alike. With a focus on Social Equity and Educational Development, our SEEDTM initiative ensures that our company reflects the communities in which we serve, ensuring equal opportunity for all to have the knowledge and resources to work in and own businesses in cannabis.

At Cresco Labs, we aim to revolutionize and lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on quality and consistency of product, and to bring legitimacy to the industry with the highest level of integrity and professionalism.

If you’re interested in joining our mission, click the below links to join our team today!

MISSION STATEMENT

At Cresco, we aim to lead the nation’s cannabis industry with a focus on regulatory compliance, product consistency, and customer satisfaction. Our operations bring legitimacy to the cannabis industry by acting with the highest level of integrity, strictly adhering to regulations, and promoting the clinical efficacy of cannabis. As Cresco grows, we will operate with the same level of professionalism and precision in each new market we move in to.

JOB SUMMARY

The Retail Store Manager of Sunnyside* is responsible for day-to-day team leadership and delivering a profitable business which supports Cresco Labs’ mission to normalize, professionalize and revolutionize the cannabis industry. You will ensure the dispensary achieves or exceeds all key metrics and goals across all aspects of the dispensary including customer acquisition and loyalty, merchandising, operations, and talent development. This role will serve as the link between the Sunnyside* brand vision of providing access to consistent high-quality cannabis and cannabis knowledge and the operations of the store.

At Sunnyside, we believe the employee experience is paramount to all. With a strong focus on training, development, diversity and authenticity, our employees experience both personal and professional growth.  As a Dispensary Manager, you will have:

• Experience leading and motivating a team of hourly and salary employees; skills include recruiting, onboarding, training, managing employee relations and coaching.

• The opportunity to build on retail business fundamentals to include effective scheduling, payroll, financial management, identifying sales trends, and business writing & reporting.

• Skills in conflict resolution, strategic thinking, decision making and complex problem solving.

• Skills in interviewing, talent selection and performance management of hourly and salary team members.

• Experience in a dynamic role that combines problem solving, teamwork, technical skills, and customer service!

WHO YOU ARE

• You are energetic, possess strong interpersonal skills and work well with others. Collaboration is key to our team’s success!

• You enjoy people! Consulting our customers, listening to their needs and providing an exceptional experience is vital to achieving customer loyalty.

• You inspire others! You are a leader who has a passion for coaching, developing, and influencing your teams while driving a profitable business. You have proven success building a high-performance team!

• You hold yourself to a high level of integrity and lead by example. In an industry that is highly regulated, we trust in our employee’s commitment to always do the right thing.

CORE JOB DUTIES

People Management:

• Build and sustain a high-performing team through employee selection, onboarding, coaching and clear accountability for results.

• Conduct at least monthly 1:1 quality conversations with each assistant manager and quarterly 1:1s with each store employee.

• Assess team performance, skill gaps, and career aspirations of employees; solicit or provide resources, trainings or procedures to support team needs.

• Analyze and determine effective headcount requirements and labor schedules that account for store sales trends, department objectives and labor laws.

• Motivate and inspire dispensary team to exceed revenue targets and KPIs, with an emphasis on selling and cross-selling techniques.

• Partner with Human Resources to resolve employee relations issues.

• Ensure employees are knowledgeable and coached to navigate any regulatory changes.

• Ensure a clean and safe environment for employees and customers

Sales & Operational Excellence:

• Provide regular updates, feedback, and solutions to corporate retail leadership across all areas of dispensary operations.

• Establish and nurture key business partner relationships across Human Resources, Outreach, Compliance, Security, Employees Health & Safety, Marketing, Construction and IT.

• Drive profitable sales through forecasting, scheduling, outstanding customer service and execution of programs and initiatives.

• Identify business and competitor risks; analyze metrics to help increase market share.

• Support outreach efforts/community partnerships to build a positive image within the community, drive brand awareness, and draw new patients.

• Establish daily operations procedures with an eye towards improvement and efficiency.

• Oversee inventory activities ensuring product requirements are met and deliveries are on time.

• Maintain accurate records of all dispensary activities including daily cash reconciliations, guest records, sales, deliveries and returns.

• Perform monthly audit reporting and store visit checklist with Area Manager.

• Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, state, and local laws.

• Serve as point of contact for state regulators and local authorities, overseeing any inspections or audits

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS

• Bachelor’s degree in business or comparable experience

• 5-7 years of retail management experience required; Cannabis knowledge or dispensary leadership experience a plus

• Experience managing teams of 10 or more with layers of leadership, preferably in a high-volume location with a focus on team development.

• Demonstrated ability to learn, apply and teach others technical, product-related information in a professional consultative manner.

• Experience working closely with HR teams and processes.

• A high level of integrity, personal motivation, and sense of urgency

• Proficient in MS Office, Highly Proficient in MS Excel with experience in data entry and data management

• Strong business acumen including excellent communication, attention to detail and interpersonal skills

• Available to work all hours of operation inclusive of nights, weekends and holidays

• Must be able to lift, carry and balance up to 50 pounds (100 pounds with assistance).

In accordance with any local and state compensation laws, the compensation listed is the current estimated range for the position. Final offer details and future compensation may be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to, geographic location, market compensation data, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this please discuss with your recruiter during the interview process.

Pay Range

$70,000—$75,000 USD

BENEFITS

Cresco Labs is proud to offer eligible employees a robust offering of benefits including, major medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(K)-match program, FSA/HSA programs, LTD/STD options, life insurance and AD&D.  We also offer eligible employees paid holidays and paid time off.  Other rewards may include annual discretionary bonuses, stock options as well as participation in our employee discount program. Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary by full-time or part-time roles, location, or position.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older to apply

• Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• The company does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants: Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, GTM Finance & Strategy
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY:

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Sr. Manager, Finance & Strategy to join our GTM Finance & Strategy team at OpenGov. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role responsible for the financial strategy and business partnership for Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing — with direct influence on decisions that shape OpenGov's growth trajectory.

You'll own the analytical infrastructure, financial narrative, and strategic advisory relationship for the GTM business, leading a team and operating with a high degree of autonomy and independent judgment. The right person has already demonstrated the ability to structure ambiguous problems, build conviction-backed points of view, earn the trust of senior stakeholders, and develop the people around them — and is ready to expand that scope further. This position is in-office at our San Francisco HQ, reports directly to the Director, GTM Finance & Strategy, and works closely with the CFO and GTM leadership.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Manage and develop a Sr. Analyst, providing clear direction, meaningful coaching, and prioritization support — setting a high bar for analytical rigor and delivering as a team

 - Drive the financial strategy and performance narrative for Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, connecting operational drivers to enterprise-wide financial outcomes

 - Forecast and explain topline performance — bookings, capacity & productivity, retention, pipeline coverage, win rates, and backlog — at the product and segment level, tying those drivers to revenue outcomes

 - Own end-to-end configuration and maintenance of the systematized ARR reporting infrastructure; collaborate with Commercial Ops on CPQ data structure, hygiene, and deal guardrails, and with Accounting on GAAP revenue dynamics

 - Own the end-to-end P&L — forecast and manage GTM spend, including headcount, T&E, and complex areas like commissions; drive accountability through budget vs. actual partnership

 - Architect and continuously improve the financial models, reporting infrastructure, and forecasting frameworks that underpin how the business plans and measures itself

 - Lead high-impact strategic projects: long range planning, go-to-market strategy, sales capacity analysis, market analysis, variable compensation design, and other initiatives that shape how OpenGov grows

 - Build deep, trusted partnerships cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, RevOps, Customer Success, and the CFO's office, and represent Finance & Strategy in cross-functional strategic planning




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience; MBA a plus

 - 6–10+ years of experience in strategic finance, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth SaaS environment, with demonstrated progression of scope and ownership

 - Prior experience managing or developing others, with a track record of raising the bar for a team

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior executives

 - Track record of driving structured, well-reasoned analysis and decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, largely independently

 - Advanced financial modeling skills; you build complex models from first principles and know how to make them scalable

 - Fluency with CRM/CPQ data and BI tools (Looker); comfortable working directly in the weeds to diagnose and resolve issues in complex, messy data

 - Actively experiments with AI tools to simplify and scale your work — you build workflows, not workarounds, and you think in systems rather than one-offs

 - Established experience partnering directly with and influencing senior/executive business leaders

 - Low ego, high output — you care about the work, not the credit



Compensation:

San Francisco, CA: $180,000 - $200,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

About Carvana

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Marketing Strategy & Planning: Lead the annual marketing planning process and maintain an integrated roadmap aligned with business goals, growth initiatives, product launches, and Global Marketing priorities. Establish governance, prioritization, budgeting, and performance-management processes that connect marketing investments to business outcomes.
• Market & Customer Activation: Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that drive customer engagement, demand generation, market penetration, and growth across core and emerging segments. Develop customer-centric value propositions and activation strategies in partnership with Sales, BDMs, Channel Management, and Product Management.
• Product Launches & Enablement: Lead marketing activation for new product launches, including campaign plans, sales enablement, customer communications, and channel support. Ensure marketing programs effectively support both direct customers and distribution partners.
• Content & Brand Management: Manage centralized marketing content and maximize reuse of Global Marketing assets through a “copy with pride” approach. Ensure consistent brand positioning, messaging, visual identity, customer experience, and regulatory compliance across USA marketing activities and channel touchpoints.
• Digital & Demand Generation: Partner with Global Marketing, Americas Corporate Marketing, Digital teams, and agencies to scale digital marketing, demand generation, lead nurturing, customer engagement, and marketing automation programs. Leverage analytics and best practices to improve campaign performance and ROI.
• Leadership & Collaboration: Serve as the primary owner of marketing planning, activation, governance, and budget coordination for Automotive & Industry USA. Represent USA market priorities within Global Marketing, facilitate cross-regional best-practice sharing, and promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Performance & Optimization: Establish and monitor key marketing KPIs, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and use data-driven insights to optimize programs, resource allocation, and marketing investments.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Digital Match Capture
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com

The Role - Staff Product Manager, Digital Match Capture

The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Staff Product Manager to lead our digital match capture products. As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with leading global sporting leagues (e.g., NBA, EPL, NFL, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver tracking data to teams, leagues, and external developers around the world.

You will own positional tracking for both first-party and third-party use-cases across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement. You will identify opportunities to lead the market, improve positional tracking, and determine the best ways to use match capture to deliver value to the Genius Sports product portfolio and its customers. Positional tracking forms the bedrock of Genius tracking-derived products, including performance, officiating, automated data collection, media visualizations, and emerging digital recreation use-cases.

You will also help shape what comes next in match capture. The lines between positional tracking, computer vision, digital twins, and 3D capture are blurring quickly, and you will explore where they meet: running prototypes and early deployments with our engineers and partners, learning what works, and bringing the most promising ideas into the core match capture platform.

The ideal candidate is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a product used both as a customer-facing offering and as a platform for the broader Genius portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data.

What You Will Own:

• As the Staff Product Manager, Digital Match Capture, you will be responsible for digital match capture spanning first-party and third-party use-cases:

• First-Party Positional Tracking — Tracking products that power the Genius Sports portfolio, including performance, officiating, automated data collection, media visualizations, and digital recreation inputs.

• Third-Party Positional Tracking — Tracking products and capabilities delivered to teams, leagues, and external developers.

• Positional Tracking Improvement & Market Leadership — A roadmap of continual improvements to tracking quality, coverage, and capability, including opportunities to lead the market.

• Next-Generation Match Capture Exploration — Discovery and validation of emerging capture capabilities that blend positional tracking, computer vision, digital twins, 3D capture, and real-time systems.

• Portfolio Value — Identifying and delivering the highest-value ways for digital match capture to serve Genius Sports products and customers.

Job Responsibilities:

Build, Maintain, and Grow Genius Digital Match Capture

• Operate as a platform product manager: balance first-party and third-party requirements, treat application product managers as customers, and define well-defined interfaces that enable both without fragmenting the platform.

• Understand customer needs across teams, leagues, external developers, and internal application teams; develop requirements and drive delivery of positional tracking for both first-party and third-party use-cases.

• Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post- launch growth and iteration — including both live-operations quality and reliability and net-new capability.

• Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for digital match capture, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with computer vision, systems, and data platform engineers, downstream product managers, match and venue operations, design, and business teams to ensure digital match capture initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.

• Explore next-generation capture opportunities that could improve tracking quality, coverage, automation, or downstream recreation use-cases, using evidence from prototypes, early deployments, and customer feedback to decide what to scale and what to stop.

• Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for digital match capture, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners.

• Balance investment across digital match capture across three horizons — Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months) — ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation.

• Define KPIs that drive business results for digital match capture, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis.

• Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to support go-to market motions with product expertise, and continuously gather feedback from teams, leagues, external developers, and application product managers and translate it into product requirements.

• Mentor less experienced product managers and raise the quality of product practice around you.

• Stay current on computer vision tracking technology, real-time data platforms, next-generation capture techniques, and competitor offerings to keep Genius digital match capture at the forefront of the industry.

Position Requirements:

• 6-12 years of relevant product management experience.

• Experience leading a complex product or platform with significant business, customer, or operational impact — shaping strategy, driving discovery, and aligning stakeholders across teams.

• Product management experience building B2B SaaS, platform, or data products: understanding functional requirements and building for scale, including balancing first-party and third-party (or multiple-customer) needs through well-defined interfaces.

• Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional programs with engineering, operations, and downstream product partners; able to influence without authority and treat application teams as customers.

• Technical fluency sufficient to work with computer vision, systems, and data platform engineers on real-time products; comfort moving between deep technical conversations and product/commercial tradeoffs.

• Ability to create clarity in technically ambiguous spaces, especially where positional tracking, 3D capture, digital twins, and real-time systems begin to overlap.

• Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience aligning stakeholders, presenting to leadership, and supporting commercial conversations with product expertise.

• Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs).

• Proficiency in gathering and transforming product requirements into a practical, prioritized product roadmap.

• Track record of mentoring less experienced product managers, or otherwise raising the quality of product practice around you.

• Domain experience in sports, computer vision, real-time systems, developer/platform products, 3D capture, or digital twins is a plus; familiarity with WebGPU, Unity, Unreal, or comparable engines/runtimes is a plus.

• Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

What Success Looks Like:

• Digital match capture is a uniform, market-leading product across basketball, soccer, and American football.

• Tracking is a core platform feature that can be used by any first-party or third party developer as a core data service.

• Product decisions are consistently grounded in customer needs and data to drive our Genius revenue streams, with clear KPIs tracked and acted on.

• Next-generation capture ideas are tested with real evidence from prototypes and early deployments, and the best of them make the tracking platform stronger.

• Cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data ops, commercial) trust the roadmap and rely on the PM as the source of truth for digital match capture product direction.

The salary for this role is based on an annualized salary range of $212,000 - $240,000. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports.

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

Implementation is an essential differentiator for Rippling and a critical time in the customer journey. We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Platform Implementations to lead a team of 20+ team members and 3 Managers and drive the successful delivery of Platform solutions across Rippling’s client base. This leader will oversee end-to-end Platform onboarding, including Custom Reports, Workflows, Apps, SOWs, Dashboards, Analytics and additional foundational capabilities to support AI. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to refine processes, enhance client experiences, and ensure that Rippling delivers scalable, world-class implementations.

The ideal candidate for this role has a technical background, track record of managing high-performing implementation teams, building processes and systems, driving operational rigor, and a passion for operational excellence and customer impact. They must also handle ambiguity, unstructured situations, and scale while leading a team with high standards.

What you will do

• Own the strategy and execution of Platform implementations from client kickoff through go-live.
• Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues.
• Partner with cross-functional leaders (Product, Sales, Engineering, Customer Success) to continuously improve delivery processes and client outcomes.
• Collaborate with sales and post-sales teams to ensure a seamless transition from sales to implementation to account management & customer support.
• Develop, monitor, and manage key performance metrics
• Hire, mentor, and grow high-performing teams that consistently meet and exceed monthly goals and targets and deliver high-quality implementation services to clients.
• Create and optimize playbooks, tooling, and frameworks to drive consistency, efficiency, and scalability across implementations.
• Drive adoption of best practices in project management, change management, and client communication.
• Foster a culture relentlessly focused on delighting customers in Implementation & maximizing adoption of Rippling’s products and services

What you will need

• You have 10+ years of professional experience leading an Implementation or Customer Success team within a fast-paced environment, startup, or SaaS organization
• At least 2+ years of experience leading and developing people managers
• Deep understanding of systems and operations with B2B or B2C products
• Proven track record in hiring and overseeing distributed teams

• Eager for a very hands-on role, where you’ll be asked to take on and run with a range of initiatives outside your comfort zone and learn quickly

Rippling’s Platform Specialist team is responsible for ensuring customers see incredible business transformations by maximizing the value of our core Platform - including custom workflows, advanced reports/analytics, apps, permission profiles, and approvals. Platform Specialist engagements are consultative and customized based on the customers’ unique needs/pain points.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Systems Architect
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Role

Snowflake's marketing technology ecosystem powers our global go-to-market strategy. The Senior Marketing Systems Architect is responsible for the data and systems foundation of Marketing Operations: designing and optimizing our data architecture, ensuring integrations are reliable and scalable, and readying the ecosystem for the next generation of AI-powered marketing. This is a hands-on technical role focused on solving complex systems challenges.



Key Responsibilities

 - Design and optimize Marketing Operations data architecture across Salesforce, Marketo, Snowflake, Hightouch, Clay, and the broader MarTech ecosystem.

 - Own the Marketo-to-Snowflake data sync: audit field mappings, identify gaps and redundancies, and partner with Data Engineering to remediate.

 - Redesign segmentation architecture so audience definitions are consistent, maintainable, and scalable across platforms and regions.

 - Improve lead routing, audience activation, and operational workflows to strengthen lifecycle performance and marketing data governance.

 - Lead MarTech stack health and rationalization: assess platform utilization against cost, flag consolidation opportunities, and deliver renewal-readiness recommendations.

 - Partner with GTM Engineering and Data Engineering to design, validate, and implement scalable technical solutions.

 - Troubleshoot complex platform, integration, and data quality issues to improve system reliability and operational performance.

 - Establish technical standards and governance that support future automation and AI capabilities.



What does success look like?

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Multiple Teams
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Our Engineering team is at the heart of building banking products that help millions of small businesses succeed. We’re on a journey to reinvent banking, and we’re looking for a curious, impact-driven Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team – someone who thrives on taking smart risks, experimenting boldly, and learning from every challenge.



You’ll tackle complex problems head-on, ship high-quality, robust code, and shape systems that power our products. This is a unique opportunity to work across our full product suite, influence technical decisions, and deliver end-to-end features that customers love. If you’re excited about building best-in-class fintech products in a fast-growing, collaborative environment, this is the role for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - End-to-End Development: Own features across the full development lifecycle – from design and development to testing, deployment, and monitoring – ensuring reliability and performance at scale

 - System & Infrastructure Ownership: Manage production systems, optimize infrastructure, and contribute to the availability, scalability, and resilience of our platform

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams to build solutions that meet customer and business needs

 - Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify areas for technical, process, and product improvement, helping the team raise the bar and influencing technical direction and long-term strategy



Who You Are

 - You have 3+ years of full-stack software engineering experience

 - You have led the development of significant components or features, delivering them successfully with minimal oversight

 - You mentor junior engineers, sharing expertise and fostering the growth and skill development of the entire team

 - You proactively drive enhancements and lead initiatives to enhance code quality, optimize performance, and streamline development processes

 - You’re a lifelong learner, curious about new frameworks, best practices, and emerging technologies

 - You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and change

 - You’re a collaborative team player, eager to pitch in, ask questions, and provide and receive feedback

 - You take ownership end-to-end, solving problems creatively and proactively, while keeping the customer and business impact front-of-mind



It’s a bonus (but not required) if you

 - Have worked in startups or high-growth tech companies

 - Have experience with JavaScript - we primarily use TypeScript, React, and Node.js

 - Have working knowledge of AWS services (ECS, S3, RDS, Dynamo, Lambda) and continuous deployment pipelines



Our Tech Stack

 - Front-end: React, Typescript, React Native

 - Back-end: Node.js, Typescript, Terraform, AWS (DynamoDB, RDS Postgres, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, ElasticSearch, ECS)

 - Tools: Cursor, Claude, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Jira, Metabase



The Interview Process

 - Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent team

 - Stage 2: A 60-minute live coding exercise with two members of the Engineering team

 - Stage 3: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with two Engineering Leaders

 - Stage 4: A take-home system design challenge, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call review with two members of the Engineering team

 - Stage 5: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of the Leadership team



Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.



The annual salary range for this role is $144,000 CAD to $176,000 CAD.



For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $160,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.



We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub https://www.notion.so/Candidate-Hub-1c7da8b7f88580a893f7d7c7852b064e?pvs=21.



Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You 

 - You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

 - You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

 - You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

 - You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself. 

 - You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

 - You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

 - Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.



Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Disclaimer: For compliance reasons, all offers of employment at Relay are conditional upon a successful background check and employment verification through Certn.

Important Notice: Relay’s recruitment team only contacts candidates and corresponds from official corporate email addresses ending in @relayfi.com. We will never ask for sensitive personal data (such as bank account details, credit card numbers, or social security/insurance numbers) during the initial application or interview stages.

jobs.title: Apartment Service Technician
jobs.description:

We're Hiring

An HVAC or EPA Certified Apartment Maintenance Technician to resolve work orders, complete preventative maintenance, and to support the day to day onsite operations under the direction of our Lead Maintenance Technician and Community Manager.

You'll work full time, Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM with an hour off for lunch.

HVAC or EPA Certified Maintenance Technicians are required to participate in the On-Call Rotation.

• Take turns responding to On-Call Emergencies with your other (2) Maintenance Co-workers
• Each On-Call Rotation earns a weekly On-Call Stipend - paid directly to you even if you're not called to the property

Pay:

• The pay rate for this position is $25-$27 per hour.
• Are eligible for employer provided benefits as well as added income via quarterly bonuses - up to 5% of the annual salary.
• Are eligible for a $100 stipend for on-call duties.

Sign-On Bonus: This position is eligible for a $1,000 sign-on bonus, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and company guidelines.

We're looking for you

To help maintain the highest standards for our apartment community. Your role will be to assist residents with open work orders by making minor repairs within apartments and alongside the Lead Maintenance Technician on routine maintenance and capital improvement projects onsite.

We need your strong work ethic, customer service for our residents, personal motivation to consistently improve, and a good foundation in general appliance repair, painting, plumbing, and landscaping. Your work in this job will directly determine our community and our resident's well-being.

• Walk the property each day; know your grounds and your buildings and clear away any trash or debris that you find.

• Respond to assigned work orders or general maintenance in a timely manner and always communicate with your Maintenance Supervisor or Property Manager as things move forward or take longer to complete than anticipated
• Work with the Maintenance Supervisor on any special projects or property wide routine maintenance as necessary

Above all, you will be responsible for staying in sync with the company’s and the community’s operating and safety policies and procedures and for adhering to federal, state and local laws pertaining to the operation of the community and Fair Housing.

Experience & strengths you'll need:

• A dedication to company goals and values and a commitment to the success of each associate as a member of the team
• Good communicator and listener with strong customer service skills
• General knowledge or direct experience of plumbing, drywall repair, painting, carpentry, appliance repair, pressure cleaning, or minor electric troubleshooting and repair
• Previous experience on a mid-rise apartment community - closing work orders and turning apartments is ideal
• HVAC Type I and Type II/EPA Universal Certification is required
• Valid Driver’s License & ability to respond to after hours or weekend emergencies
• High school graduate; technical school preferred but not required

The identified candidate is required to provide proof of a valid Driver's License in good standing for consideration of hire.

At Morguard, our employees are our greatest investment. We make people our priority and strive to create a culture of respect, health and safety, and equal opportunity to support employees to meet their goals.

jobs.title: Senior Architect (Licensed Building Architect), Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Lead Architect with deep expertise in the design and delivery of colocation and hyperscale cloud data center facilities. The ideal candidate is a licensed architect with a proven track record of leading complex, mission critical projects from concept to commissioning. This role will play a key part in shaping the architecture of high-performance, secure, and scalable data center environments to meet the evolving demands of top tier cloud and colocation clients.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance.

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead architectural design for large scale hyperscale cloud data center and colocation projects, from early concept through construction administration and closeout.
• Collaborate with internal engineering disciplines, construction teams, and external stakeholders to develop fully coordinated and integrated design solutions.
• Develop and review drawings, specifications, and technical documentation, ensuring compliance with codes, standards, and client design guidelines.
• Manage coordination with consultants, contractors, and permitting authorities to support project delivery and regulatory compliance.
• Serve as the architectural subject matter expert for hyperscale and colocation clients, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and reliability in facility design.
• Mentor and guide junior architects and designers, fostering technical excellence and design innovation.
• Maintain and apply knowledge of industry best practices and data center design trends.
• Support business development, proposal writing, and conceptual architectural designs for new pursuits.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education.
• Demonstrated experience with colocation and hyperscale data center projects.
• Experience with and knowledge of building codes, mission critical infrastructure standards, and data center design requirements.
• Experience in BIM ACC (Revit), AutoCAD, and related design tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience working with hyperscale client standards and colocation facility delivery models.
• Active U.S. Architectural license.
• LEED accreditation or equivalent sustainable design credentials.
• Experience working in fast paced, global project environments.
• Extensive experience working with permitting authorities and AHJs.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary and geographically diverse teams.

• Relocation is not available for this role
• Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
• THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 9, 2026.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

The role:

The Sanctions Compliance Senior Specialist role will be responsible for performing Level 2 escalation reviews of sanctions-related customer and transaction screening alerts for fiat and cryptocurrency, and determining the appropriate course of action in instances of a potential match. In addition, the AML Sanctions Compliance Senior Specialist will assist with the provision of sanctions-related advice and guidance regarding sanctions laws impacting financial crime investigations across SoFi’s diverse products and services, including by providing guidance to the Level 1 team supporting customer and transaction screening as well as on-chain investigations related to sanctions. The AML Sanctions Compliance Senior Specialist will also assist with the drafting of sanctions compliance policies and procedures, and help execute ad-hoc projects.

What you’ll do:

• Conduct customer and transaction-related sanctions monitoring activities, ensuring that alert determinations (fiat and cryptocurrency) are appropriate, fully supported, and documented.
• Make the final decision on alert/case dispositioning, escalating potential true matches to management, and taking mitigating actions as needed according to procedures
• Respond to sanctions-related escalations from various business units or compliance teams, including related to investigations and guidance on sanctions risk and compliance requirements.
• Conduct sanctions-related due diligence and investigations to evaluate whether alerts or cases are risk-relevant.
• Support the oversight of SoFi’s sanctions screening and reporting program, including identifying list management opportunities and preparing regulatory reporting, as needed.
• Monitor sanctions and cryptocurrency regulations, laws and best practices, identify new or changing requirements, and collaborate to ensure ongoing sanctions compliance is implemented.
• Support special ad-hoc projects, including the design of escalation paths and strategy, drafting and maintenance of procedures, liaising with cross-functional teams on initiatives, memorializing sanctions-related risk-based decisions, and developing tailored training, as assigned.
• Mentor other members of the team on sanctions and crypto-related processes and workflows

What you’ll need:

• Bachelor’s Degree from a four-year college or university in a related field.
• 3-5 years of Sanctions-related experience within a financial institution or government agency.
• Applied and practical experience conducting on-chain sanctions and AML investigations, preferably utilizing blockchain analytics tooling.
• Strong working knowledge of OFAC regulatory requirements and experience working with screening tools and relevant technologies.
• Ability to maintain up-to-date knowledge of BSA/AML laws and regulations relative to sanctions, money laundering, and terrorist financing, and the ability to apply this knowledge in assessing transactional activity and sanctions risk exposure to different products and services.
• Demonstrated written and verbal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and across different business lines.

Specific Skills in:

• Experience with Sanctions-related investigations.
• Applied experience with blockchain analytics tools (specifically Chainalysis KYT and Reactor).
• Excellent organizational, verbal, written, and interpersonal skills are required.
• Must be able to multitask, adapt well to changing priorities and effectively prioritize workflow to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, demanding, and changing environment; must work well under pressure.
• Excellent analytical skills.
• Mentorship or coaching skills to guide team members through crypto-related compliance workflows.
