jobs.title: Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

We're looking for a Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation to help TEGNA measure, learn from, and continuously improve our digital products. This role sits at the intersection of product analytics and experimentation, partnering with Product Managers to transform customer behavior into actionable insights that improve our websites, mobile apps, notifications, and personalization capabilities.

You'll help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities, enabling product teams to measure outcomes, validate hypotheses, and make confident, data-informed decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, QA, and Editorial, you'll help build a culture where analytics and experimentation are integral to how we discover, deliver, and continuously improve our products.

Who You Are

You are passionate about understanding customer behavior and using data to improve products. You enjoy digging into analytics, identifying opportunities, designing experiments, and translating complex findings into practical recommendations.

You're equally comfortable partnering with Product Managers to define success metrics, collaborating with Engineering on instrumentation requirements, working with Data teams to ensure analytics quality, partnering with UX Research and Design to better understand customer behavior, building dashboards, and helping stakeholders interpret the impact of new features, experiments, and customer journeys.

You have a strong analytical mindset but understand that data is only valuable when it leads to better decisions. You're curious, collaborative, and eager to develop expertise in product analytics and experimentation while helping teams build better products.

You're organized, proactive, and motivated by TEGNA's mission to connect and serve local communities everywhere.

Scope of Responsibility

Partner with Product Managers across TEGNA's Consumer Products organization to define success metrics, measure product performance, identify opportunities, and support experimentation initiatives.

Help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities by establishing best practices for instrumentation, dashboard development, experimentation, and product analysis.

Support product teams throughout the product lifecycle by helping define measurement plans, analyze product performance, and communicate actionable insights that improve customer outcomes.

Top Key Activities

• Product Analytics - Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, develop dashboards, analyze customer behavior, and identify opportunities to improve product performance.

• Analytics Enablement - Develop dashboards, reports, and reusable measurement frameworks that make product performance visible and actionable across the organization.

• Instrumentation - Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to define analytics requirements, document event tracking, validate instrumentation, and improve the consistency and quality of product data.

• Product Analysis - Analyze product performance, feature adoption, customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement trends, and experiment results to generate actionable recommendations.

• Experimentation - Support the design, execution, and measurement of A/B tests and feature rollouts, partnering with product teams to validate hypotheses and measure customer impact.

• Communications - Present dashboards, findings, experiment results, and recommendations to product teams and stakeholders through clear written and verbal communication.

Domain Acumen

• Experience working with digital product analytics platforms such as Amplitude (preferred) or Google Analytics.

• Experience supporting A/B testing, experimentation, feature flagging, or progressive delivery using LaunchDarkly or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of product metrics including adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, funnels, and customer behavior analysis.

• Experience partnering with Engineering to define or validate analytics instrumentation.

• Ability to translate business questions into meaningful product insights.

• Strong understanding of agile software development and how analytics supports continuous product improvement.

• Experience with SQL, visualization tools, or business intelligence platforms is a plus.

• Experience with digital media, publishing, consumer products, or content platforms is desirable.

Key Professional Traits and Requirements

• 2-5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineering teams

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills

• Comfortable collaborating across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, Data, and Editorial teams

• Data-informed decision maker with experience measuring product outcomes

• Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability

• Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments

Tools

Deep knowledge and proficiency with the following:

• Analytics: Amplitude or equivalent

• Experimentation: LaunchDarkly or equivalent

• Atlassian products: Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Confluence

• Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, or equivalent

Why Join Us?

Help shape how TEGNA builds better digital products through data.

As a Product Analyst, you'll partner with product teams across websites, mobile apps, personalization, notifications, experimentation, and analytics to help teams understand customer behavior, validate ideas, and continuously improve the experiences that reach millions of users every day.

You'll work alongside experienced product leaders and analysts, building deep expertise in product analytics and experimentation while making a meaningful impact on the future of local journalism.

This is an opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, and product strategy, helping create a culture where every product decision is informed by data and every product improvement is measurable. #LI-MS1

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacy Specialist
jobs.description:
WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support.

Our Guiding Principles:

• Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.

• Exceptional Care. We offer compassionate, innovative services that meet people where they are, from immediate support to long-term recovery.

• Integrity. We operate from a deep foundation of ethical, accountable practices in all we do.

• Organizational Resilience. We meet the moment and adapt to changing contexts with collaborative creativity, agile business processes, and financial stewardship.

Position Summary

The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist provides advanced, patient-centered clinical pharmacy services with a focus on medication optimization, disease state management, specialty pharmacy practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration. This role practices at the top of licensure under statewide protocols and WellPower Collaborative Practice Agreements (CPAs), while supporting clinical innovation, program development, and improved patient outcomes. The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist serves as a subject matter expert in clinical pharmacy practice and provides comprehensive medication management services for behavioral health conditions, substance use disorders, diabetes, metabolic disorders, ambulatory care, infectious disease prevention and treatment, population health, and other chronic disease states consistent with organizational programs, practitioner competency, and scope of practice. The position provides support to current and future initiatives as outlined by pharmacy and WellPower leadership.

Compensation & Benefits:

• $119,00 - $180,000

• For complete overview of our robust Benefits: https://wellpower.org/workplace-of-choice/

• Please note Salary will be adjusted at the start of the new year.

The posted range represents the full hiring range. Offers will not exceed this range, the majority of candidates are placed near the midpoint based on experience and qualifications.

Job Duties & Functions:

• Advanced Clinical Care & Consultation

• Design and optimize individualized pharmacotherapy plans

• Conduct complex clinical consultations within area(s) of specialty practice.

• Identify and mitigate medication-related risks, including drug interactions and adverse events, and barriers to adherence.

• Provide timely, evidence-based drug information to providers and interdisciplinary teams

• Document clinical recommendations, interventions, and patient outcomes

• Provide pharmacist-delivered, protocol-driven clinical services under Collaborative Practice Agreements (CPAs), including initiating, modifying, and monitoring therapy as authorized.

• Assess, initiate, monitor, and optimize medication regimens and clinical outcomes for patients with behavioral health conditions, diabetes, metabolic disorders, and other chronic disease states as appropriate to specialty area.

• Administer medications and clinical therapies within scope of practice and organizational protocols, including long-acting injectable therapies, immunizations, and other pharmacist-delivered services.

• Apply and interpret statewide and organizational clinical protocols to guide patient care and decision-making

• Program Development & Clinical Leadership

• Support implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of:

• Collaborative Practice Agreements

• Statewide protocols

• Specialty clinical pharmacy services

• Disease-state management programs

• Develop and support clinical programs, medication use guidelines, and population health initiatives

• Identify opportunities to expand pharmacist-delivered services and protocol-driven care

• Partner with pharmacy and medical leadership to design and enhance clinical service models

• Participate in committees, work groups, and organizational initiatives, as directed

• Provide support to current and future initiatives as outlined by pharmacy and WellPower leadership.

• Education & Workforce Development

• Serve as a preceptor for pharmacy students, residents, and other learners as appliable.

• Provide education to pharmacists, providers, nurses, and interdisciplinary care teams

• Act as a clinical resource for pharmacy and medical staff within area of expertise.

• Promote evidence-based practice and continuous professional development

• Provide patient education focused on medications, disease management, self-care strategies, and health promotion.

• Quality, Safety & Outcomes

• Participate in medication safety programs, including adverse drug reaction and medication error monitoring

• Support quality improvement initiatives tied to clinical and operational outcomes

• Contribute to the development, monitoring, and reporting of clinical program metrics such as interventions, adherence, clinical outcomes, quality measures, and cost impact.

• Utilize data to identify opportunities for improving patient care and service delivery.

• Integrated Pharmacy Practice

• Perform pharmacist duties as needed, including prescription verification and dispensing

• Support technician workflow during operational needs

• Provide MTM services and administer immunizations per protocol.

• Collaborate with medical, behavioral health, nursing, and care coordination teams to deliver integrated patient care.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory, legal, accreditation, and professional standards

• Patient Experience & Equity

• Deliver culturally responsive, trauma-informed care

• Provide individualized medication education to support adherence, self-management, and patient engagement

• Support equitable access to medications, clinical services, and preventative healthcare.

• Role Flexibility & Scope

• Adapts clinical programs and services in response to evolving regulatory standards, organizational priorities, and patient care needs

• Participates in the implementation of new services, protocols, and care delivery models consistent with pharmacist licensure, specialty training, and organizational agreements

• Maintain competency in specialty practice areas and applicable clinical certifications.

• Other duties as assigned

Requirements & Qualifications:

Education & Licensure

• Doctor of Pharmacy degree required.

• Advanced clinical training through residency, board certification, certificate programs, diabetes education training, or equivalent clinical experience preferred.

Preferred Certifications (Specialty-Specific)

One or more of the following preferred:

• Board Certified Psychiatric Pharmacist (BCPP)

• Board Certified Ambulatory Care Pharmacist (BCACP)

• Board Certified Pharmacotherapy Specialist (BCPS)

• Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES)

• Other specialty certification relevant to assigned clinical practice area

Experience

• LICENSURE: Colorado Pharmacist license in good standing.

Physical Requirements: TYPICAL PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Requires sitting, standing, bending and reaching. Position requires manual dexterity to operate standard office machines, such as computers, fax machines, calculators, telephone, and other office and/or clerical equipment.

jobs.description:

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We’re looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that’s you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Operations Manager, Tech to report to our VP Engineering and serve as a trusted operating partner to our CTO and department heads across Engineering, Product, Design, and Analytics. The role will be most deeply focused on the CTO and VP Engineering, while providing ongoing, dependable support to each EPDA leader.

This role sits at the intersection of executive partnership and tech operations. You will maintain active support relationships with all EPDA department heads, understand what each leader needs, and allocate your time transparently as priorities shift. You will protect leadership time, keep important decisions and follow-ups moving, and build lightweight systems that help EPDA operate as one team. On any given week, that may mean redesigning a leader’s calendar around the decisions that matter, preparing an OKR or all-hands update, helping negotiate a software renewal, coordinating an EPDA offsite, or driving a security initiative across several teams.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable with high-stakes executive support and operational ownership. You will not just schedule meetings; you will understand why they matter, make thoughtful tradeoffs, prepare the right context, and ensure decisions turn into action.

Location and in-office expectations: In-office role in NYC. Occasional travel is expected for offsites and company events.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide ongoing calendar, meeting, travel, preparation, and administrative support to every EPDA department head and the CTO, with the deepest and most proactive coverage for the CTO and VP Engineering; maintain a clear system for balancing requests and communicating tradeoffs across leaders.

• Serve as a go-to operating partner for EPDA leadership by preparing agendas, briefs, presentations, and decision materials and tracking commitments through completion.

• Run and improve key EPDA operating cadences, including leadership meetings, planning cycles, OKR reporting, all-hands preparation, and communications about AI use and internal efficiency.

• Manage visibility into technology vendor spend and utilization; support procurement, renewals, budgeting, and contract negotiations in partnership with Finance, Legal, Security, and functional owners.

• Project-manage cross-cutting initiatives such as security, privacy, compliance, and audit-readiness work by establishing clear owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths.

• Plan and coordinate EPDA offsites, leadership sessions, team events, and employer-brand initiatives that strengthen how the organization works and how candidates understand the team.

• Build strong relationships across Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, People, Finance, Legal, Security, IT, and executive operations; identify gaps in information flow and fix them.

• Use AI, automation, and modern productivity tools to reduce repetitive work, improve reporting, and make the organization more effective without compromising judgment, privacy, or quality.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 5+ years of experience in executive operations, executive business partnership, business operations, technical program management, or a similarly high-trust role in a fast-growing technology company.

• You have directly and concurrently supported multiple VP- or C-level leaders across different functions and are excellent at complex calendar management, meeting preparation, travel, executive follow-through, and transparently balancing competing leadership needs.

• You have operated across multiple technical or product functions and can build credibility with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and business partners.

jobs.title: Senior Civil and Structural Engineer – Reactor Deployments
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Team

The Antares Reactor Deployments team is responsible for bringing the Antares R1 microreactor from the factory to operational service. Working across engineering, manufacturing, licensing, construction, supply chain, and operations, the team develops repeatable deployment solutions that enable rapid installation of factory-built microreactors at commercial, defense, and government sites. 

As a Civil and Structural Engineer, you will lead the development of deployment sites that support safe, efficient, and cost-effective reactor installation. You'll evaluate prospective sites, develop standardized civil infrastructure, and work with multidisciplinary engineering teams to create modular site designs that can be deployed repeatedly with minimal site-specific customization.  This role spans the full project lifecycle—from customer site evaluation and conceptual planning through detailed design, permitting, construction, commissioning, and fleet deployment. You'll help establish the civil engineering standards and deployment methodologies that enable Antares to scale reactor deployments while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and constructibility.  Success in this role requires close collaboration with reactor, structural, mechanical, electrical, licensing, manufacturing, construction, and operations teams to ensure each deployment site is optimized for rapid installation, long-term operation, and regulatory compliance.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Lead civil engineering activities supporting deployment of the Antares R1 microreactor.

 - Evaluate prospective deployment sites for geotechnical conditions, grading, drainage, utilities, transportation access, constructibility, environmental constraints, and permitting requirements.

 - Develop standardized site layouts that enable repeatable deployment across commercial, defense, and government applications.

 - Design site grading, drainage systems, stormwater management, access roads, equipment pads, underground utilities, and civil infrastructure.

 - Develop reactor site layouts including reactor silos, balance-of-plant facilities, electrical infrastructure, security systems, and operational support facilities.

 - Coordinate geotechnical investigations and incorporate subsurface conditions into foundation and site designs.

 - Work closely with structural engineers to develop foundations, reinforced concrete structures, retaining walls, and below-grade facilities.

 - Coordinate with reactor, mechanical, electrical, controls, manufacturing, licensing, and construction teams to optimize deployment designs.

 - Support transportation planning, heavy-haul logistics, crane studies, equipment installation, and construction sequencing.

 - Prepare engineering calculations, specifications, design drawings, cost estimates, and construction packages through conceptual, preliminary, and final design.

 - Support permitting activities including grading permits, stormwater permits, environmental reviews, utility coordination, and site development approvals.

 - Interface with customers, EPC contractors, government agencies, and regulatory organizations throughout project execution.

 - Support construction, commissioning, startup, and lessons learned to continuously improve standardized deployment designs.

 - Develop engineering standards, design guides, and best practices that improve deployment speed, quality, and repeatability.

Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

 - 6+ years of experience in civil engineering supporting industrial, power generation, energy, defense, or large infrastructure projects.

 - Experience with site development including grading, drainage, utilities, roadway design, and civil infrastructure.

 - Experience developing engineering drawings, specifications, and construction documents.

 - Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering projects.

 - Working knowledge of applicable civil engineering codes and industry standards.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Ability to adapt to change in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Professional Engineer (PE) license.

 - Master's degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline.

 - Experience supporting nuclear facilities, military installations, industrial plants, or energy infrastructure.

 - Experience with geotechnical engineering and foundation design.

 - Experience supporting site permitting and environmental compliance.

 - Experience working with EPC contractors during construction.

 - Knowledge of transportation planning for oversized and heavy equipment.

 - Experience developing modular or standardized facility designs.

 - Familiarity with DOE, NRC, Department of War, or Department of the Army engineering requirements.

 - Experience working in highly regulated industries.

Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to travel up to 30% to customer locations, manufacturing facilities, testing sites, and deployment locations.

 - Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to support critical project milestones.

 - Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance.

 - Ability to work at DOE, Department of Defense, Department of the Army, and commercial nuclear facilities while complying with applicable security and safety requirements.

Location:

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.





Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. The Sr. CPM provides proactive oversight of CROs, vendors, investigative sites, study milestones, risks, budgets, and deliverables from study start-up through closeout including clinical study report completion. The role requires strong clinical trial operations expertise, sponsor-side accountability, critical thinking, vendor governance, issue escalation and resolution, and the ability to lead study teams in a complex, fast-paced, and highly regulated environment. This role reports to the Senior Director, Clinical Operations.

Key Accountabilities:

• Serve as the sponsor operational lead for assigned clinical trials.

• Lead cross-functional study teams and drive alignment across Clinical Operations, Medical, Regulatory, Data Management, Biostatistics, Pharmacovigilance/Safety, Clinical Supply, Quality, Legal, Finance, and external partners.

• Provide sponsor oversight of selected CROs, vendors, and external partners, including review of performance, quality, deliverables, study metrics, issue trends, escalation pathways, and corrective/preventive actions.

• Develop, maintain, and manage integrated study plans, timelines, risk management plans, communication plans, monitoring oversight plans, recruitment plans, and other study-specific operational plans.

• Oversee country and site feasibility, site selection, study start-up, regulatory and ethics submissions, site activation, enrollment readiness, and ongoing site performance in collaboration with internal teams and external partners.

• Monitor study progress against key milestones, enrollment targets, budget, forecast, and deliverables; proactively identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues appropriately to leadership and governance forums.

• Manage study budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, change orders, and vendor/site financial oversight in partnership with Finance, Legal, Procurement, and functional stakeholders.

• Develop Sponsor required study documents while providing sponsor input into study documents, including protocols, informed consent forms, study manuals, monitoring plans, vendor plans, training materials, newsletters, and operational guidance documents developed by any vendor.

• Ensure quality oversight and inspection readiness by supporting TMF/eTMF completeness, protocol deviation oversight, issue management, audit responses, CAPA follow-up, and compliance with sponsor procedures and regulatory expectations.

• Partner with study teams and sites to support patient recruitment and retention strategies, remove operational barriers, and ensure enrollment activities remain ethical, compliant, and aligned with trial objectives.

• Prepare and communicate study status updates, dashboards, metrics, risks, decisions, and mitigation plans to internal leadership, governance committees, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Lead study team meetings, vendor governance meetings, risk reviews, lessons learned discussions, and operational decision-making forums to promote accountability and timely execution.

• Represent Clinical Operations in internal and external meetings, including investigator meetings, vendor meetings, conferences, audits, inspections, and cross-functional governance discussions, as appropriate.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience:

• A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, PMP preferred.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in Clinical Trial Project Management.

• Experience with late phase clinical trials (Phase 3 - 4, registration trials), oncology and/or radiopharmaceutical experience preferred.

• Excellent oral and written communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while working under strict timelines.

• Team oriented mindset and demonstrates ability to work with cross functional teams.

• Experience managing global clinical trials.

• Thorough knowledge of ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory processes.

• Demonstrated ability to pivot study strategy quickly and lead teams in the right direction.

• Strong analytical, organizational, planning, decision making, negotiation, and conflict management skills.

• Fluent in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Teams, etc.) and experienced in working in mainly electronic record-keeping environment.

• Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to cultivate development of others.

• Start-up experience (country and site feasibility, ethics & regulatory submissions in multiple regions (APAC, EMEA, NA))

Key Capabilities:

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world.  We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

jobs.title: Director of Digital Merchandising
jobs.description:
About Ruggable:

Ruggable is a leading direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand based in Los Angeles, California with an extraordinary track record of high, profitable growth. We pride ourselves on having an extremely loyal customer base and a talented team made up of genuinely caring people who take action and deliver results. We are venture-backed and own a patented washable rug design that's disrupting the home décor industry. Our mission is to empower our customers to live vibrantly with beautiful products that don't compromise on function. If you're passionate about consumer products, e-commerce, and high-growth start-ups, keep reading!

Job Summary:

We are seeking a commercially-driven, analytical, and highly organized Director of Digital Merchandising to lead the delivery of a best-in-class global shopping experience. Reporting to the Vice President of eCommerce, you will be the primary architect of Ruggable’s digital storefront, ensuring our product catalog is presented with precision, relevance, and commercial intent.

Success in this role means transitioning from passive site maintenance to pairing intentional curation with algorithmically powered commercial trading. Working in seamless lockstep across Product Merchandising, Planning, UX/UI, Creative, Growth & Retention, Operations, and Analytics, you will architect a frictionless user journey that balances high-taste brand storytelling with conversion-driven shopability. As a master communicator with an elevated aesthetic lens, you seamlessly synthesize data and business imperatives into creative briefs and cohesive site strategies. Crucially, you bring a sharp POV on digital merchandising reporting—transforming analytical insights into decisive, revenue-driving site actions.

In this capacity, you will manage a team of Site Merchandisers, implementing new procedures and building efficiencies across existing workflows while fostering an environment that motivates and inspires. You are extremely detailed, a project management powerhouse, and a "launch day" leader who ensures marketing and site updates go live flawlessly and on schedule across our NA, AU, and EU storefronts.

What You'll Do:

Algorithmic Merchandising, Search & Agentic Shopping Architecture

• Algorithmic Platform Mastery: Own and optimize enterprise merchandising engine, Constructor, transforming raw platform capability into dynamic, revenue-generating automated site logic.

• Agentic Shopping & Personalized Assortment: Lead site readiness for agentic shopping and AI-driven personalization, ensuring search, browse, and recommendation engines partner seamlessly to present the precise product assortment tailored to each shopper's intent and context.

• Advanced Search Optimization: Overhaul search precision beyond broad Customer Experience/Service (CES) or basic keyword rules. Develop sophisticated synonym libraries, redirect strategies, hyper-relevant search rankings, and zero-result recovery models to eliminate broad or inaccurate search outputs.

• Full-Funnel Personalization & Carousels: Architect high-converting cross-sell and up-sell carousels and dynamic product recommendation modules across all key site touchpoints (Homepage, PLP, PDP, Mini-Cart, Checkout, and Landing Pages).

• Testing & Optimization Roadmap: Establish a disciplined A/B and multivariate testing pipeline with Constructor for search algorithms, visual sorting strategies, recommendation carousels, and landing page layouts to continuously improve CVR, RPV, and AOV.

Commercial Site Trading, Reporting & Deep Analysis

• Merchandising Reporting POV: Advocate and partner with the Analytics team to evolve a reporting framework for digital merchandising. Define dashboard layouts, and cadence that quantify site health, search effectiveness, and merchandising ROI.

• Deeper Analytical Rigor: Lead deep-dive analytics into shopper behavior, category affinity, cohort performance and basket analysis to uncover hidden revenue opportunities and inform broader site merchandising tactics.

• Proactive Site Trading: Drive a weekly commercial trading rhythm. Interpret real-time BI data, GA4 metrics, customer feedback, and Yotpo insights to identify top-funnel drop-offs and revenue optimizations.

• Catalog & Attribution Strategy: Direct catalog architecture to ensure clean metadata, comprehensive tagging, and strategic attribute mapping that powers backend algorithmic tools and agentic search systems.

Executive Alignment & Managing Up

• Proactive Managing Up: Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of eCommerce and executive leadership. Proactively communicate product performance and process opportunities across the site.

• Unified Campaign Strategy: Act as the authoritative, highly communicative lead for storefront execution during major campaigns. Take Paid, Retention, Social, and Creative Marketing teams on a clear, confident journey.

• Creative & UX Alignment: Partner seamlessly with UX/UI designers and Creative leadership to prototype site concepts (utilizing Figma), ensuring visual standards and elevated brand storytelling align with algorithmic feasibility and conversion goals.

Obsessive Project Management & Operational Excellence

• Obsessive Project Management: Establish hyper-structured workflow architectures across central global documents, Confluence and Airtable.

• Global Product Flow & Governance: Establish proactive monthly product flow planning frameworks across NA, AU, and EU storefronts, driving teams to stage and validate products well ahead of release dates to eliminate operational fire drills.

• Launch Day "Command Center": Oversee the end-to-end launch day execution, ensuring synchronized go-live moments for new product drops across all global markets with zero defects.

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor the Site Merchandising team. Build a culture grounded in commercial curiosity, data fluency, technical precision, hyper-collaboration, and pride in site perfection.

What You’ll Need to Have:

Required:

• Experience: 10+ years of digital merchandising or e-commerce leadership experience (D2C, Apparel, or Home Decor preferred), with 5+ years of managing teams.

• Managing Up & Executive Presence: Exceptional capability to manage up, articulate site tactics based on hard data and present confidently to executive stakeholders.

• Obsessive Project Management: Demonstrated user proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Asana or, Airtable, and Figma, with a proven track record of managing high-stakes, cross-functional projects with clear timelines and milestones.

• Hyper-Collaborative Communication: Outstanding interpersonal skills with a natural ability to build trust, bridge gaps between site merchandising, product merchandising, retention, paid media, customer service team members.

• Algorithmic & Agentic Expertise: Proven track record configuring and optimizing enterprise-level algorithmic search platforms (Constructor, Bloomreach, Algolia, SearchSpring, similar platform) with a strong understanding of AI/agentic shopping and personalized assortment delivery.

• Reporting & Analytical Depth: A strong perspective on digital merchandising reporting architectures; demonstrated capability to perform deep analytics on browse and search. Comfortable in GA4, Amplitude, and a BI.

• Advanced Search Capabilities: Direct experience structuring synonym matrices, search redirects, filtering optimization, and search tuning to improve conversion.

• Full-Funnel Monetization: Demonstrated success engineering cross-sell/up-sell models across PDP, PLP, Cart, and Checkout pages that drive AOV and RPV growth.

• Global Market Experience: Proven success managing multi-regional site setups (synchronizing launches and merchandising strategies across NA, AU, and EU).

Preferred:

• Vendor Management Experience: Partnering with and managing vendor relationships with relevant merchandising tooling.

• Visual & Creative Background: Experience working closely with creative directors and studio teams to balance high-taste visual merchandising with machine-learning algorithms.

Hours and Compensation:

• $170,000 - $185,000 per year base salary

• An annual bonus percentage that varies based on level of role

• Employer matching (up to 3% of base salary) for company sponsored 401K plan

• The position is currently hybrid (3 days in office), based in our corporate Torrance, CA location

At Ruggable, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Ruggable is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

To all recruitment agencies: Ruggable does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Ruggable employees or any other company destination. Ruggable is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:

As a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease, Convera is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to support B2B sales across Malta.

Sales Strategy & Execution:

Lead Generation & Prospecting:

Reporting & Analysis:

Basic Qualifications:

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including: ·

jobs.title: Industrial/Maintenance Electrician - 309A/442A-Afternoon shift
jobs.description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We’re on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you’ll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that’s what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let’s tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Role Details:

• Licensed trades : $40.25/hr - $47.25/hr

• Health, Vision and Dental benefits available from day one, company-covered benefits program (no deductions taken from your pay!)

• RRSP matching available from day one

• $1,000 tool allowance for first year, $300 tool allowance every year after

Position Summary:
As an Industrial/Maintenance Electrician 442A/309A- Afternoon Shift you are responsible for contributing to the company’s operational performance through maintenance program compliance and work order management including reactive, corrective, and preventative maintenance for all technical and non-technical components.

Primary Responsibilities:

Overall

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food’s Core Values.

• Direct and lead maintenance staff in everyday scheduling, preventative maintenance, repair of all production equipment and resolve equipment related issues.

• Collaborate with the Maintenance team, Planner and Parts Clerk to Maintain equipment and parts inventory using available resources to continuously minimize downtime and organize Maintenance Workshop

• Conduct major equipment repairs, overhauls, and rebuilding to ensure that it is fully operational and safe to operate and within schedule requirements.

• Ensure staff are well trained in health and safety standards and proper environmental practices within the plant and the Maintenance Department

• Be the embodiment and example of ADAPTABILITY and composure in times of volatility, uncertainty, and ambiguity.

• Provide support to the team across all weekdays and shifts as needed in instances of vacation, and other instances.

• Be the first adopter of new Maintenance strategies and initiatives encouraging participation and adoption amongst the Team.

• CMMS usage and Feedback to add value to the Maintenance strategy.

• Develop and maintain a Continuous Improvement and Open mindset amongst technicians.

• Provide and document continuous feedback to all technicians in such a manner to continuously develop skills and motivate them.

Maintenance

• Understand and lead compliance with both Health and Safety and Food Safety practices.

• Inspect, maintain, adjust, and repair food processing equipment and machinery to ensure the equipment is always in proper working order.

• Ensures Maintenance activities meet the required standards of precise highly automated equipment.

• Ensure the Maintenance TEAM members are required to be responsive to production needs and equipment failures.

• Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complicated and/or recurring automation failure modes. This will include reaching out to a 3rd party, performing risk analysis, evaluating potential causes, and assessing data.

• Independently conduct/coordinate the following assigned activities:

• Equipment set up and changeover.

• Conduct High Quality and documented Preventative and Reactive maintenance

• Assist with Facilities renovation and maintenance as necessary.

• Test and observe equipment and machinery using tools such as Sono scope, voltmeters and other testing devices to troubleshoot malfunctions and make repairs as needed.

• Ability to take OWNERSHIP and work independently without supervision, meet tight deadlines.

• Prepare notes on learnings, contribute to procedures, notes of observations and training to share with the broader maintenance team for overall growth and development.

• Contribute to maintenance reports by collecting and summarizing information.

• Exemplify GRIT in the pursuit of resolving Emergency repairs, Trouble shooting, creating a harmonious and effective maintenance team.

• Record all maintenance and repair services performed, keep track of all materials and parts used during the repair process.

• Ability to demonstrate knowledge sharing by mentoring, training, and guiding activities of junior and other Maintenance Technicians.

• Suggest and implement continuous improvement projects to improve equipment performance.

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

• Ability to technically assist with troubleshooting situations, evaluate and implement improvements to mitigate repeat issues in the plants.

• Performs regular technical and non-technical component monitoring, inspection and repairs including preventative and corrective maintenance tasks.

• Ensures all work is completed meets quality, contract response and all other requirements.

• Assists in the implementation of preventative maintenance (PM) program. Ensures that deficiencies are identified, recorded, and escalated, and that related documents are maintained.

• Ensure facilities are always kept to GMP, CFIA and BRC standards. Participates in preparation for audits and inspections.

• Exemplify RESPECT in your working relationships with all Key Internal Stakeholders (Maintenance Team, Other department peers, parts clerk, procurement officer etc.) and External Stakeholders (suppliers, contractors, OEM representatives etc.)

• Identify Gaps (Skills, Knowledge, Core Values) within the maintenance team and take appropriate steps to address them.

• Responsible for the highest standards of housekeeping & safety in all aspects of the job.

• Flexibility to workday, afternoons and nights shifts temporarily to support production, based on the need for coverage.

• Other related duties as assigned.

Administration

• Collaborate with the planner to provide feedback, schedule and prioritize related work orders

• Ensure that maintenance/service work is performed as required while following GMP and food building compliance.

• Participate in continuous improvement projects as required.

• Assists in enhancing customer satisfaction and maintaining positive relations through a positive and enthusiastic work ethic.

• Contributes to and participates in Performance Assessments of other technicians.

• Documenting coordinating and facilitating efficient pre shift and handover meetings to ensure smooth transitions between shifts.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports directly to the Maintenance shift lead, Maintenance Supervisor

• This position collaborates with the Production personnel, Maintenance Planner, Production Supervisors and Production Leads.

Key Performance Indicators

• Equipment Uptime vs. Availability

• PM Schedule completion rate

• Corrective WO completion rate

• Reactive WO Completion

• Punctuality

• Attendance

• MTTR

• Technician’s Job description

• Embodying Riverside’s Core Values

Education & Qualifications

• Must have Industrial/Maintenance Electrician 422A and /or 309A

• Working experience with equipment such as vertical wrapper, horizontal wrappers, robotics pickers and place, tunnel oven is an asset.

• Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, Robotics, HMIs, and controls (Allen-Bradley and SIEMENS PLC’s) preferred.

• Ability to read technical drawings, procedures and electrical schematics.

• Hands-on work experience with the following is preferred. Power transmission systems Electric and electronic controls Pneumatic and hydraulic systems Welding, brazing, and soldering Servo and electric motors lubrication types and systems Proven machining skills using lathes, milling, and drill press. Rigging and hoisting experience is an asset.

Skills & Abilities

• Strong, Electrical knowledge and experience with a balanced mechanical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Exceptional utilization of CMMS.

• Effective Trainer and Mentor.

Core Values

• A TEAM PLAYER with a positive attitude.

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, a self-starter with initiative and

• Proven desire to learn, takes OWNERSHIP, and a GRIT for technical fields.

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a day-to-day basis.

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside’s Core Values in a changing environment.

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

Please note this role is an existing vacancy.

Salary Range

$40.25—$47.25 CAD

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.

What we expect:

• Values-led: You’ll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life’s too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don’t enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We’re still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we’ll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we’re okay with that, as long as we’re staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We’re a flat organization with few silos which means you’ll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don’t be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn’t – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We’ll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can’t always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we’re all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don’t cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren’t obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We’re a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don’t brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There’s more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Disclaimer: As part of our recruitment process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including automated systems, to support the review and assessment of applications. These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

Mental Health Technicians foster personal growth in clients while upholding program policies and providing trauma-informed care.

• Candidates applying for this position should be aware that an offer for employment in this position is contingent upon passing a comprehensive background check, encompassing criminal records and motor vehicle reports.

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer

Position Summary:

The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (“the Foundation”) is seeking top talent for its Senior AI Solutions Engineer position. This position at The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (“the Foundation”) designs, builds, and supports AI-enabled applications, integrations, and workflows across the organization. The role applies generative AI, programming, systems integration, workflow automation, and low-code development to practical business needs.

This is a hands-on, technical role that works with business and technical teams to identify use cases, develop secure and maintainable solutions, and move successful prototypes into supported production use. The position collaborates with senior technical staff on higher-risk or more complex designs.

Key Responsibilities:

• Work with partners to identify and assess organizational needs that could benefit from AI.

• Translate business needs into functional requirements and practical solution designs partnering with senior technical staff on higher-risk or more complex designs as needed

• Design, build, test, deploy, document, and maintain AI-enabled applications, integrations, and workflows.

• Apply AI capabilities such as classification, extraction, summarization, content generation, knowledge retrieval, question answering, and task completion.

• Connect AI models with organizational systems and data using code, APIs, scripts, connectors, and low-code platforms.

• Develop and test prototypes, then advance successful concepts into secure, supported production solutions, incorporating peer and senior technical review as appropriate.

• Partner with departmental stakeholders to evaluate outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, cost, and suitability.

• Improve reliability and safety through grounding, business rules, validation, exception handling, human review, and appropriate access controls.

• Monitor and refine deployed solutions as needs, data, models, and supporting technologies change.

• Explain AI capabilities, limitations, costs, and risks clearly, including when a non-AI approach would be more appropriate.

• Code reusable components and established practices that support efficient, responsible AI delivery.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Relevant experience developing applications, integrations, automated workflows, or other technical solutions using generative AI tools, APIs, frameworks, or platforms

• Ability to translate business needs into working solutions and troubleshoot across applications, data sources, integrations, and AI services

• Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as JavaScript, Python, C#, or PowerShell, with knowledge of APIs, webhooks, connectors, data formats, or low-code platforms

• Experience with prompt development, structured outputs, and evaluating AI solutions for accuracy, reliability, security, and suitability

• Working knowledge of application security, credential management, testing, logging, error handling, deployment, and source control practices

• Sound judgment in balancing business value, complexity, cost, risk, and maintainability, with strong communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience with document processing, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise knowledge retrieval, agent workflows, or AI safeguards is preferred

• Familiarity with Microsoft enterprise technologies such as Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, Microsoft Graph, or Entra ID and integrating enterprise business systems is preferred

Compensation & Benefits
Individual compensation for this role is dependent on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, qualifications, skillsets, and applicable laws.  In addition to salary, the Foundation offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• 15+ options for medical insurance (with the Foundation paying 90 percent of the premiums)

• Competitive dental and vision plans

• 401(k) plan with 6 percent employer contribution

• Flexible spending accounts

• Employer paid life and disability insurance

• 18 Vacation Days; 12 Well-Being (Sick) Days; 2 Personal Days; summer Fridays (office closure at 2pm) and a summer holiday week over July 4

• Flexible work environment. We trust all employees to work closely with their manager and colleagues to determine when, where and how programs and projects get done.

Employees are also eligible for a discretionary bonus on an annual basis. The Foundation provides staff and leadership cultivation through regular training courses and events.

Salary Range

$150,000—$170,000 USD

How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit a resume and thoughtful cover letter describing through examples, their specific qualifications and interest in the position. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, please apply. Applicants who best match the position’s needs will be contacted.

About Us:
The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research was founded in 2000 with one clear objective: accelerating meaningful therapeutic advances and, ultimately, a cure for Parkinson’s disease (PD). The Foundation applies extraordinary scientific, business and media assets to this singular focus—thus creating a unique and dynamic organization. Since inception, MJFF has quickly grown into the largest nonprofit funder of Parkinson’s disease research, having funded over $2 billion in research projects in both academic and industry labs worldwide.

Visit www.michaeljfox.org for more information.

Research has shown that people from marginalized communities apply to roles only when they meet 100% of the job requirements. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, and you are someone who will contribute to our efforts to build and support a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we strongly encourage you to apply.

• Be #1 on day 1 by joining an industry leader.

jobs.title: Seasonal Kitchen Assistant (Sur La Table)
jobs.description:
With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. ·        Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations.

Operations & Compliance
·        Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations.
·        Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment.
·        Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses.
·        May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions.
·        Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly.

Physical Requirements

jobs.description:
The Customer Experience Specialist (CXS) serves as an internal liaison between the Customer, the Customer Experience Account Manager (CXAM), Service Operations and Billing. The role is directly responsible for order accuracy and progression.

Primary Responsibilities:

•    Order creation – Understand and fulfill all requirements for a “complete” order every time, following established Standard Work.  This includes pricing in place, profiles that are active and will remain active until receipt at facility, supplies requested, labor required, transportation needs, and waste inventory.

•    Order scheduling – Coordinate directly with operations to schedule required work, using systems in place (Preview, CORE, etc.), while understanding that direct communication is sometimes needed to make sure service is provided that meets or exceeds customer expectations.

•    Order follow up – Follow order progression through service, receipt at end of service location, and monitor all pieces required to fully invoice every order once service is completed.  Be prepared to engage with operational team members in transportation, service centers or plants to help push orders to completion when needed.

•    Order invoicing – Finalize orders before invoicing, fulfilling non-disposal order lines, while cross-referencing service details that are provided by operations.

•    Order management – Engage with order metrics, actively follow open orders that are not progressing as expected, and be able to speak to order status for your customer groups.

•    Internal customer experience – Understand the relationships between CX, operations and sales, and provide what each group needs to service the customer right the first time, every time.  Provide information to CXAM and/or directly to customer when needed, helping to facilitate profiling, pricing, and order clarification.  Be the communication bridge between customer/sales and operations/service providers.

•    Improvement opportunity management – Escalate service issues appropriately.  Use customer complaint tools and follow opportunities for improvement through to completion, using customer satisfaction feedback as the closing factor.

•    Metrics – Understand, provide, and track metrics per Standard Work practices, actionable reports, and financial goals.  Metrics will include order accuracy, delays in billing, communication timeframes and standards, attendance and participation in cross-functional meetings as required, and internal/external customer feedback.

•    Leadership - Mentor team members, lead team meetings, participate in feedback sessions, bring ideas for better customer experience to management, with a focus on team building and growth.  Understand the needs of both the smaller team and the larger teams and be a fully engaged member of both.

Basic Required Qualifications:

•    Bachelor’s degree in business, Environmental Sciences, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience).

•    Preferred 2 years in customer service (order management) or other industry roles (5 years minimum with high school diploma).

•    Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

•    Proficiency in CRM Microsoft Office Suite.

•    Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

•    Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as RCRA, DOT, DEA, and OSHA

•    Experience with ERP/company order processing systems (CORE, Preview, SPAK, Steriwise)

jobs.title: Manager, Community Operations
jobs.description:
firsthand supports individuals living with SMI (serious mental illness). Our holistic approach includes a team of peer recovery specialists, benefits specialists and clinicians. Our teams focus on meeting each individual where they are and walking with them side by side as a trusted guide and partner on their journey to better health.

firsthand's team members use their lived experience to build trust with these individuals and support them in reconnecting to the healthcare they need, while minimizing inappropriate healthcare utilization. Together with our health plan partners, we are changing the way our society supports those most impacted by SMI.

We are cultivating a team of deeply passionate problem-solvers to tackle significant and complex healthcare challenges with us. This is more than a job—it's a calling. Every day, you will engage in work that resonates with purpose, gain wisdom from motivated colleagues, and thrive in an environment that celebrates continuous learning, creativity, and fun.

Manager, Community Operations
The Manager, Community Operations is responsible for the operation of firsthand’s market-level community-based staff, ensuring consistent, scalable, person-centric approaches by the community teams across the market. The Manager, Community Operations ensures firsthand’s teams are effective in outreach, trust-building, engagement, benefits navigation, and clinical review for engaged individuals. This is a supervisory role with direct responsibility for hiring and oversight of team performance.

The Manager, Community Operations must be able to work in the community, meeting individuals where they are, and be comfortable working in non-traditional settings and unstructured environments. Experience supervising peer recovery specialists and/or community behavioral health staff is preferred.

Job Specifics
As Manager, Community Operations, you will:

• Lead, motivate, and inspire community teams of peers, social workers, and clinicians deeply dedicated to firsthand’s mission

• Be accountable for the success of the Community Team and engage in the coordination activities of community-based team members - Includes direct supervision of community team members

• Ensure the seamless execution of firsthand’s operational and strategic plans, including adapting practices as the business evolves

• Work with Senior Director, Operations) to expand firsthand’s local community presence and referral network with best-in-class CMHCs, FQHCs, health systems, and other local care providers

• Support the management of individual and team performance to OKRs, effectively coaching community-based staff

• Communicate key information, progress, and pain points to both internal staff and external partners

• Lead recruitment of community-based staff in collaboration with the People team

• Collaborate with the People Team and Learning and Development team to manage the development, coaching, training, and performance of community-based staff

• Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including clinicians, operations, and support staff, to drive integrated care and improve service delivery.

You will be a good fit if you have:

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, especially in working collaboratively with community-based staff and local providers

• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills, with a team-focused and continuous improvement orientation

• Strong management and supervisory skills, including organizing and leading initiatives

• Ability to be flexible and adaptable to changing strategies and needs for firsthand, its staff, and its members

• Openness in sharing best practices and challenges with operational leadership team

• Direct community experience working with individuals living with SMI

• Proficiency with Google Office suite, Slack, and Client Relationship Management (CRM) programs

The experience you bring to this role includes:
Required:

• Minimum five years' experience in a healthcare-focused business (preferably leading community-based teams)

• Minimum of three years of direct supervisory experience (managing certified peer recovery specialists or similar staff with lived experience) - making hiring decisions, managing team member performance, etc.

• Experience working in a multidisciplinary setting, leveraging diverse expertise to provide holistic care

$100,000—$100,000 USD

Our full-time compensation package includes a base salary, equity, and performance bonus potential, supported by comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental wellness coverage.
