jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description:
Who we are at Osmo:

Osmo is a digital olfaction company, on a mission to give computers a sense of smell to improve the health and wellbeing of human life. Why? Our sense of smell both enriches and saves lives, and has a deep and direct connection to our emotions and memory.

Olfactory Intelligence has applications across industries including fragrance, manufacturing, security, medicine, and more. We believe in the power of automation and thoughtfully applied AI/ML to solve problems beyond the reach of human intuition alone. 



We're headquartered in Elizabeth, NJ, with an additional office in Somerville, MA. We provide complimentary shuttle service from Brooklyn and Newark, NJ.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Osmo is building the first computer that can smell. Olfactory Intelligence (OI) is the model suite behind that: it predicts how a molecule or a mixture will smell, generates new formulas from a creative brief, and now powers commercial products for some of the largest consumer goods companies in the world. It runs on 5.4M+ human sniff annotations, 100M+ mass spectral readings, and a molecule library in the billions, data no one else has.

We are hiring a Head of Applied AI to own the team that builds these models. You will lead the ML engineers and research scientists, set the roadmap and the quality bar, and own the path from research notebook to production API. You will report to the CTO and work daily with Software Platform, Product Engineering, Chemistry, Sensory Science, and the perfumers and evaluators who are the ground truth for every prediction. This is a hands-on leadership seat at a company of roughly 100 people. You will read the code, run experiments, and be held to hard contractual accuracy gates with enterprise partners.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead the OI Team — Hire, level, and grow ML engineers and research scientists across formulation, prediction, and generative models, and set the review standards they work under.

 - Set Model Roadmap — Decide what we double down on, retire, or merge across brief-to-formula generation, reformulation and cost optimization, molecule generation, deformulation, odor prediction, and per-customer property models.

 - Own the Benchmarks — Run the OI benchmark suite, including internal quality gates, contractual acceptance criteria, and the model cards that go to customers and investors, so "is this model better?" gets a fast, credible answer.

 - Deliver Enterprise Commitments — Be accountable for contractual model deliverables with hard accuracy gates and quarterly dates, and say early and clearly when a target is out of reach.

 - Run the Data Flywheel — Work with Sensory Science and Fragrance Development to design experiments, define annotation protocols, and set the KPIs that turn panel time into model gains.

 - Ship to Production — Partner with Software Platform and Product Engineering to move models from research to a reliable production API, with versioning, monitoring, and drift handled.

 - Stay Hands-On — Read diffs, challenge eval design, and run experiments yourself.

 - Make Hard Cuts — Kill good work to make room for essential work, and explain the call with kindness and clarity.

 - Partner Across Osmo — Work daily with Chemistry, perfumers, and evaluators so model output is grounded in what people actually smell.

 - Own the Bar — Define what excellent applied ML looks like at Osmo and hold the team, and yourself, to it.




WHO YOU ARE:

 - Seasoned Applied ML Leader — 10+ years of industry ML/AI experience in an applied or research capacity, with models shipped to real users, not only papers or prototypes.

 - Proven People Leader — You have managed, hired, leveled, and grown ML engineers or research scientists. Team lead experience with real ownership counts; we care about substance over title.

 - Deep in Your Craft — Depth in at least one of: generative models over structured or discrete objects, molecular or chemical ML, multi-modal representation learning, LLM systems and evaluation, or Bayesian and experimental design. Breadth across several is a strong plus.

 - Rigorous on Evaluation — You ask what the baseline is, whether the test set leaked, and whether the metric moved for the reason everyone assumes.

 - Production Minded — You have owned models in production and know what versioning, monitoring, drift, and on-call actually cost.

 - Curious About Hard Data — You are energized by small, noisy, expensive data and by getting the most out of hard-won human perceptual labels rather than internet-scale ones.

 - Tenacious and Kind — You hold a high bar and stay with hard problems, and you lead the team with candor and care.

 - Hands-On — You still read diffs and run experiments. At a company this size, a leader who can't do the work can't lead it.

 - Hybrid schedule, 3 days a week in the Elizabeth, NJ office




WAYS TO STAND OUT:

 - Science Background — Chemistry, chemoinformatics, sensory science, or biology experience.

 - External Deliverables — Experience in an enterprise or contract-research setting where you owned model deliverables for outside partners.

 - Built the Foundation — Experience standing up an ML platform or eval infrastructure from scratch.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6-12 MONTHS):

 - TBD, not yet confirmed by Rich. Draft based on the JD: a fast, credible, reproducible OI benchmark suite; enterprise accuracy gates hit or flagged early; a hiring bar and leveling standard in place; and clear keep, retire, or merge decisions across the six model areas. Confirm at kickoff.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Real Growth Path — Report directly to the CTO and own the full OI applied ML organization, with room to grow scope as OI and its enterprise partnerships expand. Confirm specifics with Rich.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

 - Flexible PTO and paid family leave

 - 401(k) savings plan and employer match

 - Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

 - Catered Lunch — Mon/Wed/Fri; Newark, NJ and Brooklyn shuttles

If this role inspires you we’d encourage you to apply. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and retaining an incredible team optimized for a diversity of thought, background, and approaches.

For all Full-Time Employees, compensation is just one component of Osmo’s total rewards approach, which is designed to support the well-being, growth, and long-term success of our team members. Depending on the role, this may include base salary or contract-based pay, along with access to health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match; flexible paid time off and company holidays; and equity or incentive compensation for eligible roles. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other relevant business considerations. Osmo regularly reviews pay ranges and compensation structures to ensure they remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with current market data.  

All employment decisions and responsibilities are determined based on current ability and your ability to grow, without regard to race, color, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, religion, age, marital status, physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Payroll Analyst supports accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for Jamf's U.S. workforce while assisting with payroll processing for Jamf's international workforce. This role processes payroll and standard tax filings under established procedures, supports international payroll vendors on day-to-day matters, and escalates complex or novel tax and compliance issues to senior payroll staff.

What you can expect to do in this role:

• Process semimonthly U.S. payroll — wages, deductions, benefits, and garnishments — across multiple states in Workday, following established payroll procedures.

• Support U.S. payroll tax compliance by preparing standard federal, state, and local tax filings (Forms 941, 940, W-2, and W-3) for review, and assist with reconciling tax liabilities against the general ledger.

• Research routine payroll tax notices and agency correspondence, escalating complex or novel issues to senior payroll or tax staff.

• Support year-end processing, including W-2 preparation and reconciliation.

• Support payroll processing for Jamf employees outside the U.S. by coordinating with in-country payroll providers on day-to-day pay accuracy and timeliness.

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned international payroll vendors, flagging discrepancies for review before disbursement.

• Process and audit garnishments, levies, and voluntary deductions in compliance with applicable law.

• Coordinate with HR, Legal, and Finance on standard multi-state and multi-country payroll matters, escalating complex tax or compliance questions as needed.

• Use AI-powered tools alongside other payroll technologies to support validation and reconciliation tasks, flagging anomalies for review.

• Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

• 2+ years of U.S. payroll processing experience (required)

• Working knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax rules — FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and withholding (required)

• Experience with a major payroll platform, such as Workday, ADP Workforce Now, ADP Streamline/Celergo, or UKG (required)

• Exposure to international payroll processes, ideally partnering with in-country payroll providers or Employers of Record (EORs) (preferred)

• Experience partnering with One Source Virtual (OSV) or similar payroll service providers to support U.S. payroll processing (preferred)

• Proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables) for reconciliations and reporting (required)

• Comfort using AI-powered tools to support payroll validation and reconciliation tasks (preferred)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree (preferred)

• A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered (required)

If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun! • Review RFPs and RFQs in partnership with the internal bid team, from initial solicitation through final submission

• Experience with government contracting

jobs.description:
We are looking for a strategic and analytical Director of Revenue Operations to join our leadership team. In this role, you will lead the planning, forecasting, and reporting for our Post-Sales teams, spanning Onboarding and Customer Success, while managing and mentoring a team of two analysts. You will partner cross-functionally to diagnose bottlenecks, improve onboarding efficiency, and drive operational excellence that supports the overall growth of our organization.


 - This position will be hybrid

 - Reports to: Vice President of Revenue Operations

 - Partners closely with: Vice President of Onboarding & Customer Success
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Own Post-Sale operational excellence across Onboarding, Customer Success, and Customer Education, establishing scalable processes, systems, governance, and operating models that improve efficiency, consistency, customer outcomes, and the ability to scale.

 - Develop and execute planning, forecasting, and performance management frameworks for Onboarding and Customer Success, including time-to-value, implementation timelines, productivity, process adherence, adoption, retention, expansion, and overall customer health.

 - Establish KPIs, reporting, dashboards, and operating rhythms that provide actionable visibility into Post-Sale performance, capacity, customer outcomes, and operational health; translate data and insights into clear recommendations and priorities.

 - Analyze customer journeys, workflows, systems, and performance data to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve throughput, quality, productivity, and the overall customer experience.

 - Lead workforce, organizational, and capacity planning across Onboarding and Customer Success, including headcount models, organizational structure, role design, resource allocation, productivity targets, and staffing forecasts.

 - Design and optimize the end-to-end customer implementation and account setup experience, including account setup processes, technical integrations, handoffs, implementation standards, and quality controls that drive a consistent and efficient path to value.

 - Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives across People, Process, and Technology, partnering with Customer Success, Onboarding, Education, Sales Operations, Product, Finance, HR, BI, and Technology to identify opportunities, align priorities, and drive implementation.

 - Develop and manage compensation and incentive programs for Onboarding and Customer Success that align team behaviours and performance with company objectives, customer outcomes, productivity, retention, and growth.

 - Evaluate and implement revenue operations technologies, automation, and AI capabilities that improve data quality, reduce manual work, increase team capacity and productivity, and enhance the customer experience.

 - Foster a collaborative, data-driven, and results-oriented operating culture, establishing clear accountability, performance standards, and continuous improvement practices across the Post-Sale organization.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

 - 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, customer success operations, or a related field, preferably within a SaaS organization

 - Experience with performance metrics, reporting, and CRM tools (Salesforce preferred)

 - Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to coaching and mentoring

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment





WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

jobs.title: Program / Project Assistant
jobs.description:
About our Company:

Universal DX, Inc. is an international Company with a highly experienced team focused on cracking cancer’s code. Through our multi-omics and bioinformatics models, we have figured out how to read the disease’s signals in blood with high accuracy to detect cancer in its earliest stages. Starting with a colorectal cancer screening liquid biopsy test, we are building a multi-cancer platform that can identify the unique DNA regions associated with different types of cancers.

The Opportunity:

Universal DX is seeking a Program/Project Assistant to join our growing Program Management team. Reporting to the Director, Program Management, this role will work closely with program managers and cross-functional teams—including Product Development, Lab Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and other partners—to support the development and commercialization of IVD products. This is an opportunity to build hands-on program management experience while helping teams stay coordinated, maintain clear information, and execute complex work.

You will be part of a team that is passionate about developing novel diagnostic tests for the early detection of cancers. As part of the team, you will be in a Company that aims more than to become one of the leaders in the industry. We want to have a huge positive impact on society by achieving the ambitious purpose of “making cancer a curable disease by detecting it earlier”.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Universal DX. We are advancing Signal-C and expanding the integrated product-development and laboratory capabilities needed to bring a new generation of cancer-screening diagnostics to patients.

We are looking for passionate changemakers who can bring structure, insight, and collaboration to ambitious, technically complex work.

How you'll contribute:

• Working closely with assigned program managers, support planning, communication, coordination, and follow-up for cross-functional programs supporting lab readiness and IVD development and commercialization.

• Develop and maintain PMO resources, schedules, trackers, templates, dashboards, and other tools that enable effective program operations.

• Collect, organize, and analyze program, project, milestone, and resource data; prepare accurate reports and dashboards to support decisions.

• Support meetings and workshops by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, capturing decisions and actions, and following up on commitments.

• Build and maintain content in Confluence, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft 365, and other PMO systems, ensuring information is current and easy to use.

• Support portfolio and resource management processes, guidance documents, training, and onboarding of cross-functional team members.

• Under program-manager supervision, coordinate minor projects, deliverables, or subteams and proactively flag gaps, risks, or follow-up needs.

• Support and drive AI implementation within PMO to deliver more effective team and program operations.

What you'll bring:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, science, engineering, or a related field.

• Zero to two years of project or program coordination experience; one or more years in life sciences, diagnostics, or medical devices is preferred.

• Familiarity with regulated product development and medical device or IVD requirements, including 21 CFR Part 812 and ISO 13485; direct IVD experience is a plus.

• Familiarity with project management concepts and methods; CAPM, PMP training, or progress toward a related credential is preferred.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, problem solving ability, and capacity to prioritize and manage multiple assignments.

• Ability to collect and analyze data, create reports and dashboards, and synthesize information accurately.

• Exposure to project management tools; experience with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 is preferred.

• Experience using and leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in a program/project management setting is a plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, teamwork, facilitation, and follow-through skills.

• Ability to support global and remote teams across time zones, with adaptability and a proactive approach to learning.

What we'll offer:

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

• 22 days of PTO with the possibility to carry over 10 days to the following year.

• Company Holidays, plus your Birthday off!

• Company-sponsored benefit plans, including medical, dental, and vision insurance plus life, STD, and LTD coverage, and 401(k).

• Flexible work schedule

• And more to come!

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Universal DX. We are growing rapidly and starting our US operations by building up our team, starting our lab and business operations, and establishing strategic partnerships.

We are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey in this expansive time for us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Strategy Research Analytics
jobs.description:
Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.



As a Senior Software Engineer in Strategy Research Analytics, you will lead the design, evolution, and long-term architecture of Voleon’s analytics infrastructure supporting research reporting and analysis across strategies. You will own critical recurring analytics pipelines and foundational datasets, while guiding the transition from fragmented, bespoke workflows toward a standardized, observable, and query-native analytics platform. In addition to hands-on implementation, you will shape technical direction, establish reliability standards, and drive consolidation efforts that improve consistency, scalability, and reproducibility across research analytics systems.



You’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Researchers, and Data Infrastructure teams to ensure analytics systems run reliably and produce consistent, queryable datasets. This role offers strong technical ownership within a mission-critical area of the research organization, with meaningful impact on research velocity and insight generation.



Your Team

The Research Analytics team sits within Research Engineering and works closely with Data Scientists and Researchers across all of Voleon's core strategies. We look for brilliant people with a passion for solving problems through innovation and engineering fundamentals. You’ll work in a collaborative environment that encourages creative thinking and efficient implementation.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers recruited from leading technology companies and selected from the sharpest minds at university programs.



The team’s mission is to:

 - Stabilize existing analytics pipelines to ensure critical data is available for our data scientist and research partners

 - Implement monitoring/alerting and operational runbooks; participate in incident response and postmortems

 - Standardize outputs from strategy workflows into a unified analytics schema (tables, metrics definitions, partitioning strategy)

 - Improve dataset discoverability via documentation, schema contracts, and metadata/lineage primitives

 - Optimize query performance and cost for distributed engines (Presto/Spark) and columnar formats (Parquet/ORC)



Responsibilities

 - Own implementation and on-going operation of recurring analytics pipelines (e.g., Airflow DAGs) including monitoring, alerting, and reliability improvements

 - Lead architectural evolution of the analytics platform, including schema standardization, DAG consolidation, and modernization of legacy workflows

 - Drive cross-team technical alignment when consolidating duplicated or inconsistent analytics outputs

 - Build and maintain base analytics tables and metrics with strong schema discipline and reproducible computation

 - Define and implement reliability standards (SLOs, observability patterns, runbooks) adopted across analytics pipelines

 - Improve transparency and usability through documentation, discoverability, and clear data contracts

 - Optimize distributed compute and SQL query performance; design data layouts (partitioning, file sizing) for columnar storage

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews and raise the bar for operational and modeling rigor



Requirements:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience

 - 6+ years of experience building and operating analytics or data infrastructure systems

 - Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

 - Deep experience with distributed query engines and large-scale compute systems

 - Demonstrated ownership of large-scale or mission-critical data infrastructure

 - Strong data modeling expertise, including schema design, partitioning strategy, and reproducibility considerations

 - Expertise in metadata management, data lineage, and applying robust data governance principles



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience leading architectural migrations or major refactors of data platforms

 - Familiarity with AWS cloud technologies and on-prem compute clusters (e.g., Slurm, SSH, Unix)

 - Exposure to quantitative research or machine learning environments.

For more details regarding eligibility, terms and conditions please make sure to review the Voleon Referral Bonus Program https://voleon.com/assets/Voleon-Referral-Bonus-Program.pdf.



Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Relocation Consultant (1099) - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
What Relocity is Doing

Relocity is reimagining the global mobility experience. We enable enterprises to attract, retain, and engage talent globally through our unique blend of mobility software solutions and high-touch destination services. Our personalized digital transferee experience accommodates all mobile talent and is enabled by our AI-driven native mobile app and workforce mobility platform. Our core values drive us to focus on our customers, innovation, integrity, and excellence. Relocity serves thousands of cities across the United States, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at www.relocity.com.

Services You’ll Provide…

As a Relocation Consultant (1099 Contractor), you will deliver high-touch, client-facing relocation services to employees and their families as they transition into a new city. You will act as a knowledgeable local resource, offering tailored guidance and hands-on support across key aspects of the relocation experience.

This opportunity is structured around individual client engagements, with service needs varying based on market activity and client demand. Services are delivered both remotely and in-person within your local area, depending on the nature of each engagement.

Success in this role requires strong local expertise, a consultative mindset, and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements while delivering a seamless, high-quality experience.

How You’ll Deliver Value…

Build trusted relationships with relocating employees by understanding their needs, preferences, and priorities. Provide guidance on neighborhoods, transportation, and local lifestyle considerations. Conduct housing and school research, including rental market insights, commute considerations, and general suitability. Support clients with local orientation and navigation of common relocation logistics. Curate personalized recommendations for dining, social, cultural, and lifestyle activities. Deliver tailored insights and recommendations using your local expertise and available tools. Facilitate area tours (virtual or in-person), offering real-time perspective and context. Communicate with clients through phone, email, video, and/or in-person interactions. Coordinate with relevant vendors, partners, or service providers as needed to support the client experience. Manage multiple client engagements independently, ensuring organization and follow-through. Document key updates and interactions to support continuity of service.

What Enables Success in This Role…

Established presence in Atlanta, with strong knowledge of local neighborhoods, housing, and lifestyle offerings. Experience in a client-facing, service-oriented capacity (e.g., relocation services, real estate, hospitality, concierge services, mobility, or similar). Ability to operate independently and manage multiple engagements simultaneously. Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills. Professional judgment and discretion when supporting clients through complex or high-touch situations. Familiarity with local service providers, vendors, or community networks is a strong advantage. Prior experience relocating individuals or clients is preferred.

What Past Experience and Current Skills Will Enable Your Success In This Role?

• Must have the legal right to work in the United States.

• Must have at least 5 years of residency in Houston with extensive knowledge of the local rental market, education system, and local registration processes.

• Must own (not rent) a reliable, registered, and insured 4-door vehicle with a valid driv er’s license, as the role involves driving clients for area tours and rental searches.

• Must be flexible and available to work weekends.

• Friendly, outgoing personality, strong customer service orientation, and problem-solving abilities.

• Must be self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Prior personal or professional relocation or moving assistance experience is preferred, but not required.

Education and/or Technology Requirement

• Bachelor or Associate’s degree (or equivalent) preferred

• Extensive experience with technology tools such as Microsoft Office, Google GSuite, and CRM systems

• Must have a laptop, smartphone, and reliable internet connection

Language Skills

• Ability to read and interpret documents such as contracts, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

• Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

• Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of an organization.

• Bilingual (English/ Spanish) preferred.

Nature of Engagement

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. Contractors are engaged on a per-assignment basis, with service volume varying by client demand and market activity. There is no guarantee of ongoing or minimum volume of work. Contractors maintain discretion over how services are delivered, in alignment with client needs and engagement expectations. Contractors are responsible for maintaining any required licenses, insurance, or local compliance applicable to their services.

Additional Considerations

Strong familiarity with the local market is essential to delivering a high-quality client experience. This opportunity is well-suited for individuals already operating in a client-facing or service-based capacity within their local market. Compensation varies based on location, scope, and complexity of each engagement

Pay range: $30 - $35

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Northspyre, the only end-to-end real estate development management platform, empowers developers to make smarter investment decisions with data-driven insights and collaborative workflows. Through automation, analytics, and AI, Northspyre gives teams the real-time information, performance insights, and workflow tools they need to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. By bringing project stakeholders, data, and processes together all on one integrated platform, Northspyre eliminates expensive silos in the development lifecycle, making project delivery simple and outcomes more predictable. Since 2017, Northspyre has been the backbone of operational infrastructure for leading development firms, supporting over $500 billion in projects across the US.

About the Opportunity

Northspyre is looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to build and lead the systems, processes, training, and resources that help our sales organization perform at its best.

This is a highly visible, high-impact individual contributor leadership role for someone who believes great sales organizations are built through clear processes, rigorous execution, strong coaching, and repeatable playbooks.

You will be responsible for defining how Northspyre equips its sales team to succeed — from onboarding and training to sales methodology, messaging, deal execution, competitive positioning, and ongoing coaching.

The ideal candidate is equal parts sales operator, coach, and builder. You have likely worked in a high-growth SaaS environment, a venture-backed or sponsor-backed company, or another organization where you helped professionalize a sales motion and turn successful selling behaviors into a repeatable system.

This role is designed for someone who wants to build something and grow with it. As Northspyre's sales organization expands, the scope of this role can grow into broader sales leadership and people-management responsibilities.

You won't simply create training materials. You'll help define how Northspyre sells — and build the systems that make great selling repeatable.

In This Role, You'll Get To

• Build and own Northspyre's sales enablement strategy and playbook, including sales methodology, qualification standards, discovery, messaging, objection handling, deal strategy, competitive positioning, and closing practices.

• Establish a repeatable sales process that creates consistency across the team while still allowing individual sellers to bring their own strengths and style.

• Analyze the existing sales motion to identify gaps in process, skills, messaging, pipeline management, tools, and execution, then turn those insights into practical improvements.

• Develop and implement a structured sales onboarding and ramp program that gets new sellers productive quickly.

• Establish ongoing sales training and coaching programs, using call reviews, deal reviews, role plays, pipeline reviews, and other mechanisms to continuously improve seller performance.

• Partner closely with Sales leadership to establish clear expectations around pipeline generation, opportunity management, forecasting, conversion, and quota attainment.

• Create the systems and operating rhythms that allow sales managers and individual contributors to understand what good looks like and consistently execute against it.

• Coach sales managers and individual contributors, helping them diagnose performance gaps and develop practical plans to improve.

• Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, RevOps, and Leadership to ensure our positioning, messaging, and sales process reflect the market and customer.

• Develop and maintain sales collateral, talk tracks, competitive intelligence, case studies, battlecards, and other resources that help sellers win.

• Use data to identify performance trends, diagnose bottlenecks, and determine where additional coaching, training, or process improvements will have the greatest impact.

• Bring structure and accountability to the sales organization while maintaining a culture that is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and customer-focused.

• Build the foundation for a scalable sales enablement function, including the processes, technology, metrics, and operating cadence required as the organization grows.

• Partner with Sales leadership on broader GTM initiatives and organizational development, gaining increasing exposure to the strategic and leadership responsibilities of a scaling sales organization.

• As the team grows, have the opportunity to take on increasing people-management and sales leadership responsibilities.

We Are Looking For People Who Have

• 6+ years of experience in B2B sales, sales enablement, sales leadership, sales operations, or a combination of these disciplines.

• A track record of improving how sales teams sell, rather than simply executing within an established sales machine.

• Experience creating or significantly improving a sales playbook, methodology, onboarding program, or enablement function.

• Strong experience coaching sellers and/or managers across the sales cycle, from prospecting through close.

• A highly analytical and process-oriented approach. You naturally ask: Where is the bottleneck? What does the data tell us? What should we change?

• The ability to translate strategy into clear, practical processes and behaviors that salespeople actually use.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization, even without direct authority.

• A bias toward action and experimentation. You are comfortable operating in an environment where the playbook is still being written.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to simplify complex concepts into compelling sales messaging and repeatable behaviors.

• A builder's mentality. You enjoy creating structure where little exists and are excited by the opportunity to grow into broader responsibility over time.

• A customer-centric mindset and a genuine interest in understanding why customers buy, why they don't buy, and what creates urgency.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience at a venture-backed, private equity-backed, or sponsor-backed company, particularly in a growth or transformation environment.

• Experience building a sales enablement function or sales organization from the ground up.

• Experience taking a sales motion that worked for a small number of high-performing sellers and turning it into a repeatable system for a larger team.

• Experience working with a private equity operating team, portfolio company, or sales transformation initiative.

• Experience with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar frameworks.

• SaaS experience, particularly selling complex B2B software with multi-stakeholder buying processes.

• Experience selling into commercial real estate, construction, development, or another complex industry.

• Experience partnering closely with RevOps to improve CRM hygiene, forecasting, pipeline analytics, and sales productivity.

• Experience developing sales managers and building a management operating cadence.

• Experience with sales compensation, territory design, segmentation, or other elements of scaling a GTM organization.

• Prior people-management experience or demonstrated interest in growing into a formal sales leadership role.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you'll develop a clear understanding of Northspyre's sales motion, identify the highest-impact gaps, and establish a prioritized roadmap for improving sales execution and enablement.

Within six months, you'll have established an adopted sales playbook, strengthened onboarding and coaching, and created a more consistent operating rhythm across the sales organization.

Over time, you'll help Northspyre build a sales organization where strong performance is not dependent on individual heroics — it is driven by repeatable processes, great coaching, strong systems, and a team that knows exactly how to win.

As Northspyre grows, the scope of this role will grow with it. For the right person, this role can become a path into broader sales leadership and people management, with increasing ownership of the sales organization, its managers, and its operating strategy.

Benefits and Perks

• In addition to a competitive salary, we are offering a meaningful stock option package

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision. Multiple plan options, including a plan option for 100% employer-paid premium for individual coverage for full-time employees.

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (Fully vested after 6 mo eligibility period)

• Unlimited Vacation, Paid Sick Leave, and major US Holidays

• Awesome company swag!

• Free access to Health Advocate

• Hybrid & Remote opportunities - we have an Amazing new office in Midtown Atlanta

• You will be part of a small, professional fast-moving team with minimal supervision

• Annual team gatherings

Top Three Reasons to Join

#1: It’s the Right Time – We’ve already facilitated more than $500 billion of complex projects across the United States

#2. Northspyre has the right product – Our technology empowers modern real estate teams to build leveraging data, automation and artificial intelligence to get to faster, more predictable outcomes on complex projects.

#3. Northspyre celebrates a culture of creativity – We strive to have a sense of community within Northspyre that encourages diverse viewpoints, openness, and fostering an environment in which employees feel comfortable bringing their whole authentic selves to work.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

As a People Operations Specialist, you'll be the engine behind SpotMe's people processes. You'll run our core employee lifecycle processes, keep our people data accurate and reliable, answer questions from employees and managers, and help make everyday life at SpotMe run smoothly. Success in this role comes from precision, quick and reliable responses, seeing things through, and a drive to automate repetitive work so the team can focus on what matters most. It's a chance to have a real impact: strengthening our culture, supporting our people's growth, and helping continuously improve the employee experience at SpotMe.

What you will do:

This role reports to the Head of People and focuses on:

• [30%] Employee lifecycle administration:

• process all HRIS transactions - new hires, promotions, contract changes, line manager changes and terminations. Make sure each change reaches everyone who needs it, including payroll, legal and group reporting.

• Prepare contracts and amendments from our templates for Legal's review, and send complete payroll inputs before each cut-off.

• Run right-to-work checks for every hire, and track probation periods, work permits and employment certificates.

• Manage offboarding end to end: HRIS, payroll, benefits,l and final documents.

• [30%] Employee experience and support:

• Prepare every new joiner from offer acceptance: a welcome pack and information, HRIS onboarding tasks, equipment, travel and accommodation for the onsite week.

• Coordinate first-day logistics with line managers, and make sure new joiner announcements go out.

• Keep regular touchpoints with new joiners beyond the paperwork, checking in on travel and questions and sharing company news, so they feel part of the team before day one.

• Act as backup facilitator for the HR intro, and set up new joiner reviews

• Administer all leave - that includes HRIS updates, tracking, documentation, and keeping managers and payroll informed. Run the PTO approval checks

• Be the first point of contact for day-to-day employee questions on leave, payslips, benefits, policies and processes and escalate matters appropriately

• [10%] People data, tools and group reporting

• Keep our HRIS accurate and complete as the single source of truth for employee data. That means up-to-date records (personal details, job, compensation, line manager), correct leave balances and policies, bank holidays for each country, country-specific updates such as seniority pay, and employee documents stored in the right place with the right access.

• Submit monthly KPI and staff changes reports and weekly staff updates to our group HR teams, and keep the org chart up to date.

• Administer our employee platforms: routine maintenance, adding and removing users, user support, escalating issues, and coordinating with vendors and internal stakeholders.

• [15%] Process improvement and automation

• Maintain and improve People Operations content in the Handbook, so every process is documented and clear to follow.

• Support operational projects, such as updating offboarding documentation, refreshing contract templates with Legal

• Automate repetitive work through workflows, templates, reminders and reports.

• Spot data issues and process gaps, fix what you can, and escalate what needs a decision.

• [15%] People programs

• Support the Head of People in running company-wide and team-level initiatives, such as training, feedback sessions, retreats and team meetings, from planning and communications to logistics and collecting feedback afterwards.

What we need from you:

In your first month

• Take over the recurring cycle and deliver it independently: the monthly group KPI reports, the weekly staff updates and the monthly PTO approval checks.

• Handle onboarding and touchpoints for at least one new joiner, from travel and accommodation through the week plan and arrival email.

• Map every contract, amendment and payroll handoff with Legal and Finance, and get both teams to sign off on it, so each step has one owner and a clear deadline.

• Learn the most common employee questions by reviewing past requests with the Head of People

• Present a People Ops calendar of every recurring deadline, plus your top three operational risks with a proposed fix for each.

By month 3:

• Take over admin of our employee platforms, with every joiner and leaver added or removed on time.

• Map our People processes and present a recommendation to the Head of People on where automation and better workflows would save the most time. Agree the priorities and start implementing the first improvements.

• Run the full offer-to-day-one journey for every new joiner, with the week plan sent at least one week before arrival and regular touchpoints until day one.

• Become the go-to person for routine People questions, answering within 1 working day and escalating anything sensitive or important to the Head of People.

• Support the Head of People in delivering at least one training or feedback session end to end, from logistics to collecting feedback.

By month 6: owning the full scope of the role

• Own all People Operations admin independently: lifecycle administration, leave, people data and group reporting, and onboarding/offboarding logistics. Support Head of People, on People programs, bringing your own ideas and creativity.

• Implement the first automation and workflow improvements from your recommendation, and show the time saved.

• Support the rollout of the new performance management tool, including configuration checks and employee training logistics.

What you need to be great at

• Acting on feedback. When you get feedback today, you change how you work tomorrow. You take it as fuel, not criticism, and you ask for it before anyone offers.

• Automation and efficiency. You look at every manual task and ask whether it needs to be manual. You're comfortable using tools like workflows, templates and AI assistants such as Claude to work faster and remove repetitive work.

• Systems thinking. You see how processes connect: how one change in the HRIS flows through to payroll, reporting and the people affected. You fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

• Stakeholder management. You work well with Legal, Finance, managers and external providers at the same time. You know when to be flexible and when to push to get things done on time.

What we are most curious about:

• Tell us about a process you took over with no documentation: how you worked out how it ran, how you checked nothing was missing, and what you did next to improve it.

• Tell us about a manual process you automated or simplified: what it looked like before, what you built or changed, and how much time it saved, with real numbers.

• What are 2 or 3 ways you use AI tools like Claude that reliably save you time, where do you refuse to use them, and why?

jobs.title: Care Navigator (Remote)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH

Sailor Health is revolutionizing mental health care for older adults, addressing one of the fastest-growing and most underserved healthcare segments in America. With over 60 million seniors expected to make up nearly 25% of the population by 2030, we’re entering a period of unprecedented demand for care. Yet, today, millions of older adults remain isolated, underserved, and struggling with mental health challenges such as anxiety, depression, loneliness without adequate support.

At Sailor Health, we envision a world where every senior has seamless access to compassionate, effective, and personalized mental health care. Join us on our mission to redefine the golden years, enabling older adults across the nation to live happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: Remote - US based

Title: Care Navigator

We’re hiring a full-time remote Care Navigator to be the first voice a patient – or their family -hears when reaching out to Sailor Health. In this role, you’ll guide older adults and their caregivers through the intake process with warmth, clarity, and professionalism, ensuring they feel supported every step of the way.

This role is a unique blend of patient support, care coordination, and emotional guidance. You’ll be the steady hand helping each new patient navigate the journey into care, from matching with the right therapist to feeling confident and understood every step of the way. It’s a perfect fit for someone who thrives at the intersection of empathy and execution, and who finds meaning in turning a moment of vulnerability into one of reassurance and trust.

This role is especially well-suited for someone with an interest in mental health and healthcare access – since you’ll often be the first emotional point of contact for individuals seeking care.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Empathetic and clear communicator. You speak with kindness, listen actively, and make others feel at ease – even during difficult or emotional conversations.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple patients at different stages in the process and never let things slip through the cracks.

 - Tech-comfortable. You’re comfortable learning tools like Google Workspace, EHR platforms (e.g., Healthie), or CRMs like HubSpot, and pick up new software quickly.

 - Mission-aligned. You care deeply about improving care for older adults and are excited to play a key role in someone’s first step toward better mental health.

 - Experience welcome, not required. You may have worked in healthcare, customer service, or an administrative support role before – but most importantly, you’re organized, compassionate, and eager to grow.
   


WHY JOIN SAILOR HEALTH

 - Mission with impact. Help bring life-changing care to a population that’s too often overlooked.

 - Remote-first team. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while staying closely connected with a thoughtful, collaborative team rooted in purpose.

 - Growth and ownership. Be part of a small, agile team where you’ll take initiative, shape key processes, and grow as we grow.

 - Make someone’s day – every day. Your work helps older adults and their families feel seen, supported, and cared for.
   
   If this sounds like you, we’d love to connect. Join us in redefining what it means to age with dignity, connection, and mental wellness.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Development
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY:

The Manager, Sales Development leads the front line of OpenGov's mission. You won't just hit a number — you'll build and coach a team of SDRs who connect government leaders with technology that helps their communities run better. This is a player-coach role for someone who's energized by developing people: you'll drive a team of 12-15 SDRs across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic motions and ensure they have the tools to meet and exceed their quotas.

We like to promote at least 75% of our internal SDR team members! In 2025, our SDR org delivered 30 internal promotions and 60 new hires, growing the team 200% over the last year — your job is to keep that engine running. You won't be maintaining a team. You'll be building one.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead and coach the team — develop a team of 12-15 SDRs to hit their individual and team quotas, aligning their prospecting to company objectives and target markets

 - Carry the numbers — manage the monthly quota and drive the SDR team to consistently meet or exceed this goal.

 - Run a real cadence — own weekly 1:1s, standups, and call reviews, and build a culture of continuous learning that prepares SDRs for AE, CSM, SE, and leadership roles

 - Own the metrics — monitor team performance, surface actionable insights to stakeholders, drive continuous improvement, and address performance issues directly

 - Partner cross-functionally — work with Marketing, Demand Gen, AEs, and regional sales leaders to build prospecting strategies and identify high-potential pipeline

 - Build the bench — partner with the Sr. Director of Sales Development to refine processes, training, and team culture, and to develop the next wave of sales leaders

 - Hire and ramp — own interviewing, assessment, and hiring decisions on performance potential and culture add, and onboard new reps so they ramp fast




SETS OUR SDR LEADERSHIP TEAM APART:

 - A clear path forward. This role has high growth opportunities as our company continues to scale. You'll be leading one of OpenGov's fastest-growing hubs, and strong people-developers get noticed quickly.

 - You build people who get promoted. The team you lead feeds an AE org where SDRs get promoted quickly. OpenGov genuinely promotes from within — the best part of this job is watching your reps move up.

 - The mission is real. OpenGov serves 2,000+ governments, and roughly 1 in 3 people in the US is touched by an OpenGov customer. Mission-driven selling makes a team easier to motivate, coach, and retain.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of coaching, mentoring, and developing reps — ideally people you can point to who got promoted or turned around. This is the core of the job.

 - 3–5 years in quota-carrying sales or business development, preferably in SaaS or tech, with experience as an SDR/BDR or team lead

 - A true player-coach — genuinely willing to ensure SDRs hit their quotas and stay motivated on a high-activity, in-person floor

 - Fluency in Salesforce, and the ability to coach on real calls in Gong

 - Excited by AI and what it means for government — and forward-leaning on using AI and tooling to make your team more efficient

 - Self-motivated and competitive, with the ability to set the energy on the floor and inspire a team

 - Bachelor's degree is a plus

 - GovTech or public-sector SaaS background is a plus — but not expected
   
   


COMPENSATION:

Chicago, IL: $110,000 - $125,000



On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Environmental and Solid Waste Project Manager
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend Heery is seeking an experienced Environmental and Solid Waste Project Manager to provide project management and program support for the Charles County Department of Public Works on a diverse portfolio of environmental, solid waste, water resources, civil infrastructure, and related capital improvement projects.

The Project Manager will support projects throughout the project life cycle, from planning and feasibility through design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout. The position will work closely with County staff, engineering consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are effectively coordinated and delivered in accordance with established scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing environmental or solid waste infrastructure projects and be comfortable working in both office and field environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage multiple environmental, solid waste, civil infrastructure, and related capital projects concurrently.
• Provide project management and owner's representative services throughout planning, design, permitting, procurement, construction, and closeout.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor project schedules, budgets, scopes, action-item logs, risk registers, and project documentation.
• Coordinate with County departments, consulting engineers, contractors, regulatory agencies, utility providers, and other stakeholders.
• Review and coordinate engineering designs, technical reports, specifications, cost estimates, schedules, permitting documents, and other project deliverables.
• Monitor project progress and identify potential impacts to scope, schedule, cost, quality, and regulatory compliance.
• Identify project risks, issues, constraints, and opportunities and coordinate appropriate mitigation or resolution strategies.
• Support permitting and regulatory compliance activities associated with environmental and infrastructure projects.
• Assist with procurement, bidding, contract administration, and contractor selection activities.
• Monitor consultant and contractor performance and coordinate resolution of project issues.
• Track project expenditures, commitments, forecasts, change orders, and overall budget performance.
• Prepare project status reports, presentations, meeting agendas and minutes, correspondence, dashboards, and other management-level documentation.
• Facilitate project meetings and maintain clear and timely communication among project stakeholders.
• Coordinate project activities across multiple County departments and maintain continuity as projects transition between planning, design, procurement, construction, and closeout.
• Assist with project commissioning, startup, closeout, record documentation, warranties, and lessons learned.
• Provide technical and management support for emerging projects and initiatives as assigned by the County.
• Perform other project management duties as assigned.

Areas of Project Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

• Solid waste management and infrastructure.
• Landfill development, expansion, closure, and remediation.
• Recycling and materials recovery facilities.
• Citizen disposal facilities.
• Composting and organics management facilities.
• Environmental remediation and restoration.
• Dams, flood-control infrastructure, and water resources.
• Dredging and sediment management.
• Stormwater and drainage infrastructure.
• Water and wastewater infrastructure.
• Environmental permitting and regulatory compliance.
• Public works and municipal capital improvement programs.
• Other environmental or infrastructure-related capital projects.

• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Science, or a related field.
• Minimum 7 years of relevant project management experience, preferably involving environmental, solid waste, civil infrastructure, public works, or construction projects.
• Demonstrated experience managing projects through multiple phases, including planning, design, permitting, procurement, construction, and closeout.
• Experience coordinating engineering consultants, contractors, government agencies, and other project stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and change management.
• Ability to review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical reports, cost estimates, schedules, and other project documentation.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Experience with Microsoft Project or other project scheduling software is preferred.
• Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively within a multidisciplinary project team.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional certification or license such as PE, PMP, CCM, or similar.
• Experience with municipal, County, State, or other public-sector capital improvement programs.
• Experience with environmental permitting and regulatory agencies, particularly in Maryland.
• Experience with landfill, solid waste, recycling, environmental, or water resources projects.
• Construction management or owner's representative experience.
• Experience managing projects involving multiple consultants and contractors.
• Familiarity with public procurement, construction contracts, change management, and payment processes.
• Experience with project controls, cost estimating, scheduling, and risk management.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, organized, and collaborative project manager who can effectively coordinate technical, environmental, construction, regulatory, and administrative requirements.

The successful candidate will be comfortable communicating with engineers, environmental professionals, contractors, regulatory agencies, County leadership, and field personnel. The individual should be able to identify issues early, coordinate solutions, maintain project momentum, and provide clear and concise information to County stakeholders and senior management.

jobs.title: Engineer
jobs.description:
This is a U.S. based position. All of the programs we support require U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment. All work must be conducted within the continental U.S.

Who we are:

Raft (https://TeamRaft.com) is a customer-obsessed non-traditional defense tech company dedicated to empowering U.S. military and government agencies with cutting-edge AI/ML and data solutions. We are a leader in autonomous data fusion and Agentic AI, with a purposeful focus on Distributed Data Systems, Platforms at Scale, and Complex Application Development. With headquarters in McLean, VA, our range of clients includes innovative federal and public agencies leveraging design thinking, cutting-edge tech stack, and cloud-native ecosystem. We build digital solutions that impact the lives of millions of Americans.

About the role:

Raft builds mission-critical data, AI, and operational platforms that support time-sensitive decisions across multiple classification levels and deployment environments. Our systems move from cloud-hosted development environments into classified, on-premises, and edge deployments where reliability, security, and repeatability matter.

As an DevOps Engineer, you will help secure, deploy, and operate the platforms behind [R]DP, [R]AP, [R]AIMS, and Raft’s MLOps workflows. This is not a narrow infrastructure role. You will learn how the software works, how data moves through the platform, how Kubernetes workloads behave in production, and how security controls become part of everyday delivery rather than an after-the-fact checklist.

What makes this role different is the breadth of what you’ll be exposed to. CI/CD, GitOps, Kubernetes, Helm charts, observability, secure configuration, data pipelines, ML serving, and customer deployments all show up in the same workstream. You will work alongside experienced platform, software, data, and security engineers while taking ownership of well-scoped work. The right person is curious, disciplined, willing to troubleshoot deeply, and ready to grow into broader platform ownership over time.

What You’ll Do

• Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based platform infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers

• Build and maintain CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitLab CI, Argo CD, Flux, Helm, and repository-managed deployment configuration

• Support secure software delivery practices including container hardening, vulnerability scanning, image provenance checks, secrets hygiene, and policy-driven deployment gates

• Help operate cloud, on-premises, and disconnected deployments across AWS, Azure, data center, and tactical environments

• Deploy and debug services, Helm charts, service mesh configuration, Kubernetes networking, storage, and runtime behavior

• Support observability across Prometheus, Grafana, Fluent Bit, Loki, Kibana, OpenTelemetry, or similar tooling so issues can be detected and resolved quickly

• Work with software and data engineers to understand service dependencies, data flows, and operational failure modes

• Support data and MLOps workloads that may include Kafka, Flink, Pinot, KServe, Kubeflow, Ray, GPU-enabled workloads, and model-serving workflows

• Write maintainable automation and small tools in Go, Java, Python, Bash, or similar languages to reduce manual effort and improve repeatability

• Contribute to compliance-driven delivery practices aligned with RMF, STIGs, NIST 800-53, IL4/IL5/IL6, and customer-specific security requirements

• Document operational procedures, deployment notes, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned in a way other engineers can reuse

What we are looking for:

• 5 years of hands-on experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity engineering, or a closely related role

• Working familiarity with Linux, containers, Docker, and Kubernetes concepts, including pods, services, deployments, config maps, secrets, ingress, and basic troubleshooting

• Experience building, running, or supporting CI/CD pipelines; exposure to GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Flux, or similar tools

• Exposure to Infrastructure as Code or configuration management with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, or similar tooling

• Understanding of foundational security practices such as least privilege, vulnerability management, container image scanning, secrets handling, secure configuration, and auditability

• Ability to read application logs, inspect runtime configuration, use command-line tooling, and follow evidence to root cause

• Basic scripting or programming ability in Go, Java, Python, Bash, or a comparable language

• Interest in data platforms, streaming systems, MLOps, and operational AI/ML workloads; prior exposure to Kafka, Flink, KServe, Kubeflow, or Ray is a plus

• Strong written communication and willingness to document work clearly for teammates, customers, and future operators

• Active Secret clearance required; must be eligible for and willing to obtain a Top Secret/SCI clearance

• Ability to obtain Security+ certification within the first 90 days of employment

• Ability to travel up to 30%

Highly preferred:

• Hands-on experience deploying applications with Helm or Kustomize in a Kubernetes environment

• Exposure to GitOps workflows and continuous delivery across multiple environments

• Familiarity with AWS or Azure fundamentals including IAM, networking, storage, compute, and managed Kubernetes services

• Exposure to service mesh technologies such as Istio, including mTLS, traffic routing, and observability concepts

• Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks used in government delivery, including RMF, STIGs, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and IL4/IL5/IL6 controls

• Experience supporting air-gapped, disconnected, classified, or resource-constrained deployments

• Exposure to SBOMs, SCA, SAST, DAST, container scanning, admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Sigstore, or similar supply chain security tooling

• Existing TS/SCI clearance strongly preferred

What Success Looks Like

• You reliably execute assigned deployment, automation, observability, and security tasks with clear communication and good follow-through

• You can explain what changed, why it changed, how it was verified, and what risk remains

• You grow quickly from following runbooks to improving them, then to owning small platform improvements end to end

• Senior engineers trust you with well-defined operational work because you investigate carefully and escalate the right issues early

• Security and compliance practices show up in your daily work: pipelines, manifests, secrets, images, documentation, and operational handoffs are kept clean

Clearance Requirements:

• No active clearance required to start required; TS eligibility required

Salary Range: $140,000.00 - $180,000.00

Work Type:

• Hybrid in Colorado Springs, with up to 30% travel

What we will offer you:

• Highly competitive salary

• Fully covered healthcare, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) and company match

• Take as you need PTO + 11 paid holidays

• Education & training benefits

• Generous Referral Bonuses

• And More!

Our Vision Statement:

We bridge the gap between humans and data through radical transparency and our obsession with the mission.

Our Customer Obsession:

We will approach every deliverable like it's a product. We will adopt a customer-obsessed mentality. As we grow, and our footprint becomes larger, teams and employees will treat each other not only as teammates but customers. We must live the customer-obsessed mindset, always. This will help us scale and it will translate to the interactions that our Rafters have with their clients and other product teams that they integrate with. Our culture will enable our success and set us apart from other companies.

How do we get there?

Public-sector modernization is critical for us to live in a better world. We, at Raft, want to innovate and solve complex problems. And, if we are successful, our generation and the ones that follow us will live in a delightful, efficient, and accessible world where out-of-box thinking, and collaboration is a norm.

Raft’s core philosophy is Ubuntu: I Am, Because We are. We support our “nadi” by elevating the other Rafters. We work as a hyper collaborative team where each team member brings a unique perspective, adding value that did not exist before. People make Raft special. We celebrate each other and our cognitive and cultural diversity. We are devoted to our practice of innovation and collaboration.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Virtual Specialized Education Instructor - Arizona (Mod/Severe)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supporting children with learning differences? Parallel is seeking experienced Special Education Teachers to provide virtual instruction to K-12 students in Arizona. We are hiring educators with experience in self-contained classrooms with an Arizona Moderate/Severe Disabilities, PreK-12 Endorsement.

What You'll Do

• Deliver Expertise: Provide legally compliant, specially designed instruction (SDI) and deliver compensatory education services (when indicated) to students with active Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).

• Instructional Design & Implementation: Develop and execute data-driven, individualized lesson plans to target critical skill areas:

• Reading and literacy development

• Foundational math skills and intervention

• Executive functioning and organizational strategies

• Functional and adaptive life skills

• IEP Management & Compliance: Own the creation, management, and ongoing progress monitoring of student IEPs, including case management responsibilities.

• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Collaborate with the student's IEP team to coordinate service schedules and tailor instructional approaches to unique student needs.

• Assessment & Evaluation: Administer screenings, conduct progress monitoring, and complete formal outcomes assessments to drive instructional decision-making.

What You'll Need

Core Qualifications (Required Qualifications)

• Active Arizona educator license/certification with Moderate/Severe Disabilities, PreK-12 Endorsement.

• School-based experience providing specially designed instruction and working effectively with diverse student populations.

• Exceptional collaborative communication skills for engaging with IEP teams, including teachers, parents, and students.

• Proficiency in conducting virtual services using meeting platforms and a strong command of instructional technology.

Remote Setup & Availability

• Dedicated, private workspace with a secure, high-speed internet connection, reliable computer, and webcam.

• Availability during traditional school hours (8:00am - 4:00pm) and days (Monday-Friday).

• Commitment to a minimum availability of 15 hours per week.

Why Join Parallel?

At Parallel, We Simplify Your Work So You Can Focus On What Matters Most—delivering Quality Care. We Provide Comprehensive Support, Including

• Thoughtful Student & District Matching: Alignment with your experience, licensure, and expertise to match you with appropriate districts, schools, and student needs.

• Efficient Tools and Support: Access to templates, tools, and streamlined systems designed to reduce administrative paperwork and maintain organization.

• Billing & Operational Support: Systems that manage billing and documentation workflows, allowing you to prioritize student support and collaboration.

• Clinical Resources: Utilization of standardized assessments, progress monitoring tools, and therapy resources to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Innovation & Feedback: Opportunities for your input to directly shape the future of our programs.

• Clinical Community: Connection with peers through dedicated office hours, provider meetings, and free continuing education opportunities offered throughout the school year.

• A Powerful Mission: The chance to significantly improve the lives of students nationwide.

Compensation

The rates below apply to 1099 opportunities and are based on the provider’s primary service delivery state.

• CA, NY, WA: Starts at $44/hour

• CO, IL, MA, ME, OR: Starts at $38/hour

• AL, AR, AZ, GA, IN, KS, KY, MI, MO, MS, NC, OH, OK, PA, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV: Starts at $36/hour

Join us in making a lasting impact—apply today to become part of the Parallel Provider Network!

👋 About Parallel

Parallel is the first tech-forward provider of care for learning and thinking differences across the United States. We believe learning differences are parallel ways of thinking that should be celebrated. Our mission is to provide students with the resources and encouragement to succeed in the classroom and beyond by helping them build confidence in their unique strengths and create strategies to work around their challenges.

Parallel simplifies the process of getting support for learning differences by consolidating providers and resources on a single platform. We connect students with qualified professionals while significantly reducing waiting times, costs, and confusion.

Our core services include:

• Psychological Assessment

• Counseling

• Speech-Language Services

• Special Education

• And more

Learn more at parallellearning.com.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Parallel, we believe in celebrating differences. This belief extends from schools into our workplace and through the ways we work together toward our mission. We are committed to fostering a diverse, accessible environment that represents many different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints, and abilities by championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We are committed to building and fostering a diverse workforce, including individuals from historically marginalized groups, and creating a workplace where employees’ strengths are championed, differences are celebrated, and no one is discriminated against based on age, race, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where different learners and thinkers can thrive.
