jobs.title: Information Systems Security Officer
jobs.description:
This is a U.S. based position. All of the programs we support require U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment. All work must be conducted within the continental U.S.

Who we are:

Raft (https://TeamRaft.com) is a customer-obsessed non-traditional defense tech company dedicated to empowering U.S. military and government agencies with cutting-edge AI/ML and data solutions. We are a leader in autonomous data fusion and Agentic AI, with a purposeful focus on Distributed Data Systems, Platforms at Scale, and Complex Application Development. With headquarters in McLean, VA, our range of clients includes innovative federal and public agencies leveraging design thinking, cutting-edge tech stack, and cloud-native ecosystem. We build digital solutions that impact the lives of millions of Americans.

About the role:

As an Information Systems Security Officer and Manager, you will manage security and compliance activities supporting Raft's cloud-native products and customer environments. You will work closely with engineering and program teams to apply the Risk Management Framework, maintain accurate authorization documentation, assess security risk, and support IATT and ATO efforts across systems at different stages of authorization.

This role requires strong working knowledge of RMF and NIST guidance and experience applying security controls in Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and other cloud-native environments.

What you will do

• Provide ISSO oversight across Raft's product contracts, applying consistent RMF practices while accounting for each customer's system boundary and authorization requirements.

• Develop and maintain mature RMF authorization packages, including System Security Plans, security control traceability matrices, Ports Protocols and Services Management artifacts, architecture and data-flow diagrams, POA&Ms, and bodies of evidence.

• Translate system architectures and operational processes into accurate control implementation statements, policies, procedures, and supporting evidence aligned with applicable security control baselines.

• Coordinate control owners, engineers, system administrators, and program stakeholders to collect evidence, address gaps, prepare for assessments, and maintain authorization readiness across supported environments.

• Partner with engineering teams to make evidence collection and recurring compliance reporting more automated, repeatable, reusable across systems, and traceable to authoritative sources.

• Conduct ongoing security risk assessments using findings from cloud and Kubernetes posture reviews, vulnerability and CVE analysis, DISA STIG scans, network monitoring, software-supply-chain reviews, configuration-drift detection, and endpoint protection tools.

• Manage POA&Ms from identification through validated closure, including risk prioritization, owners, milestones, due dates, remediation evidence, and status reporting.

• Evaluate proposed architecture, configuration, boundary, and deployment changes for security-control and authorization impact.

• Conduct continuous monitoring, configuration reviews, control assessments, and readiness reviews; embed security requirements early and help technical teams select practical mitigations.

What we are looking for:

• At least four years of experience in ISSO, ISSM, cybersecurity compliance, information assurance, or a closely related role.

• Strong understanding of the Risk Management Framework and applicable NIST guidance, including NIST SP 800-37, NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, and NIST SP 800-60.

• Demonstrated experience applying RMF and NIST security controls in cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and containerized workloads.

• Experience developing and maintaining RMF artifacts such as SSPs, control implementation statements, traceability matrices, PPSM packages, POA&Ms, risk assessments, assessment plans and reports, vulnerability results, and supporting evidence.

• Experience with continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, DISA STIG compliance, security assessments, and remediation tracking in federal or DoD environments.

• Ability to organize and prioritize security activities, evidence, risks, and authorization milestones across multiple systems and customer environments.

• Ability to understand technical architectures and findings, connect them to security controls and mission risk, and communicate clearly with engineers, program leaders, and security stakeholders.

• Security+ or another qualifying DoD 8140 or contract-required certification at hire, or the ability to obtain it within six months of employment with Raft.

Highly preferred:

• Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information assurance, information technology, or a related field.

• CISSP, CISM, CISA, CGRC, or another relevant advanced cybersecurity certification.

• Experience with eMASS or a similar governance, risk, and compliance tool.

• Experience supporting or completing an IATT or ATO process.

• Experience securing Kubernetes-based DevSecOps platforms or software factories, particularly within Platform One or a comparable DoD environment.

• Experience implementing or assessing FIPS requirements.

• Experience writing and reviewing RMF control implementation statements, security policies, and procedures.

• Experience communicating security risk and authorization status to program or executive leadership.

Clearance Requirements:

• Active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance.

Salary Range: $150,000.00 - $190,000.00

Work Type:

• The selected candidate will work onsite in Honolulu, Hawaii; Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts; Tampa, Florida; Colorado Springs, CO; or the National Capital Region. The position may require up to 35 percent travel to CONUS and OCONUS locations. Candidates must possess a valid, active U.S. passport with at least six months of validity beyond the intended travel period.

What we will offer you:

• Highly competitive salary

• Fully covered healthcare, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) and company match

• Take as you need PTO + 11 paid holidays

• Education & training benefits

• Generous Referral Bonuses

• And More!

Our Vision Statement:

We bridge the gap between humans and data through radical transparency and our obsession with the mission.

Our Customer Obsession:

We will approach every deliverable like it's a product. We will adopt a customer-obsessed mentality. As we grow, and our footprint becomes larger, teams and employees will treat each other not only as teammates but customers. We must live the customer-obsessed mindset, always. This will help us scale and it will translate to the interactions that our Rafters have with their clients and other product teams that they integrate with. Our culture will enable our success and set us apart from other companies.

How do we get there?

Public-sector modernization is critical for us to live in a better world. We, at Raft, want to innovate and solve complex problems. And, if we are successful, our generation and the ones that follow us will live in a delightful, efficient, and accessible world where out-of-box thinking, and collaboration is a norm.

Raft’s core philosophy is Ubuntu: I Am, Because We are. We support our “nadi” by elevating the other Rafters. We work as a hyper collaborative team where each team member brings a unique perspective, adding value that did not exist before. People make Raft special. We celebrate each other and our cognitive and cultural diversity. We are devoted to our practice of innovation and collaboration.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Our Interview Process

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

 - Meaningful equity program

 - Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

 - Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

 - Paid parental leave

 - Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites 



At Socket, we

 1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

 3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

jobs.title: Maintenance Planner
jobs.description:
💰 $35–$40/hour, paid weekly

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 6:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Location: Rock Island, IL

📋 What you'll do

• Turn requests into ready-to-go work orders. Review maintenance requests in D365 daily, convert valid ones the same day, or close them out with a clear reason.
• Prepare every job before it's scheduled. Assets, instructions, labor hours, parts, tools, safety requirements (lockout, permits, confined space), and downtime needs.
• Get the right parts there first. Identify parts by item number, raise purchase requests early, follow up with procurement and the storeroom, and have parts staged before work begins.
• Build and run the weekly schedule. Prioritize ready work against available labor, lead the weekly scheduling meeting with maintenance and production, and assign labor with the maintenance supervisor.
• Keep work moving. Track jobs in progress, clear roadblocks, and spend time on the floor capturing photos, nameplate data, and lessons learned.
• Close the loop. Make sure completed work orders include notes, labor hours, parts used, and downtime, and that follow-up work gets raised.
• Build the system. Create job plans, checklists, and PM plans in D365, keep asset records accurate, and maintain equipment documentation and floor plans.
• Plan the big events. Scope and plan annual shutdowns months ahead, and prepare the site for contractor work.
• Track what matters. Report on schedule compliance, PM compliance, planned vs. reactive work, backlog, and MTBF/MTTR.
• Support the network. Help other Techo-Bloc sites remotely and join a monthly planner network to share standards.

📌 Good to know

• You'll report to the Corporate Maintenance Planning & Systems Manager, with a strong dotted line to the site Maintenance Manager.
• This is a planning role. You won't supervise technicians or perform repairs yourself.
• Occasional after-hours support may be needed for urgent situations.

✅ What you bring

• Experience in maintenance planning, maintenance coordination, or as a maintenance technician in manufacturing
• Solid mechanical and electrical knowledge, enough to understand a job, estimate it, and identify the parts it needs
• Experience with a CMMS or ERP system (work orders, PM plans, parts, purchase requests)
• Strong organization and follow-through when juggling many jobs at once
• Clear communication with technicians, supervisors, production, storeroom, and procurement
• Comfort on the plant floor: reading nameplates, taking measurements, documenting equipment
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel
• Valid driver's license with a good driving record

⭐ Bonus points for

• Microsoft D365 Asset Management or Microsoft AX experience
• Knowledge of PM and reliability practices (criticality, PM intervals, MTBF/MTTR)
• Shutdown or major maintenance event planning
• Scoping and coordinating contractor work
• Forklift and industrial equipment operation
• Staying calm and organized when breakdowns disrupt the plan

Why Work at Techo-Bloc?

We offer stable, long-term careers with strong benefits, growth opportunities, and a team-first culture. Our perks include:

• Weekly Pay
• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
• Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
• Life Insurance
• 401(k) with Employer Match
• Paid Time Off
• Employee Discount on Products
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Uniforms provided after 3 months
• Boot Reimbursement Program
• Training & Development Opportunities

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must transport and move items up to 75 pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to remain stationary and/or move throughout the facility and yard. The employee is frequently required to communicate with leaders, peers and vendors. The employee is frequently required to operate a computer. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms talk or hear and smell. The employee is required to ascend and descend steps and ladders, climb ladders, work on elevated equipment platforms and position self in tight spaces.

Other duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT UTOPIA

UTOPIA is a venture studio (Utopia Studio) and fund manager platform (Utopia Capital) headquartered in Doha, operating across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The platform combines early-stage venture funds with an in-house studio that builds companies directly, supported by a proprietary technology infrastructure that shortens the time from idea to build. A team of 30 runs capital deployment, company-building and infrastructure together, giving the platform direct access to markets, data and operating relationships across three regions.

UTOPIA is anchored by sovereign wealth and Qatar's leading development institutions, and is invested in alongside family offices, high-net-worth investors and foundations. The platform is regulated by the Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority (QFCRA), and its investor base sets the standard for the financial rigour, compliance and operational discipline it runs to. UTOPIA builds and backs early-stage ventures led by domain experts, with capital efficiency and disciplined execution central to how it operates.


THE ROLE

The Legal & Compliance Manager keeps the platform's regulatory, compliance and legal obligations current and on time across both Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. The Manager owns the compliance calendar, prepares and coordinates filings, keeps registers and records accurate, and puts the policies and frameworks set by leadership into day-to-day practice. Regulatory strategy and controlled-function accountability sit with the COO and CEO. The MLRO and Compliance Officer functions are held externally through a service provider, and this role works alongside them to make sure the platform meets its obligations on time.

Reports to: COO.

Direct reports: None.

Works closely with: COO, CFO and finance, People & Operations, the outsourced MLRO / Compliance Officer, external counsel and company secretary, and the Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital teams.

Location: Doha, Qatar (full-time, with some remote allowances during the summers)

Compensation: circa US$50,000 per annum.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

There are four areas of ownership: regulatory filings, compliance operations, legal administration, and governance records. Together they keep the platform's obligations met on time across both entities.

Regulatory filings & reporting

 - Own the platform's regulatory filing calendar across both entities: track every QFCRA (and other applicable) deadline, and support the Compliance Officer with preparing submissions and accurate and on-time filings.

 - Coordinate periodic regulatory returns and maintain a clear record of what has been filed, when, and what is next due, so status is visible at any moment across all group entities

 - Own the compliance and filing cycle for the fund vehicles (Cayman & QFC)

 - Own the reporting calendar to our investors and LPs: track deliverables and milestones, prepare and coordinate the periodic reports, and make sure every submission is complete, accurate and on time.

Compliance operations

 - Run day-to-day compliance monitoring against existing policies, and act as the internal point of contact for the outsourced MLRO and Compliance Officer, gathering information, completing first-line checks and following actions through to closure.

 - Execute onboarding and KYC due diligence, screening, and the upkeep of conflicts, gifts and entertainment registers.

 - Prepare (when needed) compliance reporting packs for the COO and board, and support supervisory engagement and audits by assembling documentation and tracking remediation actions to closure.

 - Coordinate the fund-level AML and economic substance obligations in Cayman with the outsourced administrator and appointed officers, keeping the platform's records aligned with what is filed offshore.

Legal & contract administration

 - Draft, review and process standard-form agreements (NDAs, vendor, engagement and service agreements) and manage the contract lifecycle from request to execution to storage.

 - Maintain the contract register and central legal repository so every agreement is filed, findable and current.

 - Coordinate with external legal counsel on matters beyond standard scope, managing instructions, turnaround and documentation.

 - Own corporate housekeeping across the platform's entities, ensuring that registrations, renewals, licences and statutory records are completed on time.

Governance & records

 - Keep the platform's policies, registers and corporate records organised, version-controlled and up to date.

 - Maintain accurate entity and shareholding records across the Group and keep the corporate register current.

 - Ensure documentation is retained and organised to the standard the platform's regulator and investor base expect.


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–6 years in a compliance, regulatory reporting or filings function, ideally within a regulated financial services, fund management or professional services environment.

 - A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as accounting, finance, business or economics.

 - A law degree or specialist compliance certification is not mandatory, though a legal or compliance background is advantageous. What matters most is the years you have spent working hands-on inside a compliance or reporting function.

 - Practical familiarity with regulatory filing and compliance processes; direct QFCRA, DFSA, FSRA or comparable exposure is a strong advantage.

 - Meticulous and deadline-driven, taking pride in nothing being late, nothing being missed, and every record being accurate.

 - Highly organised and self-directed, comfortable owning a calendar of recurring obligations and chasing the inputs you need from others.

 - Practical and execution-minded, more focused on getting the filing done correctly

 - GCC experience preferred; familiarity with Qatar's institutional and regulatory landscape is an advantage.

 - Temperament: reliable, discreet, calm under deadline pressure, and comfortable holding colleagues to account to get documentation in on time.


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Real ownership of the platform's day-to-day regulatory and compliance execution across both a fund manager and a venture studio.

 - A clearly defined, hands-on role reporting directly to the COO, focused on day-to-day execution while strategy and accountability sit above you.

 - Institutional context: sovereign-grade anchor partners, a QFCRA-regulated environment, and an investor base that sets a high operational standard.

 - A platform at the point where it scales, giving you the chance to build reliable, repeatable compliance operations for both entities.





We believe innovation should be inclusive and globally distributed. Our team is built on openness, curiosity, and collaboration — with people from across the GCC, Africa, and Southeast Asia working together to build meaningful ventures.



All roles are based in Doha, Qatar, with flexible hybrid options and global travel opportunities (unless otherwise stated). We welcome talent from every background to join us in shaping the future of AI-native innovation.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRELLIUM

Brellium's mission is a big one – to improve the standard of care across the US healthcare system. We’ve built AI-powered technology that helps healthcare providers deliver safer, higher-quality care - starting with the first real-time medical review platform built to fix clinical and compliance risks before they impact patients.

Each year, 1 in 20 people in the U.S. experiences a medical diagnostic or compliance-related mistake. Most providers lack the time, staffing, and tools to mitigate these issues - so they go unnoticed, impacting care quality and increasing clinical and financial risk.

Brellium is building the AI-powered platform that helps providers deliver safer, more consistent care by mitigating risk early and aligning patient visits with clinical best practices. Our goal is to give every provider in the U.S. the tools to deliver clinically excellent, data-driven care - at scale.

Brellium was founded in 2021. Since then, we’ve grown to serve over 250,000 providers across all 50 states who use Brellium to take better care of their patients and ensure data-driven, compliant care. We’re a Series A company with over $30MM in funding from First Round Capital, Left Lane Capital, and Menlo Ventures.



About the Role
We're building the compliance infrastructure that modern healthcare runs on — and we need a Enterprise Healthcare Account Executive who wants to be at the center of it. This role owns the full sales cycle, shaping how clinics discover and adopt Brellium, and turning first conversations into long-term partnerships. With a largely untapped TAM and a product that genuinely solves one of healthcare's most painful problems, this isn't a role where you're pushing a product people don't need. With real demand and a category-defining product, the opportunity is there to run toward. If you thrive in high-growth environments, love collaborating with a team that wins and learns together, and want your fingerprints on how a company grows — this is the role.

What You'll Do at Brellium

 - Work a full sales pipeline: follow up on inbound leads from clinics who've already raised their hand, and proactively prospecting into new accounts and finding creative ways into the right organizations

 - Run discovery calls with CEOs and COOs of Enterprise clinic groups, getting beneath surface-level interest to uncover the compliance and documentation pain that's actually costing them time and money

 - Move deals through a 6–8 week cycle with purpose, keep momentum alive between conversations, advancing stakeholders, and ensuring nothing stalls because of a slow follow-up

 - Deliver sharp, tailored product demos that connect Brellium's capabilities directly to what a specific operator is trying to solve (their workflows, compliance pressure points, and documentation challenges) and goes beyond a generic walkthrough to foster a real conversation about the business

 - Build and maintain a clean pipeline in CRM, forecast accurately week over week, and flag risks early so problems get solved before deals slip

 - Close new business and hand off new partners with enough context that the relationship starts strong from day one

 - Bring field intelligence back to the team, including the objections, priorities, and language coming from CEOs and COOs should shape how Brellium sells and what it builds



What We're Looking For

 - 7+ years of relevant sales experience

 - Ability to translate a technical product's value into business terms for clinical directors and C-suite operators who aren't technical buyers

 - Skilled at running structured discovery — diagnosing pain, qualifying budget and authority, and mapping a decision process in a single conversation

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and able to build a talk track or outbound approach when there's no existing playbook for a new vertical or persona

 - Genuinely responsive to coaching — feedback gets applied within the week, not the quarter

 - Ability to travel occasionally (1–2× per quarter)

Bonus Points

 - Prior experience selling into healthcare, behavioral health, or compliance-adjacent buyers

 - Startup experience at the Series A–B stage, especially helping build or refine the sales motion rather than just inheriting one

 - Experience selling to multi-location or multi-site organizations with complex buying committees

 - Familiarity with insurance reimbursement, clinical documentation, or audit and compliance workflows

Compensation: $270,000 - $340,000

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health benefits, commuter benefits, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.




BENEFITS OFFERED INCLUDE:

 - 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

 - Equity Compensation

 - Dinner Provided via DoorDash & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage coverage of up to 100% premiums for you and your family

 - HSA / FSA

 - 11 paid holidays each year

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Training and professional development

 - Hybrid Work Schedule (4 days onsite, 3 if located > 1 hour away)




WHAT IT MEANS TO BE "ONE OF US"



Bias to Action: Brellium teammates do not wait to make reversible decisions or seek unnecessary approval. We quickly decide and move forward. If the decision was incorrect, we quickly reverse it and move forward.



Thinks for themselves: Brellium teammates do not take things at face value. We ask "why" until base truth is reached. If a better solution is present, Brellium teammates use it, regardless of status quo.



Negative Maintenance: The opposite of high maintenance isn’t low maintenance - it’s negative maintenance. Brellium teammates are poised under pressure, self-motivated, self-improving, self-disciplined, self-aware, and non-defensive.



Expect Excellence: We hold ourselves to exceptionally high and continuously rising standards. We strive for thoughtfulness in our decision making, and for speed and quality in our execution. We acknowledge trade-offs and communicate proactively.



Communicate with Clarity: Brellium teammates communicate concisely, directly, and purposefully. We optimize for ensuring our points are easily understood the first time.



We are aware of fraudulent job offers claiming to be from Brellium. All legitimate communication comes from brellium.com http://brellium.com, or no-reply@ashbyhq.com http://ashbyhq.com, and we will never ask for money or sensitive personal information as part of our hiring process. If there are any questions please direct them to peter@brellium.com http://brellium.com

jobs.title: Industrial Vision & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Within the Engineering Quality team, you will own industrial vision inspection across our production lines, from roadmap and qualification to integration on automated and manual stations. As production ramps up, you will turn today's manual controls into robust inline inspections, working hand in hand with the Industrialization & Automation, Quality and Production teams. With hardware already on site, this is a greenfield role: you will write the standard rather than inherit one, and see your programs running on a defense production line within weeks. This is a full time position based in Orly, with opportunities to grow within the organization.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and own the industrial vision roadmap across our production lines, and defend the associated investments.

 - Audit existing cameras and programs, then establish a measured baseline of escape and false reject rates.

 - Develop and deploy vision programs on real parts, tuning optics, lighting, thresholds and Edge Learning tools.

 - Integrate vision on automated stations with the automation team, including triggering, PLC/IO handshake and robot guidance.

 - Deploy standalone camera programs on manual stations, along with the scripting and small tooling around them.

 - Define and run the qualification framework (IQ/OQ/PQ) and trace every inspection into the control plan.

 - Maintain a versioned and backed up program library, with clear documentation for every deployed inspection.

 - Review rejected images daily with production, separating real defects from false rejects and unblocking stations.

 - Partner with R&D on design for inspectability, and with Manufacturing Systems Engineering and IT on data and network handling.


CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

 - Educational Background: Engineering degree or equivalent, with a strong academic record.

 - Vision Experience: 2+ years of practical industrial vision experience in a production environment, such as automotive, electronics, aerospace, medtech or a vision integrator.

 - Technical Skills: Proficiency with at least one industrial vision platform or library, scripting skills and enough automation exposure to work with a PLC or a robot.

 - Validation Rigor: Manages false rejects and escapes with data, knows that optics and lighting drive the result, and is curious about assembly (PCBA, solder joints, connectors).

 - Roadmap Ownership: Able to build a plan and a standard from scratch in a greenfield environment, and to defend an investment case.

 - Shop Floor Pragmatism: Designs for operators and shift reality, favors robust over elegant solutions, works autonomously and embraces a “no task is too small” mentality.

 - Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English, capable of working with diverse principals, from operators on the line to senior leadership.

 - Eligibility: Security clearance may be required for this role.

 - Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.



We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Forecast Analyst
jobs.description:
The Forecast Analyst builds and maintains time series forecasting models, owns forecast accuracy, and translates demand insights into inventory and safety stock decisions. Working with Demand planning, Supply Chain, and customers, the role combines statistical modeling, SAP and Power BI analytics, and AI tools such as Claude to deliver reliable forecasts, protect fill rates, and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

Forecast Modeling

• Develop, test, and deploy time series forecasting models (e.g., Holt-Winter’s, ARIMA, Croston, and machine learning approaches) to predict demand at SKU, customer, and distribution center levels.
• Research and prototype new forecasting methods, including demand segmentation and model-routing frameworks that match each SKU's demand pattern to the best-fit model.
• Perform feature engineering and incorporate external drivers such as promotions, seasonality, POS trends, and new product introductions into forecast models.
• Validate model performance through back testing and holdout analysis before production rollout.

Forecast Accuracy & Performance Management

• Own and monitor forecast accuracy KPIs, including MAPE, WMAPE, bias, and forecast value add (FVA), and report on them regularly.
• Conduct root cause analysis on forecast misses, backorders, and fill rate gaps, and implement corrective actions.
• Maintain forecast hygiene by cleansing demand history, handling outliers, and adjusting for supply-constrained periods.
• Continuously improve forecasting processes and reduce manual overrides through better statistical baselines.

Operations & Supply Chain Collaboration

• Work closely with Operations and Supply Chain teams to translate demand forecasts into inventory, replenishment, and safety stock requirements.
• Support S&OP by preparing demand plans, highlighting risks and opportunities, and driving consensus across functions.
• Build and maintain safety stock models that account for demand variability, lead time variability, and target service levels.
• Analyze lead time variability, inventory positions, and service levels to support fill rate and inventory targets.

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

• Collaborate with key customer accounts to review POS data, order trends, and forecast alignment, and recommend forecast changes.
• Communicate forecast assumptions, changes, and risks clearly to Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.
• Gather market intelligence from Sales and Marketing to enrich forecasts with qualitative inputs.

Data, Tools & Reporting

• Extract and manage demand and inventory data from ERP systems (SAP) and build automated reporting and dashboards in Power BI and Excel.
• Build repeatable analytical workflows that reduce manual effort and improve data reliability.
• Document forecasting methodologies, model logic, and processes for transparency and knowledge sharing.

AI & Automation

• Use AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis, code development, data exploration, and documentation.
• Write effective prompts to generate forecasting scripts, summarize account trends, draft stakeholder communications, and validate analytical logic.
• Identify opportunities to integrate AI into forecasting and reporting workflows to improve speed and consistency, while reviewing all outputs for accuracy.

Required Knowledge & Skills

• Time series forecasting methods, including statistical, and machine learning models.
• Safety stock and inventory planning concepts, including service level targets, demand and lead time variability, reorder points, and fill rate drivers.
• Forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE, WMAPE, bias, FVA) and root cause analysis techniques.
• S&OP processes and cross-functional demand planning.
• SAP ERP, Power BI, and advanced Excel; Python or R for modeling is a plus.
• Working knowledge of AI assistants such as Claude and prompt engineering for analytics and business communication.
• Strong communication and presentation skills for customer-facing and executive audiences.

Education/Experience

• Undergraduate degree in supply chain, engineering, statistics, Analytics or a related field.
• 1-2 years of supply chain planning experience in forecasting, S&OP, demand, and supply planning.

The posted salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,0000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Front Desk Associate, internally known as a Member Support Specialist, you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $21.50 per hour based on a full time schedule.

Physical Demands:  Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

jobs.title: Director - Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Freshworks is looking for a senior demand generation leader to help build and modernize our scaled demand engine across our product portfolio.

This role is for a hands-on operator and builder. You will own the day-to-day demand generation engine across channels, work closely with Revenue Marketing leadership on strategy and prioritization, and help rethink how demand generation should operate in an AI-forward company.

We are not looking for someone to simply run the traditional demand gen playbook faster. We want someone who can question what is working, identify what is not, build better systems, and use AI and automation to fundamentally improve how we generate, qualify, nurture, and convert demand.

You will partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and regional marketing teams to create an integrated demand engine that drives measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and execute the scaled demand generation roadmap across our product portfolio, balancing pipeline goals, audience priorities, channel performance, and budget.
• Build and optimize always-on demand programs across SEM, SEO, AI search/GEO, content syndication, webinars, conversational marketing, lifecycle, nurture, and emerging channels.
• Build AI-native and agentic workflows into the demand engine, including audience identification, campaign orchestration, lead qualification, personalization, optimization, and reporting.
• Own performance across key demand generation metrics including MQCs/MQLs, SAOs, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, pipeline velocity, CAC, CPL, and channel efficiency.
• Manage and continuously optimize multi-million-dollar budgets across channels and campaigns based on incremental pipeline impact and ROI.
• Partner with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, qualification, routing, SLAs, and handoff processes to improve conversion from demand through pipeline.
• Partner with Product Marketing to ensure campaigns, messaging, and audience strategies are coordinated across product lines rather than fragmented.
• Build a rigorous testing and experimentation culture, with clear hypotheses, measurement frameworks, and decisions on where to scale, optimize, or stop investment.
• Lead and develop a high-performing demand generation team while remaining close enough to the work to diagnose problems and drive execution.
• Evaluate and help evolve the demand generation martech stack, including marketing automation, intent data, conversational marketing, AI tools, and orchestration platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

In this role, success means building a demand engine that is:

• Predictable in generating qualified pipeline
• Efficient in how budget is deployed
• Stronger at converting demand into sales opportunities
• Integrated across products, regions, and channels
• Increasingly automated and AI-native
• Measured on business outcomes, not activity volume

The Profile We Are Looking For

• You are equally comfortable looking at a pipeline dashboard, challenging a channel strategy, designing a new operating system, and getting into the details with the team.
• You are not overly attached to legacy marketing playbooks. You care about what actually creates an incremental pipeline and are willing to stop programs that no longer perform.
• Most importantly, you are a builder. You see demand generation as a system to continuously redesign and improve, not simply a collection of campaigns to run.

• 10+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in enterprise SaaS.
• Significant experience owning scaled demand generation programs and measurable pipeline targets.
• Experience managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets and making channel allocation decisions based on performance and ROI.
• Strong understanding of demand generation economics, including CPL, CAC, conversion rates, pipeline coverage, velocity, and incremental return.
• Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-enabled or agentic workflows within a marketing or demand generation environment.
• Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
• Experience with intent and account intelligence platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase and conversational marketing platforms such as Qualified or Drift.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to independently diagnose performance issues using data.
• Strong partnership skills across Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Analytics, and executive stakeholders.
• Experience leading and developing demand generation teams.

Preferred:

• Experience in a scaled, sales-led enterprise SaaS company with a multi-product portfolio.
• Experience operating in both enterprise and SMB/mid-market motions.
• Experience at an AI-native company or building AI-native marketing systems.
• A strong point of view on AI search, GEO, and how buyer discovery is changing.
• Experience with ITSM, customer support, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software categories.

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.

The annual base salary range for this position is $225,000 - $280,000 Base Salary.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

• This position is for Mail Services Specialist 2 on the 12-hr fixed front day shift (7:00am - 7:00pm) (Schedule: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and every other Wednesday)

• Operate machines that automatically addresses, weighs, and ties into bundles printed publications, such as magazines, catalogs, and pamphlets, for mailing according to zip code

jobs.title: Account Executive, B2B
jobs.description:

As an Account Executive at Flywire, you’ll play a key role in growing our B2B vertical by converting high-quality inbound leads into successful client partnerships. You’ll represent one of the most exciting fintech platforms in the market, helping organizations solve critical AR and payment challenges with our innovative solution.

Our FlyMates are creative problem solvers focused on execution and building trusted, value-driven relationships with clients. Success in this role is defined not just by revenue generated, but by client satisfaction, product adoption, and long-term success.

• Convert inbound leads into qualified opportunities and close deals by understanding client pain points and demonstrating the value of Flywire’s AR automation and payments solution.
• Engage prospects in discovery calls, product demos, and consultative sales discussions.
• Build and maintain strong relationships throughout the sales lifecycle—from first touch through onboarding and handoff.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Operations, Solutions Engineering) to deliver a seamless client experience.

• Identify trends in client feedback to influence new product features and improvements.
• Support broader sales and marketing initiatives, including lead nurturing and campaign follow-up.

Here's What We're Looking For:

• At least 1-2 years experience in a full cycle Sales role

Submit today and get started!

jobs.title: Senior Security Client Solution Architect - California (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You’re a strategic security leader who connects business risk, regulatory needs and technology into cohesive multi-domain security solutions. You’re comfortable leading executive-level discoveries and influencing decisions by translating complex security concepts into clear actionable guidance. You naturally think across domains and spot opportunities to integrate identity, cloud, endpoint and data security into unified architectures. You work independently, partner closely with sales and technical teams and enjoy mentoring others to elevate consultative security practices across the organization.

About The Role

The Senior Security CSA plays a critical role in shaping and delivering multi-domain security strategies for complex client environments. This role goes beyond technical architecture to influence deal strategy, guide security investment decisions and ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements, risk tolerance and long-term business goals.

You will lead security discovery efforts, design integrated architectures across multiple security domains, and collaborate closely with Account Executives and practice leaders to qualify opportunities and position comprehensive security solutions. As a senior member of the organization, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, an escalation point for complex designs and a mentor to CSAs and engineers.

This role is ideal for a security professional who enjoys owning strategy, driving cross-domain conversations and helping both clients and internal teams operate at a higher level of security maturity.

Must be based in the United States and reside in California. Travel up to 40% may be required.

Other responsibilities include:

• Conduct executive-level security discovery with an emphasis on risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and enhancement of operational maturity

• Manage security solution strategies utilizing the entire Security stack

• Proactively recognize opportunities for cross-domain expansion (e.g., Identity, Perimeter, End Point, Data, Application, Email, Cloud, AI -Security, Zero Trust, Observability etc.)

• Design integrated security architectures covering endpoint, network, cloud, and identity domains

• Collaborate with Account Executives to develop opportunity strategies, assess qualifications, and refine positioning

• Review and validate security designs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and Statements of Work (SOWs) alongside practice leaders

• Serve as the escalation point for intricate or high-risk security designs

• Mentor CSAs and engineers in consultative approaches to security discovery and architecture

• Contribute to the development of reference architectures, playbooks, and go-to-market security solutions

• Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section

• Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts

• Other duties as assigned

Desired skills and experience:

• 7–10 years of experience in security architecture or consulting

• Proven track record in selling and delivering multi-domain security solutions

• Comprehensive understanding of Zero Trust principles and NIST security frameworks

• Capable of leading complex client discussions and influencing strategic decisions

• Extensive technical expertise across at least three security domains

• Exceptional executive-level communication skills

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

• We Before Me: We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.

• Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.

• Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

Some of Our Benefits

• Incentive compensation plans for all employees

• Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500

jobs.title: Partner Manager MSP - Norden (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Vi söker en MSP Partner Manager som blir vår första medarbetare på plats i Norden och som får i uppdrag att bygga upp vår säljnärvaro i regionen.

I rollen ansvarar du för att etablera Eyes nordiska nätverk av MSP-partners (Managed Service Providers). Du identifierar, kontrakterar och aktiverar nya partners samtidigt som du vårdar och utvecklar starka, långsiktiga relationer. Med ett starkt entreprenöriellt driv representerar du Eye på den nordiska marknaden och samarbetar tätt med kollegor inom sälj och marknad.

Vad du kommer att göra:

 - Bygga upp och expandera Eyes ekosystem av MSP-partners i Norden.

 - Identifiera och onboarda nya partners samt bygga långsiktiga, förtroendefulla relationer.

 - Stötta partners genom hela processen – från första dialog till avtal, onboarding och affärsplanering.

 - Driva gemensamma go-to-market-initiativ med partners för att säkerställa tillväxt för båda parter.

 - Representera Eye vid partnermöten, mässor och branschevent.

 - Samarbeta med kollegor inom sälj, marketing och andra interna team.

Din profil och bakgrund:

 - Erfarenhet av att bygga och utveckla partnerskap – antingen genom direktarbete med MSP:er, uppbyggnad av partnerekosystem eller genom nykundsförsäljning inom SaaS eller mjukvara.

 - Starkt affärssinne och en proaktiv, driven säljmentalitet.

 - Bakgrund inom SaaS-försäljning. Kunskap inom cybersäkerhet är starkt meriterande.

 - Stark förmåga att bygga relationer och kommunicera effektivt.

 - Goda kunskaper i svenska eller danska samt engelska.

 - Flexibilitet och en beredskap att resa regelbundet (runt 30%) inom Norden.

Vad vi erbjuder

 - Möjligheten att bli en del av ett av Europas snabbast växande scale-ups inom cybersäkerhet.

 - En nyckelroll i att bygga upp ett innovativt produktutbud, där vi kombinerar effektiv cybersäkerhet med cyberförsäkring på global nivå.

 - Kontinuerlig utveckling i takt med branschen – som ett snabbväxande scale-up erbjuder vi en miljö där din professionella utveckling drivs framåt av vår dynamiska verksamhet och de komplexa utmaningar vi löser.

 - Ett flexibelt arbetssätt som passar vår utspridda organisation runt om i Europa.

 - Ett attraktivt kompensationspaket och bonusstruktur.

 - Milersättning/bilförmån samt extra valfria helgdagar (floating holidays) för mer ledig tid.

 - Valfri hårdvara: MacBook eller Windows-dator samt iPhone eller Samsung som tjänstetelefon.

 - Stort stöd för din personliga och professionella utveckling.

 - Regelbundna företagsträffar och årlig offsite.



Om Eye Security

Eye Security levererar cybersäkerhetslösningar med integrerad cyberförsäkring till organisationer runt om i Europa. Vi har vårt huvudkontor i Nederländerna, har redan passerat 170 heltidsanställda (FTEs) och fortsätter att växa internationellt.

Vi kombinerar spetsteknologi med praktisk erfarenhet och djup expertis för att upptäcka, hantera och avvärja cyberhot i realtid. I vårt team ingår talanger med bakgrund från underrättelsetjänsten, militären, techsektorn och konsultbranschen – alla med samma mål: att göra cybersäkerhet i världsklass tillgänglig för alla företag, inte bara de stora aktörerna!

Hos oss på Eye får du arbeta med projekt som har ett internationellt avtryck, lösa komplexa problem i verkligheten och bidra till att skapa en tryggare digital framtid för våra kunder.

Inspire is the first of its kind medical device designed to make a difference in the lives of those living with Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). jobs.title: Senior Recruiter, Generalist
jobs.description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees. 

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number. 

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $20B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.




THE ROLE



We're building the operating system for CPG brands—covering demand planning, finance, accounting, and sales in one platform. We just raised a $55M Series B, and we're adding new modules and products that mean every team—Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Design, Data Science, Engineering—is expanding. We plan to double the company next year. Hiring is a core lever for us right now.

We're looking for a Senior Generalist Recruiter to own searches across the entire company. Q4 is in a good spot, but hiring ramps significantly in Q1 and won't slow down after that. This role exists so that no team waits on recruiting capacity.

You'll own searches end-to-end—sourcing, running, and closing—and you'll need to move between an ML Engineer, an Enterprise AE, and a Brand Marketer in the same week without missing a beat.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting across GTM, BizOps, Marketing, Product, Design, and technical roles—wherever the business needs you most that month/quarter

 - Pivot quickly between functions, getting up to speed on what great looks like for each role and calibrating fast with hiring managers

 - Partner directly with dedicated hiring managers to align on scope, calibrate candidates, and drive fast, confident decisions

 - Run searches on established processes—most roles already have interview plans, rubrics, and templates fully built in Ashby for you to copy, adapt, and make your own

 - Drive outbound sourcing with a high bar for quality. Finding profiles is the easy part now; writing outreach that's genuinely personal and legitimate is what gets responses. We care about the difference

 - Partner with our dedicated sourcer on high-priority roles to build pipeline quickly without cutting corners

 - Keep searches moving, hold stakeholders accountable, and close candidates
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in high-growth B2B SaaS

 - Genuine range: you've recruited across technical and non-technical functions and can speak credibly to both an engineering manager and a sales leader

 - Proven ability to operate as a senior IC

 - Strong outbound sourcing and messaging skills—your outreach reads like it was written by a person who did their homework, not an AI-generated token

 - Comfortable managing a high req load across multiple functions without letting quality or candidate experience slip

 - Sharp judgment on candidate signal across different profiles—you know what separates strong candidates from strong interviewers in more than one function

 - Excited by volume and variety rather than worn down by it




WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND ISN'T)

jobs.title: Client Success Principal
jobs.description:
Job Summary: 
The Client Success Principal role is a customer success professional responsible for achieving Retention, Upsell and NPS targets for their portfolio of customers in addition to other objectives and key results. This individual contributor plays a critical role in cultivating client relationships and serves as a trusted advisor to them. They understand and advance client strategy that aligns to Included Health's services and solutions. They are an expert in Included Health offerings, reselling value and deepening our partnerships with them. They provide strategic thought leadership and business insights that showcase member outcomes and progress towards client ROI.
Responsibilities:
Portfolio Management: You will manage a portfolio of complex clients reselling the value of IH services and solutions while seeking opportunities to deepen the partnership through upsell and expansion.
Client Goals & Strategy: You will develop a deep understanding of client strategy, partnering with clients to develop measurable goals and define desired business outcomes for their relationship with IH.
Retention & Upsell Plan: You will establish and maintain a Retention and Upsell Plan for each assigned client. And, you will engage internal partners to intentionally drive client health including member utilization and client ROI to meet client expectations and deliver on contractual commitments. 
Member Engagement, Utilization & Marketing: You will consult with clients encouraging alignment to IH Marketing Best Practices. You will partner with the IH Marketing team to define and execute a holistic member engagement strategy aligned to contractual commitments.
Upsell & Expand: You will resell the value of IH services, products and solutions, identifying and promoting upsell opportunities while seeking opportunities to expand and deepen the relationship.
Business Reviews: You will deliver recurrent business reviews demonstrating progress towards and achievement of shared success measures including member engagement, utilization, clinical impact, PGs and ROI while demonstrating a strategic command of the client's experience and linking results to the client's desired business outcomes and goals.
Relationship: You will conduct recurrent Partnership Connect meetings with daily client contacts galvanizing the partnership and creating a trusted advisor bond. You will cultivate professional relationships and trusted advisor status with client executives and consultants. You will collaborate with vendors in the client's benefits ecosystem to optimize the member experience and the client investment.
Client Onboarding: You will understand client contractual commits and ensure client expectations are well managed and effectively aligned to contract. You will serve as the internal IH client advocate and represent Client Success in Implementation activities.
Renewal Management: You will negotiate price increases at renewal, actively seeking opportunities to expand IH services and offerings while ensuring the renewal is completed with most-current IH contract terms.
Escalation Management: You will mitigate churn risk and engage cross-functional IH business partners to advance client strategy while serving as the client's advocate within IH.
CS Operations & Other Tasks: You will maintain CS and CRM Platforms in keeping with CS leadership expectations / CS Strategies. You will document all client interactions and follow-up in appropriate IH systems and to clients via email to achieve client commitments and document expectations.
CS Mentorship & Initiatives: You will serve as a mentor to CS colleagues helping them onboard and become more proficient. You will participate in special projects to improve effectiveness of CS, and client and member experience as needed.
Qualifications:
7+ years client success experience serving mid to large enterprise clients.
Corporate experience working at a navigator, digital health point solution, carrier, consultant, population health management firm, or related.
Deep understanding of the employer benefit landscape, key stakeholders and decision makers.
Executive level communication ability that showcases a compelling value proposition, delivers insights, and manages difficult conversations.
Ability to work internally across functions to achieve client contractual commitments and results.
Proven ability analyzing and interpreting data - deriving insights that support value delivery for clients
Solution focused, curious, lifelong learner, optimistic problem solver.
Travel up to 25%.
 
The base salary range for this full-time position is $127,660.00 - $167,112.00 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C). 
For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher-cost Zone D markets (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Bonus 
Equity
Remote-first culture

Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)

jobs.title: PC Depot Technician
jobs.description:
Join DYOPATH as a PC Depot Technician

Are you energized by hands-on technical work and the satisfaction of keeping technology secure, functional, and ready to support business operations?

DYOPATH is seeking a skilled PC Depot Technician who enjoys building, imaging, configuring, troubleshooting, and deploying computer systems in a fast-paced environment. This role is ideal for someone with experience in desktop support, hardware deployment, workstation configuration, asset management, computer imaging, and end-user technology support who takes pride in delivering reliable IT services.

Why You'll Love Working Here

• Purpose with Passion – Be part of a company where Living Our Values Every Day (L.O.V.E.) drives meaningful work and trusted client partnerships.

• Grow & Thrive – DYOPATH invests in your development through training, certifications, skill-building, and defined career pathways.

• Award-Winning Culture – Work in an environment known for service excellence and strong teamwork.

• Fun & Respectful Teamwork – You'll collaborate with colleagues who celebrate wins, support each other, and work toward shared goals.

Benefits

DYOPATH offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and growth, including:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Life insurance

• 401(k) plan with company match

• "You Pick a Day" paid holiday

• FSA & HSA options

• Pet insurance

• Additional voluntary benefits

• Full benefits overview available at dyopath.com/careers

Role Overview

• Location: On-site (Oakbrook Terrace, IL)

• Schedule: 1st Shift (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST), Monday through Friday

• Pay Rate: $20.00 per hour

Your Mission as a PC Depot Technician

As a PC Depot Technician, you will play a critical role in computer deployment, workstation imaging, hardware configuration, asset lifecycle management, and technical support operations. Working within our depot environment, you will ensure laptops, desktop computers, peripherals, and related hardware are properly configured, documented, maintained, and ready for deployment.

You will collaborate with IT support teams, asset managers, and end users to deliver high-quality technology solutions while maintaining inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and security standards.

Core Responsibilities

• Build, image, configure, deploy, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, and peripheral devices.

• Configure computer workstations and peripheral equipment including printers, routers, monitors, and related hardware.

• Inspect computer hardware, components, and accessories to ensure proper functionality and performance.

• Install, configure, validate, and troubleshoot operating systems, drivers, software applications, and enterprise tools.

• Perform hardware diagnostics, repair, part replacement, and troubleshooting for workstation equipment.

• Maintain local networks and connectivity to support reliable performance and uptime.

• Ensure security and privacy standards are maintained across systems, devices, and network configurations.

• Provide user orientation and technical guidance on new equipment, software, and workplace technology.

• Coordinate upgrades, deployments, refresh cycles, and maintenance schedules to minimize user disruption.

• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, and peripheral issues.

• Support asset lifecycle management including receiving, deployment, refresh, inventory tracking, and retirement of equipment.

• Maintain accurate inventory records, deployment logs, asset documentation, and maintenance plans.

• Identify equipment shortages, replacement needs, and initiate ordering requests.

• Assist with workstation refresh projects, endpoint deployments, and technology rollout initiatives.

• Support desktop support and IT support operations by ensuring devices are deployment-ready and fully functional.

Additional Responsibilities

• Manage shipping and receiving activities for depot computer equipment.

• Handle physical and logical hardware inventory using Helix, Teams, and other depot management tools.

• Create, update, and maintain Depot Knowledge Base Articles (KBAs), technical documentation, and process guides.

• Maintain accurate hardware inventory records and support equipment lifecycle tracking.

What You Bring to the Team

Education & Experience

Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma and 2–3 years of experience in desktop support, PC system support, computer deployment, depot operations, hardware support, or equivalent technical training.

Preferred

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Licenses & Certifications

Preferred

• CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified IT Professional (MCITP), or related IT certifications.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

The ideal PC Depot Technician will bring hands-on experience supporting desktop hardware, workstation deployments, asset management, computer imaging, and end-user technology support within a depot, service desk, or technical support environment.

• Proven experience as a PC Depot Technician, IT Technician, Desktop Support Technician, Hardware Technician, Deployment Technician, or similar technical role.

• Experience imaging, configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Windows-based workstations and laptops.

• Strong knowledge of computer systems, desktop hardware, peripherals, operating systems, and networking fundamentals.

• Experience supporting hardware inventory management, asset tracking, and equipment lifecycle processes.

• Strong diagnostic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication, customer service, and end-user support abilities.

• Outstanding organizational, documentation, and time-management skills.

• Knowledge of internet security, data privacy, endpoint security, and technology deployment best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, asset managers, logistics personnel, and end users.

• Experience working with ticketing systems, technical documentation, and knowledge management processes.

• Depot imaging, workstation deployment, hardware staging, or computer deployment experience is highly desirable.

Why This Role Matters

As a PC Depot Technician, you will ensure employees have reliable, secure, and well-configured technology needed to do their best work. From workstation imaging and hardware deployment to inventory management and technical troubleshooting, your contributions directly impact productivity, operational efficiency, and the delivery of exceptional IT services.

You'll serve as a trusted technical resource, problem solver, and critical part of delivering high-quality desktop support, end-user support, and technology deployment services that keep our clients and teams productive every day.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of the employee assigned to this job.
