jobs.title: Account Executive, SMB
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

SMB Account Executives have a critical role and responsibility to deliver new client acquisition in zero-base accounts, while also ensuring successful relationships and revenue growth with existing customers.

We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals. Our Account Executives have a significant total contract value (TCV) opportunity with uncapped commission!

Your Mission

The Account Executive (AE) is responsible for consistently generating, qualifying, and executing opportunities that solve complex problems to support our customers within a targeted geographic territory in the pursuit of becoming more trusted organizations.

• Uncover net new business opportunities and successfully take through the sales cycle to closure.
• Will be responsible for sourcing and qualifying sales opportunities, setting proper customer expectations, handling negotiations and accurately forecasting to management.
• Utilize two-sided discovery to build relationships, understand the customers’ needs and articulate valuable solutions to ensure OneTrust is viewed as a trusted advisor.
• Understand key competitors and their strategies to clearly differentiate OneTrust’s solutions in the marketplace.
• Identify and leverage contributors, leaders, and champions to drive execution of the sales strategy .

jobs.title: Payer Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

As Payer Partnerships Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy and execution of Nourish’s partnerships with leading health plans. You will be responsible for owning the strategy and business development process end to end with the country’s top payers, designing and closing value-based deals and fostering close relationships with health plan executives. Your work will shape the future of Nourish as you designing innovative partnerships that expand access for nutrition therapy and deepen our impact on patients.

This role is full-time and open to NYC-based candidates only (expectation to work in-person 3-4 days per week, with some remote flexibility). Our office is in the heart of Flatiron. Occasional travel expected (e.g. to conferences, priority payer meetings, etc.)

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage a revenue generating book of top health plans - be the single point owner for 5-10 health plan relationships, defining the strategy and partnership playbook for each plan and executing against that strategy to help us expand access, increase rates, and build strategic, long-lasting relationships

• Design and drive our health plan strategy – define our partnership strategy and lead end-to-end relationships with top health plans. Shape engagement approaches, structure game-changing deals, and be the face of Nourish to your health plan partners

• Build trusted executive networks – develop deep, strategic partnerships with payer leaders. Create champions who will advocate for Nourish internally, unlocking influence and momentum across complex organizations

• Design & close transformative deals – craft and negotiate innovative agreements, including value-based care models. Push beyond status quo contracting to secure deals that expand access and align with Nourish’s long-term growth vision.

• Tell a powerful story – adapt and deliver Nourish’s value proposition compellingly to VP and C-suite audiences, tailoring every conversation to resonate with each payer’s unique priorities and challenges.

• Bring the ‘voice of the payer’ to our team – share and translate commercial, real-time insights to inform our product, clinical, and growth strategy. Partner cross-functionally to translate payer feedback into bold strategic moves, including new products.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have 3-5 years of experience in highly strategic roles (e.g. management consulting, business operations) — extra points if you have commercial/go-to-market experience or healthcare/payer knowledge, but not a must

• You’re energized by 0→1 work and ambiguity, and enjoy stepping into undefined spaces to build structure, momentum, and clarity where none exists.

• You’re a strategic thinker who values speed and learning, comfortable testing ideas, iterating based on signal, and evolving your approach over time.

• You have a strong commercial mindset and executive presence, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and influence VP- and C-suite stakeholders.

• You have experience building strong client relationships — whether in consulting, strategy, partnerships, GTM, or a high-growth startup environment — and are comfortable representing a company externally.

• You’re operationally excellent, able to manage a high volume of moving pieces and competing priorities with strong attention to detail, while still maintaining momentum and clarity in a fast-paced environment.

• You’re highly collaborative and cross-functional, able to work effectively across partnerships, growth, product, clinical, and operations teams to drive impact.

jobs.title: Staff Package Design Engineer
jobs.description:
In this role, you will work at the intersection of IC design, advanced package development, and system-level implementation. You will play a critical role in designing and delivering next-generation, high-performance semiconductor package solutions, including power modules, chiplet-based architectures, FCBGA, SiP, WLCSP, wire-bonded, QFP, and QFN packages supporting automotive SoCs, industrial IoT microcontrollers, and AI-enabled embedded computing platforms. This role requires strong technical depth in package layout execution, manufacturability, assembly process constraints, and cross-domain co-design with global silicon design, signal integrity/power integrity, thermal, reliability, and product engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute package layout design and development for advanced package technologies, including power modules, FCBGA, SiP, WLCSP, and multi-chip modules.
• Develop and maintain package CAD databases, ensuring accuracy and adherence to package design guidelines, DFM, and DFA requirements to support manufacturability, yield, and long-term reliability.
• Manage the package design cycle, including schematic creation, netlist import, footprint assignment, layout implementation, verification, and generation of manufacturing release outputs such as Gerber/drill data, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, bump maps, and related documentation.
• Create and modify substrate and RDL layouts, bump maps, escape routing, stack-up structures, and power/ground distribution features.
• Collaborate with SI/PI, thermal, reliability, DFT, silicon design, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to support package-level co-optimization and participate in design reviews.
• Ensure package designs comply with applicable foundry, OSAT, substrate vendor, and manufacturing design rules, including DRC, LVS, connectivity, and netlist verification requirements.
• Support Engineering Change Order cycles, design updates, revision control, and release documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• 4+ years of hands-on experience in package CAD layout, substrate design, or advanced package development; 6+ years preferred.
• Strong background in power module packaging, FCBGA, SiP, WLCSP, advanced substrate-based packages, and multi-die/chiplet-based package architectures.
• High proficiency with industry-standard package design tools such as Cadence Allegro Package Designer / SiP Layout, Siemens Xpedition Substrate Integrator, or equivalent CAD platforms.
• Proven experience applying advanced package design rules, substrate vendor constraints, OSAT assembly requirements, DFM/DFA principles, and manufacturing release standards.
• Experience interfacing directly with Tier-1 OSATs, substrate suppliers, foundries, silicon design teams, and product engineering teams.
• Working understanding of SI/PI fundamentals, high-speed routing, impedance control, power/ground distribution, and crosstalk mitigation.
• Strong communication, presentation, and technical documentation skills, with demonstrated experience working effectively in global, cross-functional engineering environments.

Education

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

jobs.title: Principal Consultant - Product Management
jobs.description:
Are you energized by shaping products that solve meaningful customer and business problems? Do you thrive in fast-paced, client-facing environments where you bring clarity to ambiguity, align cross-functional teams, and turn product strategy into practical execution? Does helping organizations make better product decisions and deliver measurable outcomes excite you?

If so, Torq may be the place for you!

We're looking for experienced Product Management leaders to help our clients define, build, launch, and improve digital products that create meaningful business and customer value. From advisory engagements to large-scale digital transformation efforts, our team partners with organizations to shape product strategy, modernize product management practices, and deliver measurable business outcomes. We help clients leverage AI, emerging technologies, and proven product management best practices to build stronger product organizations and accelerate delivery.

In this role, you’ll do more than maintain a roadmap or manage a backlog. You’ll work with business leaders, customers, design, research, data, engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to identify the right problems, evaluate tradeoffs, establish priorities, and deliver products that achieve measurable outcomes.

What You Could Be Doing:

While every project we work on is different, and every role unique, below is a high-level overview of some of the responsibilities/hats you may wear while in our Transform practice:

• Own a digital product, product area, or product workstream based on each client’s needs and maturity.

• Translate business objectives, customer needs, market insights, and technology considerations into product strategies, priorities, and roadmaps.

• Partner with research, design, analytics, engineering, and customer-facing teams to turn discovery insights into product decisions.

• Help clients evolve their product management capabilities by leveraging AI, emerging technologies, and modern product management best practices to improve how teams build and deliver products.

• Define and prioritize capabilities, features, releases, and backlogs based on value, feasibility, risk, and dependencies.

• Create product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and decision documents that move teams from concept to delivery.

• Facilitate planning, prioritization, roadmap, and stakeholder sessions that drive alignment and timely decisions.

• Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs while balancing customer value, business goals, delivery constraints, cost, and risk.

• Define and monitor product metrics tied to adoption, customer value, revenue, retention, efficiency, or quality.

• Support launches, adoption, and post-launch measurement when required by the engagement.

• Present recommendations, progress, risks, and decisions to client stakeholders and senior leaders.

• Contribute to proposals, sales presentations, and other product-focused business development efforts.

What You Bring to the Table:

When you join Torq, you’re a consultant first. That means bringing structure to ambiguity, building trust with clients, and helping teams move from strategy to execution. At the Senior Consultant level, we expect you to do that with greater independence, stronger judgment, and a higher level of ownership.

Core Consulting Strengths

• Ideally 7+ years of experience in product management, consulting, digital delivery, technology transformation, or a similar environment.

• Demonstrated experience owning a product, product area, or substantial product workstream.

• Ability to connect customer problems and business objectives to product vision, strategy, roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes.

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous client environments.

• Proven ability to build relationships across product, business, technology, design, data, operations, and leadership teams.

• Experience defining roadmaps, backlogs, capabilities, features, releases, and supporting product artifacts.

• Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid delivery, or similar product development approaches.

• Ability to partner with discovery teams and turn customer, research, design, and data insights into product decisions.

• A business-minded, technically fluent approach, with familiarity with APIs, integrations, data flows, platforms, cloud environments, and software delivery.

• Ability to balance product outcomes with delivery quality, stakeholder alignment, and team execution.

• High self-awareness, openness to feedback, and accountability for client, product, and team outcomes.

Leadership and Team Impact

At the Principal Consultant level, strong individual delivery is assumed. We’re looking for people who can lead others, raise standards, and make complex work easier for the team and client to navigate.

• Ability to lead consultants and senior consultants through clear direction, thoughtful delegation, feedback, context-setting, and work review.

• Comfortable setting high but realistic standards for quality, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through.

• Ability to stay composed under pressure and help teams remain focused during complex, fast-moving, or high-stakes situations.

• Strong team orientation, including a willingness to coach others, share knowledge, and contribute to a positive team environment.

• Ability to adapt when priorities change, timelines shift, stakeholder expectations evolve, or client needs become more complex.

• Sound judgment when making decisions, escalating issues, resolving conflicts, and balancing client needs, team dynamics, delivery risks, and Torq’s standards.

• Ability to create trust with clients and teammates through reliability, professionalism, candor, and follow-through.

• Ability to model strong consulting behaviors and help others understand what good looks like.

Business Development and Relationship Growth

Principal Consultants at Torq are not expected to be salespeople first. But they are expected to build trusted client relationships, recognize where Torq can add value, and help turn strong delivery into future opportunity.

• Ability to identify client pain points, future needs, new initiatives, renewal opportunities, or areas where Torq can provide additional support.

• Comfortable building relationships with stakeholders beyond the immediate project team, including senior leaders and decision-makers.

• Ability to contribute to proposals, sales conversations, solutioning discussions, client presentations, and account growth strategies.

• Strong client presence, including the ability to build credibility through delivery, communication, judgment, and genuine partnership.

• Ability to share relevant examples, success stories, or lessons learned in a way that helps clients understand potential value.

• Comfortable collaborating with other Torq experts to shape practical, feasible solutions for clients.

• Ability to balance relationship-building with delivery accountability, ensuring clients see Torq as a partner that solves real problems rather than simply fills roles

Bonus Experience

Experience in the following areas is a plus:

• Product tools such as Jira, Confluence, Amazon Kiro, Apptio, Miro, Figma, or PowerPoint.

• Product launches, go-to-market planning, release readiness, adoption, or change management.

• Enterprise platforms, cloud or data products, APIs, integrations, internal tools, mobile, or customer-facing digital experiences.

• Pricing, product positioning, competitive research, portfolio decisions, or regulated environments.

Benefits and Other Fun Stuff:

We ask our consultants to be superstars, so we treat them like it. Even better, our perks are designed for employees by our employees. We do this because we believe in delivering a compelling benefits package that puts you at the heart of our rewards!

• Competitive Salary - your bank account will be smiling

• Unlimited PTO - we’re serious about that work-life balance thing

• Best-in-class health, vision, and dental benefits - your health is our priority

• Generous 401K options - take care of your future with us

• Paid Parental Leave - supporting you during life’s biggest milestones

• Opportunity to be a key player at a highly reputable, fast-growing consulting firm

• High degree of internal mobility and diverse project opportunities

The salary range for this position considers multiple factors influencing compensation decisions, such as skillset, previous experience, certifications, and various business and organizational requirements. Being hired at or near the top of the range for this role is uncommon, as compensation determinations rely on individual circumstances. Currently, the base salary range is estimated to be between $130,000 and $160,000.

Torq is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.

*Note:  No visa sponsorship is available for this position, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.location: Burbank, California, United States; Walnut Creek, California, United States
jobs.description:
Network Optix (Nx) is a global powerhouse in enterprise video software platform development, driven by a mission to empower the creation of intelligent video-based solutions and products capable of converting video into actionable data. Over fifteen years in the making, the Network Optix Enterprise Video Operating System helps innovative organizations rapidly and affordably build world-class, custom-tailored, enterprise-scale video products and solutions.

Nx is headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, with additional locations in Burbank, California, Beaverton, Oregon, Belgrade, Serbia; Hague, Netherlands; Taipei, Taiwan, and regional teams distributed across the globe. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies list for 10 years in a row, we are committed to expanding our teams cross-functionally and globally.

At Network Optix, our corporate vision is to change the way the world interacts with video, shifting the paradigm from passive observation to actionable intelligence. We are pioneering video management as an operating system of the future: an open, intelligent platform that leverages deep data integration and agentic AI to orchestrate real-time analytics and autonomous decision-making. We believe software should be instantly usable, open, lightweight, and extremely powerful. Moving beyond legacy infrastructure, we create open-platform ecosystems where video serves as the foundation for autonomous decision-making and next-generation operational intelligence.

Our Nx culture is built for innovators, builders, and problem solvers who value agility and lean processes and love shipping great technology. We value technical expertise, speed, flexibility, and integrity.

Summary / Purpose of the role

The People Operations Manager owns People Operations end-to-end for a growing, globally distributed technology company (~200 people across 36 countries). This is more than administering HR processes. You will be accountable for the employee experience from onboarding to offboarding, own compliance across our jurisdictions, and champion culture and engagement. You'll also use People Data to spot risks and opportunities before they become issues. This full-time role reports to the Head of Global HR and works as part of a small, collaborative HR team, helping People Operations scale as the company grows globally.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End People Operations

• Own the full employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, records, and HRIS) as one coherent process rather than disconnected tasks

• Develop and continuously improve our new hire orientation program

• Maintain accurate employee records in our HRIS (BambooHR), run regular data audits, and get more out of the system

• Identify and close process gaps before they turn into compliance or employee experience issues

• Serve as the primary escalation point for operational HR questions across all our locations

• Be a trusted partner for employees on HR policies, benefits, and programs

• Help assess our HR systems as we look to consolidate them, and lead the implementation when we move forward

People Analytics & Insights

• Build and maintain recurring people metrics (headcount, turnover, engagement, compliance completion, and more)

• Connect the dots in the data, and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders

• Flag emerging risks such as attrition, compliance gaps, or engagement dips, rather than just reporting history

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure ongoing compliance with labor law across all our operating jurisdictions (US, EU, Serbia, and EOR/contractor markets). Own document management, contract validation, data collection, pre-employment due diligence, and employment eligibility verification.

• Own compliance training programs and completion tracking

• Manage documentation, internal agreements, coordination, and updates for global mobility and visa-related relocations, partnering with internal stakeholders

• Own HR audit readiness for security certifications (e.g., SOC 2)

• Monitor regulatory changes and turn them into policy updates

Culture & Engagement

• Design engagement programs together with HR and leadership, tailored to a globally distributed and diverse workforce

• Partner with stakeholders to run engagement cycles and feedback mechanisms

• Maintain engagement metrics and standards, analyze the data, and share actionable insights with leadership

• Surface issues early and propose solutions, then help turn them into action plans

• Partner with leadership to keep our culture consistent as the company scales across regions

• Champion a global Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategy across our 36 operating countries, driving equitable HR practices, supporting diverse representation, and building inclusive policies that adapt to regional cultural nuances rather than relying on a single-country default

Workplace Experience

• Provide functional and program leadership to the Workplace Experience team (Office Managers, HR Coordinators)

Cross-Functional Partnership

jobs.title: AI Program Director
jobs.description:
Job Title: AI Program Director

Position Summary:
The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research ("the Foundation") is seeking top talent for its AI Program Director role. This position at The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (“the Foundation”) is responsible for defining, advancing, and scaling the Foundation’s enterprise AI strategy. This role will guide the Foundation from experimentation to coordinated, responsible, and measurable adoption of AI, enabling greater organizational effectiveness, accelerating mission impact, and proactively managing risk.

Working in close partnership with organizational leaders and cross-functional teams, this position establishes the strategy, governance, operating model, performance metrics, investment priorities, budget, roadmap, and execution cadence required to embed AI thoughtfully and sustainably across the Foundation.

The role will identify and prioritize high-value use cases, drive adoption and change management, and ensure AI initiatives align with organizational goals, responsible-use principles, and regulatory/ethical expectations. By connecting strategy with execution, this position will help the Foundation build a scalable AI ecosystem that strengthens decision-making, improves staff experience, and expands the organization’s ability to advance its mission.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy, Prioritization & Program Maturity

• Maintain an enterprise-wide view of AI initiatives, pilots, investments, and dependencies across the Foundation

• Partner with organizational leaders to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities aligned with mission, strategic, and operational goals

• Develop and manage a sequenced, enterprise AI roadmap that balances near-term value, organizational readiness, risk, and long-term capability building

• Define program objectives, performance indicators, maturity benchmarks, and reporting mechanisms to measure outcomes and inform investment decisions

• Establish prioritization criteria and resource-allocation recommendations for AI initiatives, platforms, and enabling capabilities

• Manage the AI program budget, track performance against plan, and recommend adjustments based on results and evolving priorities

Incubation, Adoption & Knowledge Sharing

• Design and operationalize a repeatable incubation model that moves opportunities from intake and prototyping through evaluation, scaling, or retirement

• Guide teams in testing, refining, and validating AI solutions before broader implementation

• Build adoption plans that address workflow integration, training, communications, change management, and ongoing support

• Facilitate knowledge-sharing forums and cultivate a cross-functional AI community of practice

• Develop and maintain reusable resources, including prompt libraries, implementation playbooks, evaluation tools, and leading practices

• Capture and share lessons learned to improve future initiatives and accelerate responsible adoption across the Foundation

Program Execution & Technical Enablement

• Lead cross-functional AI initiatives from initial concept and business case through design, launch, measurement, iteration, and enterprise rollout

• Translate business needs into clear requirements, success criteria, review processes, and acceptance standards for AI-enabled workflows and solutions

• Coordinate internal and external partners to ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and against defined outcomes

• Identify technical, data, process, and organizational dependencies that could affect implementation and proactively drive resolution

• Partner with technology and business teams to assess platforms, tools, architectures, and reusable capabilities that support the AI roadmap

Governance, Responsible Use & Risk Management

• Develop, maintain, and operationalize guidelines and standards for AI, including acceptable use, privacy, security, transparency, and ethical safeguards

• Define practical controls and review processes proportionate to the risk and impact of each AI use case

• Monitor evolving regulations, sector practices, technology risks, and ethical considerations, translating them into actionable guidance for a nonprofit research organization

• Coordinate Legal and Cybersecurity, stakeholder reviews of new AI capabilities, vendors, and use cases

• Promote accountability and responsible decision-making by ensuring appropriate human oversight, documentation, and escalation pathways

Qualifications & Skills:

• Proven experience leading technology, digital transformation, data, innovation, or enterprise change initiatives, with increasing responsibility for strategy, execution, and organizational outcomes

• Demonstrated success building and scaling new programs, including defining objectives, success measures, and reporting that demonstrate value and inform investment decisions

• Proven experience developing strategic roadmaps, investment priorities, performance measures, and execution plans for complex, cross-functional initiatives

• Proven ability to lead organizational change, drive adoption, build alignment, and influence senior leaders, technical teams, and business partners

• Working knowledge of AI technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation, and the ability to translate technical capabilities into practical, responsible, and high-value solutions

• Experience designing and operationalizing governance frameworks, decision rights, policies, controls, and risk management practices for technology-enabled programs

• Ability to identify and manage dependencies across data, technology, business processes, workforce readiness, privacy, cybersecurity, legal, and change management

• Strong strategic, analytical, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to connect mission priorities, organizational readiness, data maturity, technology investments, and adoption

• Exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and risk considerations to diverse audiences

• Experience implementing or scaling AI, data, digital transformation, or emerging technology programs in a complex organization is strongly preferred

• Experience in nonprofit, healthcare, biomedical research, philanthropy, or another mission-driven environment is preferred

Compensation & Benefits
Individual compensation for this role is dependent on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, qualifications, skillsets, and applicable laws.  In addition to salary, the Foundation offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• 15+ options for medical insurance (with the Foundation paying 90 percent of the premiums)

• Competitive dental and vision plans

• 401(k) plan with 6 percent employer contribution

• Flexible spending accounts

• Employer paid life and disability insurance

• 18 Vacation Days; 12 Well-Being (Sick) Days; 2 Personal Days; summer Fridays (office closure at 2pm) and a summer holiday week over July 4

• Flexible work environment. We trust all employees to work closely with their manager and colleagues to determine when, where and how programs and projects get done.

Employees are also eligible for a discretionary bonus on an annual basis. The Foundation provides staff and leadership cultivation through regular training courses and events.

Salary Range

$165,000—$185,000 USD

How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit a resume and thoughtful cover letter describing through examples, their specific qualifications and interest in the position. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, please apply. Applicants who best match the position’s needs will be contacted.

About Us:
The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research was founded in 2000 with one clear objective: accelerating meaningful therapeutic advances and, ultimately, a cure for Parkinson’s disease (PD). The Foundation applies extraordinary scientific, business and media assets to this singular focus—thus creating a unique and dynamic organization. Since inception, MJFF has quickly grown into the largest nonprofit funder of Parkinson’s disease research, having funded over $2 billion in research projects in both academic and industry labs worldwide.

Visit www.michaeljfox.org for more information.

Research has shown that people from marginalized communities apply to roles only when they meet 100% of the job requirements. If you think that your skills are transferable and can add value to this role, and you are someone who will contribute to our efforts to build and support a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, we strongly encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant II
jobs.description:
• Executive Assistant to the CEO Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer in making the best use of his time across a global business. Based in New York, you will own his calendar, travel, and day-to-day coordination, working closely with our Workplace team in Brussels and Collibrians across the company. The CEO will be your primary focus. You will also manage scheduling, travel, and expenses for the Chief People Officer and Chief Technology Officer, with the CEO’s needs taking priority when requests overlap. This role suits someone who enjoys the art and science of executive support: understanding priorities, anticipating needs, and getting the details right. You will have significant autonomy to resolve scheduling and logistical issues, with the judgment to know when to involve the CEO. Location and schedule Our CEO splits his time between Brussels and New York, working on a European schedule approximately half the time. This role is based in our New York City Financial District office, with at least four days per week in office and a regular schedule that aligns with his location. All hours below are Eastern Time. When the CEO is in Europe: Monday - Thursday, 6:00 - 9:00 a.m. remote and 10:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. in office. Fridays are fully remote, 6:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. When the CEO is in the US: Monday – Thursday, 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. in office, with Fridays remote, unless needed in office. Supporting a global CEO requires availability beyond these regular hours. You will be expected to monitor and respond to time-sensitive needs in the early mornings, evenings, and on weekends, including changes to travel, scheduling, and other urgent requests. The Executive Assistant to the CEO at Collibra is responsible for Managing the CEO’s calendar across multiple time zones, assessing requests for his time, resolving conflicts, and keeping his schedule aligned with business priorities. Managing the Executive Committee’s (ExCom) meeting cadence, coordinating agendas and advance materials, documenting decisions, and tracking action items and follow-through. Managing the preparation and process for executive strategic planning sessions, including timelines, pre-work, facilitator guides, and draft working materials, and capturing decisions and next steps. Managing coordination and tracking for the Executive Sponsor Program, which connects senior leaders with strategic accounts, partnering with account teams to prepare executives and track commitments and follow-up. Maintaining a central record of CEO customer meetings and other executive customer engagements, including briefing materials, key discussion points, decisions, and follow-up, so teams can build on previous interactions. Planning an preparing the CEO for stakeholder meetings, and media or speaking engagements by gathering and synthesizing input from partners into concise briefings, and maintaining a central record of executive customer engagements, key discussion points, commitments, and follow-up. Building and maintaining reusable AI-powered workflows to support executive preparation, meeting documentation, and follow-up, with appropriate safeguards for confidential information and human review. Arranging domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries, and responding quickly when plans change. Managing expenses and coordinating procurement, vendor, and approval workflows through Navan and Zip, ensuring submissions are accurate and processed on time. Coordinating logistics for leadership meetings, offsites, and executive events, partnering with internal teams. Managing scheduling, travel, and expenses for the Chief People Officer and Chief Technology Officer. Building trusted relationships across the business to gather context, coordinate requests and legal document signatures, and keep administrative work moving. Welcoming visitors and coordinating executive meetings in the New York office. Handling occasional personal requests with discretion and professionalism. You have 8+ years of experience supporting senior executives, including a CEO or other C-suite executive, with experience balancing the needs of multiple executives. Experience managing executive team meeting processes and cross-functional programs, including preparing working materials, documenting decisions, and following up with senior leaders on commitments. Extensive experience managing complex calendars and international travel across multiple time zones. Experience supporting a Europe-based or globally distributed executive is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building repeatable AI workflows beyond one-off prompting. You can structure reusable context and instructions, set up AI projects, and automate recurring work using agents or similar tools. You should be prepared to walk through a specific workflow you built, explain how you tested its reliability, and describe how you handled sensitive information. Excellent judgment and a demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential information, including Board-level materials and sensitive business and people matters. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into clear, concise executive briefing materials. A track record of anticipating needs, resolving competing priorities independently, and following through as circumstances change. Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including preparing executive-level presentations and maintaining spreadsheets. Experience using travel, expense, procurement, and electronic signature platforms such as Navan, Zip, and DocuSign, alongside collaboration tools such as Slack and Zoom. Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes. A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience is required. Experience working in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred. Fluency in Dutch or French is preferred. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. You are Highly organized and dependable, with a keen eye for detail and an understanding of the priorities behind the work. Calm under pressure, able to adapt quickly and make thoughtful decisions as plans change. Proactive and resourceful, comfortable taking ownership, solving problems independently, and knowing when to ask for input. Warm, professional, and respectfully direct, able to build trusted relationships across levels, locations, and time zones. Curious about better ways of working and willing to experiment, while applying sound judgment about accuracy and confidentiality. Comfortable handling both complex coordination and routine administrative tasks with care. Discreet and trustworthy, handling sensitive information and requests with professionalism. Executive Assistant to the CEO Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer. In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the day-to-day logistics that keep our CEO operating efficiently, from complex calendar management and global travel to meeting coordination and administrative support. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and thrives on staying one step ahead. You'll anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and ensure every detail is handled with care. You'll work closely with the CEO and partner with colleagues across the business to make the best use of his time, enabling him to stay focused on leading the company. While your primary responsibility will be supporting the CEO, you'll also provide support to other senior leaders as business needs require. You'll operate as part of the Office of the CEO, partnering daily with the CEO's NYC-based CEO Operations & Events Lead. While you own the CEO's day-to-day logistics of scheduling execution, executive briefings, client meeting tracking, travel, expenses, and Brussels-based coordination, the Office of the CEO owns strategic calendar oversight, and ExCom operations. This partnership ensures seamless coverage across time zones and that our CEO has coverage across our two main offices; Brussels & New York. This is a hybrid role based in our Brussels office. Our hybrid model means you'll work from the office at least four days each week. This role also requires some evening overlap with US East Coast working hours along with occasional early morning meetings across EMEA time zones. Executive Assistants at Collibra are responsible for Providing comprehensive administrative support to the CEO with the highest level of discretion, anticipating needs before they arise and ensuring every meeting is confirmed, prepped, and logistically sound. Monitoring incoming communications and requests for the CEO's time, proactively resolving conflicts and exercising sound judgment to balance competing priorities and keep the CEO focused on what matters most. Coordinating all aspects of domestic and international travel including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries, while managing procurement, vendor, and expense approval workflows via Zip and Navan and reconciling the CEO's expenses — ensuring nothing bottlenecks. Supporting the planning and execution of leadership meetings, offsites, and executive events in close partnership with the NYC-based CEO Operations and Events Lead, staying several steps ahead to ensure seamless coverage across Brussels and New York. Acting as the connective tissue across the business by building strong relationships, facilitating communication, coordinating legal document execution, and gathering EMEA-side context to support client visit briefs. Welcoming visitors and coordinating executive meetings in the Brussels office, while providing administrative support to other senior leaders and handling occasional personal requests with professionalism and care. You have 8–10 years of experience supporting senior executives, including experience supporting a C-suite executive. Extensive experience managing complex calendars, international travel, and executive scheduling across multiple time zones. Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and stay several steps ahead. Strong written and verbal communication skills and a warm, professional, customer-focused approach. Excellent judgment and the ability to handle highly confidential information with complete discretion, including regular exposure to Board-level materials and sensitive company information.. Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and PowerPoint. Experience with modern executive operations tooling; Navan, Zip (or comparable travel and procurement platforms), DocuSign, Slack, and Zoom. Experience leveraging AI to work more efficiently Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes. Experience working in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred. A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. You are Highly organized, proactive, and dependable. Calm under pressure and able to manage multiple competing priorities with confidence. An exceptional planner who enjoys creating order and solving logistical challenges. Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture. Able to anticipate needs and adapt quickly as priorities change. Comfortable working independently while building strong relationships across the organization. Willing to roll up your sleeves—no task is too small. Trusted to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and sound judgment.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. jobs.title: Senior Counsel, Employment
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is seeking a Senior Counsel, Employment to provide practical, strategic legal guidance across the employee lifecycle for a distributed, multi-jurisdictional workforce. Reporting to the AGC, Corporate, this role will advise People, managers, business leaders, and executives on employment matters, manage legal risk, and help build scalable employment policies and processes in a fast-growing technology company.

The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, strong employment-law expertise, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance. This role will shape employment practices, support business growth, and contribute to broader Legal team initiatives.

What You'll Do:

• Advise People, managers, business leaders, and executives on a broad range of employment matters, including hiring, performance management, employee relations, accommodations, leaves, investigations, discipline, compensation, classification, restrictive covenants, and separations.

• Provide guidance on federal, state, provincial, local, international and other applicable employment laws and regulations.

• Draft, review, and update employment-related agreements, policies, procedures, training materials, and communications, with a comprehensive annual review and update cycle.

• Partner with People, Recruiting, and business stakeholders to develop practical, consistent, and legally compliant approaches to workforce and employee-relations matters.

• Manage and oversee employment-related claims, agency charges, audits, investigations, and litigation in partnership with internal and external counsel.

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments and recommend updates to policies, processes, training, and business practices.

• Support workforce programs, organizational changes, and other cross-functional legal projects and strategic business priorities.

• Manage outside counsel effectively and help ensure matters are handled efficiently and with appropriate risk calibration.

What We're Looking For:

• J.D. and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state.

• 10+ years of relevant employment-law experience in a law firm and in-house legal department.

• Deep knowledge of employment law and demonstrated experience advising on employee relations, contingent workers, restrictive covenants, workplace investigations, wage and hour matters, leaves, accommodations, and employment-related disputes.

• Experience supporting a distributed or multi-jurisdictional workforce across multiple U.S. states as well as international jurisdictions, preferably in a technology or high-growth company.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to provide clear, practical, and risk-calibrated advice.

• Brings strong technical drafting skills for preparing employment-related agreements.

• Experience advising on equity incentive plans and equity matters across a distributed workforce.

• Ability to manage complex matters independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external counsel.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, close attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

• A self-motivated individual with a solutions-oriented, low-ego approach and willingness to contribute beyond a narrowly defined specialty.

• AI-first perspective, with interest in building and leveraging AI-driven tools.

• Someone with a great sense of humor and no ego who shares our vision that the legal team can be both a center of excellence and fun at the same time!

jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

WBNS-TV Columbus, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Columbus is searching for an ambitious Digital Content Producer who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content.

Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across all WBNS-TV Columbus website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. They work as part of the larger content team to break news and tell great stories in a 24/7 news environment.

The ideal candidate is an avid news consumer and writes accurate, compelling content with a sense of urgency.

Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. They should also have solid news judgment and experience producing and copy-editing content for digital platforms. Experience with SEO best practices and audience listening are a big plus.

We’re also looking for someone with strong initiative and an inner drive who is ready to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:

• Write and distribute original and accurate breaking news content

• Curate and schedule news content on all station platforms, including website, mobile app, social media and streaming platforms

• Edit reporter stories for grammar, clarity, structure, AP style and optimize the content for digital

• Use creative production or story-packaging techniques, like subheads, hyperlinks, graphics and media (viewer pictures, user-generated content, etc.) to enhance digital stories

• Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner

• Research for facts and credibility

• Monitor news releases and use social listening to find new content, enterprise stories and make community contacts

• Analyze and actively use data and metrics to inform editorial and strategic decisions

• Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or senior digital producers

• Ensure the newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the station brand across platforms

Requirements:

• BA/BS in journalism, communications and/or equivalent experience in the field

• 1-3 years of experience writing breaking news articles or writing news articles in AP style

• Strong communication and organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure and meet deadlines

• Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and rapidly changing coverage

• Strong news and editorial judgment, and an understanding of the tenets of professional journalism

• Strong knowledge of AP style, copy editing and SEO best practices

• Experience with CMS, photo and video-editing systems preferred

• The ability to write in an exciting, captivating and conversational tone is preferred

• Experience creating and managing content on social media platforms, including Instagram, Twitter and Facebook

• An aptitude for creating and packaging engaging, audience-driven content

• Knowledge of how to interpret and use digital analytics is a plus

• Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Canva is a plus

• Ability to work various shifts, including mornings, nights and weekends

jobs.title: Engineer, Whole Vehicle Test Requirements and Validation – Propulsion
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Support whole-vehicle validation definition and execution for propulsion-driven vehicle attributes, including drivability, performance, efficiency, charging, thermal performance, and vehicle capability across real-world customer use cases.

• Contribute to the development of validation strategies for limit operating conditions, including edge and corner cases that drive propulsion system design requirements, such as power delivery, thermal management, durability, energy consumption, and operating strategies.

• Support development of key validation routes, duty cycles, and environmental conditions that represent worst-case and boundary operating scenarios, providing critical input to propulsion system sizing, battery performance, thermal systems, and vehicle operating strategies.

• Provide validated data for real-world vehicle loads, environmental conditions, and customer usage profiles, ensuring engineering teams have accurate physical inputs for propulsion system and vehicle-level design.

• Support cross-functional validation alignment across Propulsion, Chassis, Thermal, Controls, Software, Electrical, Vehicle Integration, and Manufacturing teams to ensure cohesive whole-vehicle performance.

• Develop and execute vehicle-level test cases covering propulsion behavior, drive modes, acceleration, regenerative braking, charging, towing, payload, gradability, off-road capability, and interactions with braking, traction, stability, and ride & handling systems.

• Translate propulsion functional requirements and vehicle capability targets into executable test procedures, instrumentation strategies, and validation plans at the whole-vehicle level.

• Ensure propulsion systems perform seamlessly alongside chassis, thermal, electrical, and software interfaces to validate overall vehicle behavior across on-road, towing, off-road, charging, and extreme environmental conditions.

• Support vehicle-level validation campaigns at proving grounds, public roads, and hot/cold climate locations, evaluating propulsion performance across diverse customer usage profiles and durability routes.

• Translate customer use cases—including daily commuting, towing, payload hauling, off-road recreation, mountain driving, fast charging, and long-distance travel—into validation scenarios with measurable acceptance criteria.

• Evaluate and validate key vehicle-level attributes including drivability, torque delivery, energy efficiency thermal robustness, charging performance, towing capability, off-road performance, and overall propulsion system integration.

• Drive test execution and data collection, including route development, vehicle preparation, instrumentation planning, data acquisition, and environmental conditioning using vehicle CAN, GPS, thermal instrumentation, pressure, force, and specialized data logging systems.

• Ensure robust traceability from system requirements through validation plans, test cases, execution, and results using lifecycle management tools such as Codebeamer, Jama, or Jira.

• Collaborate across Propulsion, Chassis, Controls, Thermal, Electrical, Software, and Vehicle Integration teams to analyze test data, identify performance gaps, perform root-cause investigations, contribute to resolving cross-functional issues.

• Document validation results, benchmark competitive vehicle performance, and provide data-driven recommendations to support vehicle readiness reviews and program milestones.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Novi, Michigan.

jobs.title: Lead VFX Artist
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

What it means on a daily basis

• VFX Team Leadership: Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
• Visual Direction & Quality: Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
• Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
• VFX Pipeline: Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
• Standards & Workflows: Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
• Team Development: Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

What success will look like

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

Who you would be working with

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

Your recruitment journey

• HR Screen Call
• Test
• Second Interview
• Final Interview

Where this role can take you

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
• Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
• Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
• Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
• Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
• Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
• Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
• Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
• Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
• Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
• Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
• Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
• Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

WHO YOU ARE

• You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
• You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
• You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
• You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

• Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
• Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
• Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
• Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
• Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

• Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
• 25 vacation days per year.
• Private medical health insurance.
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
• Free language courses.
• Your birthday off!
• 1 month of remote work.
• Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career development opportunities.
• Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
• ...and Thursday after-work beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

jobs.title: Sr. Finance & Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY:

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Sr. Manager to join our GTM Finance & Strategy team at OpenGov. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role responsible for the financial strategy and business partnership for a critical pillar of our go-to-market organization, with direct influence on decisions that shape OpenGov’s growth trajectory.

 

You’ll own the analytical infrastructure, financial narrative, and strategic advisory relationship for a significant portion of the GTM business, operating with a high degree of autonomy and independent judgment. The right person has already demonstrated the ability to structure ambiguous problems, build conviction-backed points of view, and earn the trust of senior stakeholders - and is ready to expand that scope further. This position is in-office at our San Francisco HQ, reports directly to the Director, GTM Finance & Strategy, and works closely with the CFO and GTM leadership. 

 


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Drive the financial strategy and performance narrative for a key GTM business segment, connecting operational drivers to enterprise-wide financial outcomes

 - Forecast and explain topline performance - bookings, capacity & productivity, retention, pipeline coverage, win rates, and backlog - at the product and segment level, tying those drivers to revenue outcomes

 - Own end-to-end configuration and maintenance of the systematized ARR reporting infrastructure. Collaborate with Commercial Ops to on CPQ data structure, hygiene, and deal guardrails, and with Accounting on GAAP revenue dynamics

 - Own the end-to-end P&L - forecast and manage GTM spend, including headcount, T&E, and complex areas like commissions, drive accountability through budget vs. actual partnership

 - Architect and continuously improve the financial models, reporting infrastructure, and forecasting frameworks that underpin how the business plans and measures itself

 - Lead high-impact strategic projects: long range planning, go-to-market strategy, sales capacity analysis, market analysis, variable compensation design, and other initiatives that shape how OpenGov grows

 - Build deep, trusted partnerships cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, RevOps, Customer Success, and the CFO’s office, and represent Finance & Strategy in cross-functional strategic planning

 


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; MBA a plus

 - 6-10+ years of experience in strategic finance, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth SaaS environment, with demonstrated progression of scope and ownership

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior executives

 - Track record of driving structured, well-reasoned analysis and decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, largely independently

 - Advanced financial modeling skills; you build complex models from first principles and know how to make them scalable

 - Fluency with sales/CPQ data, BI tools (Looker); comfortable working directly in the weeds to diagnose and resolve issues in complex and oftentimes messy data

 - Actively experiments with AI tools to simplify and scale your work - you build workflows, not workarounds, and you think in systems rather than one-offs

 - Established experience partnering directly with and influencing senior/executive business leaders

 - Low ego, high output - you care about the work, not the credit



Compensation:

San Francisco, CA: $180,000 - $200,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.description:
At PEARCE, we've got a career for you!

Pearce is a leading technology-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce-services.com.

Your Impact

Pearce is seeking an Entry Level Traveling HVAC Technician - Preventative Maintenance to join our team for performing preventative maintenance (PM's) servicing on commercial HVAC package units on cell phone tower sites. This is a fast-paced and rewarding job that is best suited for individuals who are responsible, self-directed, highly motivated, willing to travel, and looking to learn and grow in the Telecom industry. This is a 100% travel position. Travel out of state is required.

Core Responsibilities

• Perform all work in a safe manner in accordance with OSHA, company and industry standards.

• Work independently with minimal supervision in an efficient process.

• Conduct performance checks and regular preventative maintenance.

• Timely and accurate completion of daily work reports.

• Drive to remote work sites.

• Minimum of 30 preventative maintenances (PM's) to be completed weekly.

• Maintain a company vehicle according to company policies, which will include maintaining vehicle records, ensuring regular maintenance is performed at appropriate times, and the vehicle is always kept clean and in safe working condition.

Specific duties may vary or evolve over time based on business and client needs.

Core Experience

• No previous experience required.

• Must be able to communicate effectively both verbally and by email.

• Must have a valid driver’s license for at least a year with an acceptable driving record, and be able to pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check.

Physical/Work Environment

At Pearce safety is our number one concern. Candidates must be able to comply with OSHA Standards.

• This is a 100% travel position. Travel is required for 21 days in a row potentially out of state with 7 days at home break periods.

• Travel costs will be paid by Pearce Services, with an additional $50.00/day per diem.

• Compliance with FCC/FAA/EPA/OSHA Regulations.

• Must have the ability to inspect equipment, both visually and audibly.

• May need to pass DOT physical.

Compensation: $23.00 - $27.00 hourly

At Pearce, we are committed to fair and transparent pay practices.  Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

In addition to wages, employees may also be eligible for performance and referral bonuses, production incentives, tool/equipment and fuel stipends, company vehicle, per diem or other applicable compensation.  We also offer all full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package including health and life insurance, 401k with employer match, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and professional development courses.

This pay range reflects our commitment to pay equity and compliance with state and federal pay transparency laws. If you have questions about compensation, we encourage open discussions during the hiring process.

Base Pay Range
