jobs.title: AI-Native Product Designer
jobs.description:
AI-Native Product Designer

About the Company

We're partnering with an AI-native operating system for supply chains used by wholesalers, manufacturers, retailers, and traders. The platform integrates logistics and procurement data through connections with internal and external systems, enabling predictive analytics and automated workflows that improve fill rates, reduce inventory levels, and optimize cash-to-cash cycle time.

By leveraging predictive analytics and automation, the company helps large enterprises reduce costs, unlock additional revenue, and prevent under- or over-stocking across complex global supply chains.

Role Overview

The AI-Native Product Designer owns the design and experience of the company's product in an AI-first environment.

The way product design works here has fundamentally changed. Technical design knowledge no longer ends at execution — it becomes the language used to direct and collaborate with AI. This role requires someone who understands that shift deeply, is hungry to explore what's possible in an AI-native environment, and can translate complex operational realities into product experiences that are intuitive, consistent, and ready to ship.

This is an individual contributor role, working closely with the Head of Experience, the AI Engineering team, Technology Team, and customer-facing teams in Sales and Implementation to ensure the product reflects real operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

AI-directed design

 - Use AI tools actively and fluently as part of the design workflow — not as a shortcut, but as a design collaborator

 - Apply technical design expertise to direct AI outputs toward high-quality, production-ready results

 - Stay ahead of emerging AI design tools, techniques, and patterns — and bring that knowledge back to the team

 - Explore what AI-native product experiences look and feel like — and push the product in that direction

Product design & execution

 - Design end-to-end product experiences: screens, flows, interactions, and AI-driven interfaces

 - Own design delivery from concept through handoff — with Figma deliverables of a quality that reduces back-and-forth with Engineering to a minimum

 - Maintain and evolve the company's design system and interaction patterns to ensure consistency and scalability

 - Iterate based on feedback from Engineering, commercial teams, and customer insights — balancing speed with quality

Collaboration with Engineering & Technology

 - Work closely with Engineers — especially the AI team — to design solutions that are buildable and technically sound

 - Participate actively in developer conversations to clarify design intent, edge cases, and interactions during implementation

 - Ensure design quality is preserved through development — with full independence and without requiring constant oversight

Customer & market proximity

 - Connect regularly with Sales and Implementation teams to capture customer feedback and real operational context

 - Translate customer complaints, requests, and friction points into product improvements — acting as the bridge between what clients experience and what gets built

 - Validate design decisions against real usage patterns and market expectations in logistics and B2B platforms

 - Bring proactive proposals based on their own findings — not just translating feedback, but connecting dots and showing up with ideas

Profile We're Looking For

 - Proven experience as a Product Designer in B2B or complex product environments

 - Experience designing for or building AI-native products — not just products with AI features bolted on, but products where AI is core to the experience

 - Highly fluent with Figma and AI-powered design tools for design, prototyping, and collaboration

 - Comfortable in close, ongoing collaboration with Engineering — participating in technical discussions and supporting implementation

 - Ability to design data-heavy and workflow-driven interfaces for operational B2B environments

 - Autonomous, proactive, and vocal — brings ideas and pushes initiatives forward without waiting to be directed

 - Hungry to explore what's possible — not just delivering, but constantly asking what we could do better or differently

 - Comfortable operating with speed and quality in a fast-moving startup environment

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Route Planning
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our customers are faced with a constant stream of decisions every day to meet the commitments they have made to their own customers: which orders need to be delivered when, which driver is equipped to drive which truck, and how to balance delivering every order against fleet utilization and the profitability of their business..

As an engineer on the Route Planning team, you might work on a product that helps customers recover efficiency in their plans that has degraded with the addition of new customers or deal with the sudden influx of orders on the day of delivery. You will also help measure efficiency of the plans across our Routing products, including route execution and commercial navigation.

We are a rapidly scaling team that has found product market fit and is expanding to new verticals. We are looking for someone who will help us shape and build the next generation of Route Planning products

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.

• You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

• You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

• You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

In this role, you will:

• Design and build features end to end, from frontend to backend, that work across our diverse customer base, from grocery delivery to oil and gas

• Leverage AI with strong judgement, knowing when to build a prototype to unblock a stalled customer deal or accelerate a refactor that reduces risk of incidents in our products

• Partner with the engineering manager and staff engineers to advocate for technical excellence on the team

• Work with the product manager and designer to build interfaces and APIs that make a planner’s work more efficient

• Mentor junior engineers on the team and help build a strong technical bench

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

• 6+ years of experience as a software engineer

• Demonstrated ability executing in ambiguous environments

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal navigating conversations with a technical audience or a customer

An ideal candidate also has:

• Proven experience shaping and improving routing and navigation products

• A passion for mentoring and helping junior engineers grow

• A track record of thriving in 0→1 teams and scaling them through the post–startup phase

• Experience operating as a tech lead or in a similar technical role directly impacting output of other engineers.

• Willingness to engage directly with customers when needed

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$154,700—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Maritime International Deployments
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Seabed Sentry team is responsible for Maritime Domain Awareness providing subsea autonomous sensing and communication across critical commercial and defense mission sets. You'll operate in a fast-paced environment where small empowered teams move with urgency to deliver cutting-edge maritime capabilities from concept to deployment in months, not years. We bias toward action, embrace ambiguity, and expect technical program managers to drive execution with minimal bureaucracy — because the mission and the warfighter can't wait.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Industries is seeking our next Technical Program Manager to lead international deployment execution for a maritime undersea domain awareness program. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, program management, and customer delivery — you will own the end-to-end execution of international demonstrations and system deployments, from planning through on-site execution. You will be the connective tissue between product teams, engineering, operations, business development, and international customers. This is not a role where you manage from a distance — you will be in the details, in the room with the customer, and accountable for delivery. Our next Technical Program Manager is the person who is energized by complexity, who builds trust with customers through competence and follow-through, and seeks to put order to chaos.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own planning, scheduling, and execution of international system deployments and demonstrations for undersea domain awareness capabilities

• Build and maintain program schedules in Jira, ensuring milestones, dependencies, and critical path items are current and visible to all stakeholders

• Develop and maintain milestone trackers, risk registers, and action item burndowns across multiple concurrent workstreams

• Drive technical alignment across hardware, software, and systems engineering teams to ensure deployment-ready configurations meet customer requirements

• Prepare and deliver technical briefings and program status reviews to international customers, senior leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders

• Coordinate logistics for international hardware shipments including export compliance, temporary import/permanent export documentation, and customs coordination

• Identify and manage risks and dependencies across engineering, supply chain, compliance, and operations — escalate early and with proposed mitigations

• Translate customer requirements into actionable engineering tasking and ensure product teams understand the operational context behind what they're building

• Keep Jira updated as the single source of truth for schedule status — ensure sprint planning, epic tracking, and program milestones reflect reality, not aspirations

• Drive alignment across stakeholders who don't always agree — get decisions made, documented, and executed

• Support contract amendment processes, milestone payment tracking, and deliverable acceptance with the customer

• Document product baselines, configuration states, and deployment readiness criteria in Confluence

• Operate as the single point of accountability for deployment readiness — if something isn't tracking, you own the recovery plan

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of technical program management experience, preferably in defense, maritime, or aerospace

• Demonstrated ability to manage international customer engagements and deployments in high-stakes environments

• Strong technical foundation — able to go deep on systems architecture, integration challenges, and hardware/software trade-offs without relying on engineering to translate for you

• Experience building and presenting technical briefings to senior military and government stakeholders

• Track record of managing complex, multi-team schedules with interdependent milestones and hard deadlines

• Proficiency in Jira for program scheduling, sprint management, and milestone tracking — you treat the tool as a real-time reflection of program health, not an administrative chore

• Exceptional organizational skills — you are the person who tracks every action item, every dependency, every open risk, and doesn't let things fall through

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and high-pressure situations where the plan is changing and decisions have real consequences

• Experience with export control processes (ITAR/EAR) and international logistics

• Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, contract structures (FFP, T&M, CPFF), and milestone-based deliverables

• Ability to travel internationally up to 25%-40%, including extended deployments for demonstrations

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in undersea warfare, autonomous systems, or maritime ISR programs

• Background in systems engineering or test & evaluation

• Experience working with Indo-Pacific partner nations

• Experience with Confluence for documentation and product baseline management

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
What is the job?



We're looking for an experienced Quality Officer to join Leafio at a pivotal stage of our growth. This is a unique opportunity to join an ambitious team as we establish our pharmaceutical wholesale operation and secure the licences required to import, store and distribute medicinal products across the UK.



As part of the Quality team, you will ensure the daily activities are actioned and monitored and meet the highest standards of Good Distribution Practice (GDP), regulatory compliance and product quality.



You will play a critical role in ensuring that all medicinal products received, stored and supplied by Leafio comply with GDP, MHRA requirements (esp Reg 167), internal Quality Management Systems (QMS) standards, and customer expectations.



What will you be doing?



 - Ensure that Deviations, change controls, risk management and CAPAs are actioned according to their target date of completion

 - Raise Deviations, change controls, risk managements and CAPAs when needed and support in the investigations where relevant

 - Maintain and update the QMS (SOPs, policies, forms, logs)

 - Draft standard operating procedures, distribute for reviewing and finalising the procedures

 - Manage document control, versioning, training records and archiving

 - Support preparation of quality management review

 - Deliver GDP and QMS training to the relevant departments where needed

 - Support with batch traceability, Certificate of Analysis (CoA) documentation and batch release confirmations/verifications

 - Support with customers’ complaints and ensure timelines are adhered to

 - Support the Responsible Person (RP) in maintaining compliance and safeguarding product quality throughout the supply chain.

 - Actively collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g. pharmacy, warehouse)

 - Participating and supporting in audits (internal/external) and inspections where required

 - Any other tasks deemed necessary by the Responsible Person (RP)



What do you need?



 - Knowledge of Good Manufacturing (GMP) or Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the regulatory framework governing pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution

 - Proven experience working within a GMDP regulated pharmaceutical environment, (ideally supporting wholesale distribution and importation), with more than 2 years experience

 - Proven experience of dealing with a Quality Management Systems (QMS), including but not limited to Complaints, CAPAs, Deviations risk management, change control, self inspections/internal audits

 - Proven experience in dealing with unlicensed products (especially in accordance with Regulation 167)

 - Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills

 - Strong communication and report-writing ability

 - Highly organised, able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines



Desirable

 - Experience or exposure to Importation of unlicensed products from outside the EEA

 - Experience in working with an ERP system

 - Previous experience working within the medical cannabis sector

 - Previous experience in releasing products (QC-Quality control)



What we offer:

 - Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

 - Private Healthcare Scheme

 - Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

 - Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave


About Us

At Leafio, we’re building a smarter, more resilient pharmaceutical supply chain that gives pharmacies fast and reliable access to the medicines they need, when they need them.



By working directly with manufacturers and creating a more efficient wholesale model, we’re improving stock availability, simplifying distribution and helping to make medicines more affordable for patients. Everything we do is focused on creating a supply chain that is responsive, transparent and equipped to better support healthcare providers across the UK.



We’re an ambitious, fast-growing business with exciting plans for the future. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact, help shape how we grow and join a team that is modernising pharmaceutical distribution from the ground up.

Liquid Personnel is recruiting an Adult’s Social Worker to join its client’s Hospital team, based in Wolverhampton. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to support adults with complex care and support needs through safe, timely, and person-centred discharge planning from hospital settings.

The successful candidate will work within a fast-paced multidisciplinary environment alongside health professionals, therapists, discharge coordinators, carers, families, and community-based services. You will play a key role in ensuring individuals receive the right support at the right time, promoting independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes whilst reducing unnecessary delays in discharge.

This role requires a confident and experienced Social Worker with strong assessment skills, safeguarding knowledge, and a sound understanding of Adult Social Care legislation. You will be responsible for managing complex cases, coordinating services, and supporting adults through periods of transition from hospital back into their communities.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Managing a caseload of adults requiring social care intervention within acute and community hospital settings.

• Undertaking Care Act 2014 assessments, reviews, and reassessments to identify eligible needs and support discharge planning.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes.

• Supporting safe, effective, and timely hospital discharges through collaborative planning and intervention.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Assessing and managing risk, balancing individual choice, control, and independence with safeguarding responsibilities.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and responding to safeguarding concerns in accordance with Adult Safeguarding legislation and local procedures.

• Arranging and coordinating care packages, residential placements, equipment, reablement services, and community-based support where required.

• Working collaboratively with health professionals, community teams, care providers, carers, families, housing services, and partner agencies.

• Supporting adults and carers through periods of change and transition, offering advice, guidance, and advocacy where appropriate.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, discharge planning meetings, safeguarding discussions, and case reviews.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant assessments, reports, case records, and support plans.

• Promoting strengths-based practice and supporting individuals to maximise their independence following hospital admission.

Qualifications and Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have;

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Hospital Experience: Previous experience within a Hospital Team, Hospital Discharge Team, Integrated Discharge Service, or similar Adult Social Care setting is highly desirable.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake Care Act assessments, Mental Capacity Assessments, support planning, and risk management interventions.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with NHS professionals, therapists, care providers, housing services, community organisations, families, and carers.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice and continuous professional development.

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage a complex caseload, prioritise competing demands, and work effectively within a fast-paced hospital environment.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

 - We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We're a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built, you're the one we need.

What you'll do

 - Own White Circle's developer relations: how engineers and AI researchers discover, understand, and adopt what we build

 - Lead technical launches for open-source releases and developer tools, like our Halo framework, from narrative and demos through to launch day

 - Write and publish technical content: blog posts, tutorials, walkthroughs, demos, and threads on X and LinkedIn

 - Organise and run hackathons, meetups, and technical events, mainly in SF and New York

 - Build and grow a technical community around our open-source work and platform

 - Set up and run technical partnerships and collaborations with AI labs, dev tools companies, and research teams

 - Give technical input to promo and product videos, working with our design and creative team on production

 - Track what's working (signups, repo stars, views, event turnout, hiring pipeline) and double down on it


We're looking for someone who

 - Has a strong technical background as a software engineer, ML engineer, or researcher

 - Has worked at a technical product company, ideally in dev tools, infrastructure, databases, or AI

 - Has organised hackathons, meetups, or technical events, and can show how they went (turnout, signups, what came out of them)

 - Has an engaged following among engineers and/or AI researchers on X, LinkedIn, GitHub, or elsewhere

 - Knows the AI tooling landscape well: coding agents, eval frameworks, open-source models, and who is building what

 - Can take a complex technical topic and make it compelling for a developer audience without dumbing it down

 - Thrives with ownership and moves fast without waiting for direction

 - Is based in the US, or able to work US hours. SF or New York is ideal, but we'll consider exceptional candidates anywhere

 - Is fluent in English


A big plus

 - You've led developer marketing or DevRel for a technical launch that drove real adoption

 - You've contributed to or maintained popular open-source projects

 - You have existing relationships across the AI research and developer community

 - You've worked on or around AI safety, evals, or reliability


Compensation & benefits

 - Competitive compensation package, including equity

 - Flexible time off

 - Health insurance

 - Mental health support, including coverage for therapy when you need it

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Learning and development support for courses, conferences, and opportunities to grow your skills

 - All the hardware, subscriptions, tools, and services you need

 - Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Marbella


Process

 1. Intro call with Talent (25 min)

 2. Take-home assignment, with a choice of a walkthrough of one of our public repos or a launch case study on a sample company

 3. Technical chat with Head of Design & Head of Applied Research (45 min)

 4. Final conversation with CEO & Head of Engineering (45 min)

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser - Orlando International Premium Outlets
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will be responsible for executing the visual, commercial, and styling curation according to visual & commercial guidelines for the store. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Contribute to the total OMNI customer experience in your store by ensuring visual and commercial curation according to guidelines (In-direct)
• Representing yourself and the H&M Brand positively during customer interactions (Direct)
• Organize and plan your workload according to store activation plan and adapt based on business needs in collaboration with your Store Management team and Area Visual Manager
• Launch and maintain the latest global campaigns and sale activities on time according to H&M Brand Standards
• Ensure good garment care, stock levels, and give input on allocation to Store Management and Area teams
• Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
• Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
• Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, products, brands, competitors, and relevant influencers etc.
• Plan time for fashion & trend awareness to understand trend theory and mood boards for styling techniques and product presentation to anticipate our customer’s needs and enhance our shopping experience in store

Team & Development

• Share, inspire and educate your store teams, keep them updated with seasonal changes, fashion trends, relevant visual & commercial information, in-store communication, including price perception
• Coach and develop the Store team´s visual and commercial skills to secure high quality of product & commercial presentation according to guidelines
• Support & develop daily routines and best practices for your Store team to always ensure a consistent level of visual & commercial standard while maintaining customer service engagement
• Develop and coach talents and provide onboarding training to new colleagues
• Organize, provide, and carry out the visual & commercial upskilling for you and your colleagues
• Complete Visual Competencies & Commercial 4 All trainings based on Regional & Sales Market learning and development goals
• Support Sales Market and Area teams with expansion (store projects) needs

Visual & Commercial Execution

• Execute the visual & commercial curation & styling for the store based on commercial calendar, allocation, store activation plan and fashion trends according to mood boards and direction from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Carry out sample picking best practice routines including stockroom garment quantities, accessories, and shoes to ensure you create clear trends and stories according to inspiration from the visual & commercial guidelines
• Secure window & styling execution according to visual & commercial guidelines to create inspirational and commercial customer experience
• Provide good customer flow by maintaining commercial layout, fixtures, to secure the best trend story placement
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in windows and throughout the store following guidelines according to Global strategy and Sales Market requirements
• In collaboration with Facilities Management ensure all lighting is working correctly, aimed to highlight our products and display forms in windows and throughout the store
• Maintain and care for all display forms and interior material (fixtures & fittings) with sustainability in mind
• In collaboration with Area Visual Manager ensure your store navigation is maintained and kept up to date according to latest guidelines and store layout
• Ensure your store has enough quantities of sale and other activity including POS material according to local routines
• Keep sales floor and back of house clean, organized, and safe according to local security guidelines

Who You Are

• For you to be a successful Visual Merchandiser, you must be curious and creative; always looking for inspiration, proactive, solution focused, flexible, with effective communication skills to achieve results cross functionally.
• We look for individuals with fashion interests and leadership skills who can apply their visual and commercial experience working in a dynamic environment to the role.
• Experience with being solution focused to improve product presentation and commercial execution in store
• Good knowledge of visual, commercial, and operational best practises, routines, and tools
• Know how to manage, follow-up and act on selling equation and weekly sales reports

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Social Worker - Preparation for Adulthood Team
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Social Worker for its client's Preparation for Adulthood Team in Dorset.

This is an exciting opportunity to work within a specialist Birth to Settled Adulthood Service, supporting young people with disabilities and their families as they prepare for adult life.

Working within a strengths-based, multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate with colleagues across social care, health, SEND, and education to support young people aged 14 to 25. The role has a unique focus on preparation for adulthood, helping young people build independence, develop life skills, and achieve their aspirations as they transition towards adulthood.

The successful candidate will primarily complete and review Preparation for Adulthood Plans, working directly with young people and their families to identify goals and support pathways that maximise independence and promote positive outcomes. Whilst this role does not involve long-term case holding, there may also be opportunities to undertake Care Act assessments, support planning, Mental Capacity Assessments, and Best Interest decision-making where required.

This role requires a motivated practitioner who is passionate about supporting young people through transition and ensuring that adulthood is approached in a planned, informed, and person-centred way.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Completing and reviewing Preparation for Adulthood Plans for young people aged 14 to 25 with disabilities and additional needs.

• Working directly with young people and their families to identify aspirations, strengths, and goals that support a successful transition into adulthood.

• Promoting independence skills, self-advocacy, community participation, employment opportunities, education, and independent living.

• Using strengths-based and person-centred approaches to support young people in achieving positive long-term outcomes.

• Collaborating closely with professionals across social care, health, SEND, education, and partner agencies to ensure coordinated support.

• Undertaking Care Act assessments and Care and Support Planning where required as part of transition planning.

• Completing Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making processes in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Supporting young people and families to understand available resources, services, support options, and transition pathways.

• Providing professional advice and guidance to colleagues regarding preparation for adulthood principles and approaches.

• Contributing to the development of good practice in transition planning and promoting independence across the wider service.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, planning discussions, and transition-related forums.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records, assessments, plans, and reports.

• Supporting a smooth transition between children's and adult services, ensuring there are no unnecessary gaps in support.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

Job Title: Meetings and Events Senior Project Manager

Brand: Emota

Location: Philadelphia or hybrid on Central or Eastern time

Reporting to: Project Director

Direct reports: Project Co-ordinators and Senior Project Co-ordinators

A bit about the role …

As an experienced Senior Project Manager specializing in Meetings and Events, you will play an important role in the planning of global projects for our renowned clients.

You will use your project management skills to achieve all logistical elements and associated budgets of our projects, whilst mentoring our Project Co-ordinators to follow the same.

Your role, which includes national and international travel, will involve client, partner, supplier, team, and financial management at all stages of the delivery - pre, on-site and post event.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to you including volunteer days, enhanced annual leave with an option to buy/sell, 401k, health insurance and many other benefits.

You will…

Project Management:

· Lead the project from a client, internal team and external partner perspective

· Lead small to medium sized projects that involve several Emota / XD service lines, being the main contact for the client and ensuring a seamless delivery

· Ensure that the highest standards of event planning and delivery are maintained through the leadership of Project Executives

· Oversee the building of apps and content

· Manage post event metric reporting

· Manage all hotels and venues and associated logistical arrangements.

· Co-ordinate client requirements with all 3rd party suppliers, promoting relationships

· Manage communications e.g. weekly status reports to all internal and external partners

· Travel on-site to conduct site inspections including planning meetings with all suppliers and for delivery of the event

· Attend on-site at Meetings and Events held both nationally and internationally

· Ensure delivery of all events following regulatory and client-defined compliance guidelines

Client Liaison and Development:

· Conduct meetings and communicate with clients to develop relationships

· Identify new opportunities and leads for our business development to share with Client Engagement Director

· Help present event proposals to clients

· Plan, attend and accomplish client planning meetings both F2F and virtual

· Manage preparation of supportive meeting planning materials for client planning meetings

· Ensure your client is up to date with all aspects of meeting planning arrangements throughout the course of the program

· Lead relevant aspects of client debrief post event

· Be a subject matter expert for client account to guide and support colleagues across the account

Budget Management:

· Lead the end-to-end event budget within the company financial tools

· Manage the preparation and maintenance of budgets, throughout the lifecycle of each event

· Approve all client invoices before dispatch

· Ensure financial tracking of each event and conduct regular 'health checks' to ensure positive cash flow

· Accomplish scope management – to identify and charge clients for out-of-scope activities

· Identify and measure cost avoidance / saving measures

· Ensure compliance with company and client invoicing and financial processes

· Ensure time is logged for the project

Staff Development and Management:

· Work with Project Director to prioritize staff and resources to meet goals and deadlines

· Assist Project Director with recruitment of Project Managers, Project Executives and provide input to their mentoring and development

· Conduct scheduled 1:1s with direct reports to ensure they are supported and that client deliverables are met

General:

· Be an ambassador for the agency

· Attend and contribute at team meetings

· Collaborate with other departments to ensure the delivery of client goals

· Work towards client and our service level agreements (SLAs) for all events

· Understand, apply, and promote our mission, vision, and values

· Comply with all company and client procedures, including those relating to Health & Safety, privacy and security

· Display an understanding of compliance when working with healthcare clients

· Comply with all client and company privacy and security protocol

· Apply a knowledge of our range of services

· To be mindful of environmental sustainability in all aspects of your role and incorporate this mindset in your approach

What do you need to have …

· Previous experience (5+ years) of managing and delivering meetings and events in a corporate setting (ideally internationally)

· Experience managing event budgets from creation through to revisions and reconciliation

· Meeting and event project management and resource skills

· A customer-centric approach to event delivery

· Previous experience leading teams to success

· Proficiency in a range of event management software, project management tools and Microsoft 365 suite (including Excel and ability to maintain complex spreadsheets)

· The flexibility and desire to travel both nationally and internationally and manage busy event schedules on-site

· Experience working with Pharmaceutical / Healthcare clients is preferable

A bit about us ….

Emota is an award-winning global events agency that creates and delivers engaging, impactful experiences.

Part of Inizio Engage XD, we are an unusually shaped communications group that creates experiences that inspire lasting change. We partner with clients to provide employee engagement, learning and training solutions, scientific engagement and capability building, all underpinned by applied behavioral science. We engage internal and external audiences through the delivery of live and virtual experiences, film, digital, and immersive content.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer (Knowledge Graphs & Applied AI)
jobs.description:
FOUNDING ENGINEER, SEARCH & KNOWLEDGE SYSTEMS

Location: NYC (Hybrid)
Compensation: $200,000+ base + founding equity



ABOUT RELEVANT

Recruiting is broken. Coaching is reserved for executives. Career transitions are often far more difficult than they should be.

At Relevant, we're building a portfolio of products designed to help people navigate their careers with greater clarity, confidence, and support. Our products include Reva, Coach, Passport, and SuccessDNA — each tackling a different part of the career journey.

This is not another productivity app or AI wrapper.

We're building systems that help people understand opportunities, make better decisions, and navigate complex career paths. The problems we're solving sit at the intersection of search, knowledge representation, recommendations, reasoning, and human potential.

We're still early. SuccessDNA is currently in design-partner and dogfooding stages, while several other products are being built from the ground up.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a Founding Engineer to join directly after the founder and help shape the technical foundation of the company.

You'll work across product, architecture, data, retrieval, search, and AI systems. This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys operating in ambiguity, making architectural decisions, and building systems from first principles.

You won't inherit a roadmap.

You'll help create it.


WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

 - Graph-based retrieval systems

 - Semantic search and ranking infrastructure

 - Knowledge representation and entity relationships

 - Data models that support reasoning and personalization

 - Recommendation and matching systems

 - Agent-powered workflows and AI-enabled user experiences

 - Core platform capabilities used across multiple products


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're less interested in AI titles and more interested in the systems you've built.

You may currently be a:

 - Staff Software Engineer

 - Principal Software Engineer

 - Staff Backend Engineer

 - Platform Engineer

 - Data Platform Engineer

 - Search Engineer

 - Knowledge Graph Engineer

 - Distributed Systems Engineer

You likely have experience with some combination of:

 - Graph databases

 - Knowledge graphs

 - Semantic modeling

 - Entity resolution

 - Search infrastructure

 - Retrieval systems

 - Ranking systems

 - Recommendation systems

 - Large-scale data platforms

You should also bring:

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience

 - Strong architectural and systems design skills

 - Experience building and operating production systems at scale

 - Ability to move from idea to implementation without waiting for detailed specifications

 - A pragmatic mindset focused on shipping, learning, and improving


AI EXPERIENCE

Experience with LLM-powered products, agents, retrieval-augmented systems, or AI applications is valuable.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks, or application-layer integrations.

The foundation we care about is strong engineering, data systems, search, and knowledge representation.



BONUS POINTS

 - Previous startup or founding engineer experience

 - Experience building products from 0→1

 - Experience leading engineers or technical initiatives

 - Background in talent, recruiting, HR technology, or career development

 - Interest in psychometrics, organizational design, or human performance


WHY JOIN

You'll have direct influence over product direction, architecture, and company strategy.

You'll work closely with the founder and leadership team.

You'll help define the technical foundations of a company that aims to meaningfully improve how people navigate their careers.

And you'll do it with the ownership, autonomy, and upside that come with being an early founding team member.

jobs.title: QC Pharmaceutical Laboratory Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced QC Pharmaceutical Laboratory Manager to lead and oversee the Westport-based testing schedule for raw materials, stability studies, in-process materials, and final commercial release products.

This role is responsible for ensuring that testing activities are completed in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), AbbVie Worldwide Quality Assurance (WWQA) standards, and applicable regulatory requirements, including those of the FDA, EMA, HPRA, and other health authorities.

The successful candidate will be an active and visible leader within the laboratory, engaging and motivating team members, constructively challenging performance, and creating opportunities for professional growth and development.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership

• Lead, motivate, and develop team members, taking appropriate action to address individual performance when required.
• Conduct performance and development meetings in line with company policies and procedures.
• Participate actively in the recruitment and selection of laboratory team members.
• Monitor attendance and timekeeping and take appropriate action where standards are not met.
• Support the training, qualification, and certification of new employees.
• Ensure the area is appropriately staffed and that resource constraints are effectively managed.
• Promote a culture in which all activities are completed in compliance with AbbVie and regulatory requirements.

Operational and Strategic Support

• Provide testing completion dates to support raw material, stability, in-process, and final commercial release timelines.
• Monitor team performance and provide relevant KPI data.
• Lead Tier 2 meetings and support effective escalation and issue resolution.
• Represent QC Pharma at meetings and forums as directed by senior management.
• Coordinate the review and approval of local and global quality documents.
• Ensure team activities support AbbVie’s strategic objectives, including effective collaboration across functions and business units.

Departmental Support and Compliance

• Collaborate with laboratory management colleagues to ensure testing is completed, reviewed, validated, and released in line with procedural timelines and site and laboratory performance targets.
• Facilitate resource allocation across QC Pharma teams to support business priorities, meet testing timelines, and provide professional development opportunities.
• Coordinate with laboratory management and laboratory trainers to ensure appropriate cross-training is completed.
• Maintain inspection readiness for internal and external audits and regulatory inspections.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives across the laboratory.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant scientific discipline.
• Demonstrated experience in direct people management, including performance management, development planning, and conflict resolution.
• Strong knowledge of GMP standards and regulations, particularly laboratory-related requirements.
• Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated laboratory environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.
• Confidence communicating with external stakeholders, including regulatory inspectors and auditors.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement & RFP Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT TALON.ONE:

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world’s most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Enablement & RFP Specialist, you will own end-to-end RFP responses for prospects while helping to build the enablement resources, wikis, and onboarding tools that power our global Sales Engineering team. With primary focus on the RFPs for the AMER region and providing additional support EMEA and APAC during peak volumes, you will help prospects understand the full capabilities of our Loyalty and Promotion platform. In this role, you are a deal champion who highlights our unique differentiators and clearly articulates why our solution commands enterprise-grade investment through the RFP responses.

You must be based on the US East Coast, ideally within commuting distance of one of our hubs: New York or Boston.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

You'll report to our Senior Enablement Manager and support scaling our RFP operations and Sales Engineering enablement as our business expands through both organic growth and the integration of our parent company's ecosystem. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment to help shape our content architecture, AI drafting strategies, and cross-functional workflows.

ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:

• Own end-to-end RFP, RFI, and security questionnaire responses for prospects

• Transform standard RFP requirements into compelling value narratives that highlight our Loyalty and Promotion platform's unique competitive advantages, ensuring every response positions us as the high-value strategic partner

• Support RFP response across AMER, EMEA, and APAC when volume requires extra hands

• Using internal tools and knowledge base with complementary AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT as part of your workflow and for speed and accuracy, before Sales Engineers and Account Executives layer in their depth from real prospect conversations

• Build and maintain enablement resources, including our Sales Engineering wiki, internal tool documentation, and onboarding materials

• Partner with Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Account Managers, Product Marketing, and Business Value Consultants to get RFP content and positioning right

• Shape how we answer new RFP questions as our platform integrates with our parent company's technology

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:

• You value accuracy, speed, and a high work ethic

• Bring hands-on experience responding to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires

• Frame every response around value creation, highlighting Unique Selling Points (USPs), ROI, and key differentiators to justify enterprise deal sizes

• Use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT with a deep understanding of their capabilities and limitations

• Experience digesting and understanding technical product details (APIs, integrations, data security) and translating them into clear, customer-facing copy.

• Experience managing multiple RFPs at once across different industries and stakeholders, under competing deadlines and shifting priorities

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

• $1,200 annual learning budget

• Manage your own time off with our flexible PTO policy

• $350 home office setup budget, a $50 monthly home office allowance

• Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide

• WeWork On-Demand access for flexible workspace solutions

• Mental health support with nilo.health

• Choose from top-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans (Blue Cross Blue Shield MA, MetLife, VSP)

• Build your savings with our 401(k) plan, including a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4%

• We provide 100% company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage

jobs.title: Prozessingenieur (gn)
jobs.description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Intermediate | Location: Elmshorn | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Dein Start im Technics Team bei ESN & More!

Als Prozessingenieur (gn) bist du für das Analysieren und Optimieren bestehender Maschinen- sowie Produktionsprozesse verantwortlich. Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Produktionsabläufe und Produktionsprozesse mit und hast Lust die Marken ESN & More Nutrition voranzutreiben? Dann melde dich bei uns und werde Teil des Teams.

Deine Mission bei uns

• Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende Maschinen- sowie Produktionsprozesse und implementierst neue TPM-Standards direkt im operativen Umfeld

• Du entwickelst Sicherheitskonzepte auf Basis von Risikoanalysen und stellst die Einhaltung von Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltauflagen sicher

• Du leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse (KVP) ein, führst Kaizen- sowie Root-Cause-Analysen durch und überwachst die Maschinenleistung mittels Datenanalyse

• Du gestaltest neue Produktionsabläufe bei Produkteinführungen, wählst passende Anlagen aus und begleitest technische Projekte eigenständig

• Du schulst Operator sowie Maschinenführer in TPM-Standards und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Produktion Konzepte zur autonomen Instandhaltung

• Du fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Technik und QS und führst interne technische Audits zur Prozessoptimierung durch

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Lebensmitteltechnologie) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für Prozessverbesserungen mit und hast Erfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Abläufe zur Ressourcenoptimierung

• Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in gängigen Methoden wie Lean Management, TPM oder Kaizen und hast Freude daran, diese in einem dynamischen Umfeld einzuführen

• Du zeichnest dich durch eine beharrliche, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus und hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze proaktiv, um die Produktionsleistung zu steigern

• Du bist ein Teamplayer und schätzt die enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, von der Qualitätssicherung bis hin zum Maschinenbediener

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Augenhöhe und verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

• Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

• Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

jobs.title: VP of Marketing
jobs.description:
The Company



Frontline work is the cornerstone of modern society. Restaurants, schools, hospitals, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services — these are the organisations that keep the world running, and they employ 80% of the global workforce: over 3 billion people. Yet frontline businesses are among the hardest in the world to run. By-the-minute HR, scheduling and payroll make them vastly more operationally complex than the average white-collar company, and they've been chronically underserved by technology — just 1% of venture funding has gone to tools built for these sectors, despite the complexity being an order of magnitude greater.

That gap has become an existential one. Rising costs, minimum wage increases, labor shortages, tighter regulation and stretched consumers have eroded margins and pushed many frontline operators out of business. There is real urgency to fix the economics of labor — and AI is the lever. It can't do the jobs of frontline workers, but it can eliminate the inefficiencies that drain them. Frontline companies generate enormous volumes of operational data; harnessed properly, AI agents can run significant parts of these businesses autonomously and fundamentally reset their economics.

That's what Sona is building: the AI-native workforce management platform that lets frontline companies unleash agents to run more efficiently. It's a market worth over $500 billion, hiding in plain sight — and the room to build one of the largest software and AI companies in the world. We're off to a strong start: over $100M raised from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and offices in New York, London, Austin and Lisbon.



Job Summary



We're hiring a Vice President, Marketing to own global marketing and build Sona's US presence from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder & CEO, you'll be the most senior marketing voice in the company, responsible for turning early US traction into scaled pipeline, while sharpening how Sona shows up across every vertical we serve.

The core challenge is one of messaging and market-making. Sona is a complex, multi-product platform selling into sectors like hospitality, care and retail - and the opportunity is to translate that complexity into positioning that lands with buyers fast. Day to day, that means working at the intersection of product marketing, GTM strategy, and brand. Not just managing channels or optimising spend.

You'll inherit a strong UK team of six. What doesn't exist yet is the US function, a unified global strategy, or vertical messaging sharp enough to scale. Building those three things - quickly, credibly, and in close partnership with sales - is the job.



Responsibilities



 - Own global marketing strategy, positioning, and budget, reporting to the CEO

 - Build the US marketing function from scratch, establishing Sona's brand and pipeline engine

 - Build top, middle, and bottom of funnel strategies to ensure the wider GTM team are meeting growth targets

 - Develop Sona's brand with a key focus on the US market

 - Partner closely with global Sales leadership across UK & US

 - Define and execute vertical-specific messaging across our sectors with a key focus on hospitality in the US

 - Drive pipeline through ABM, field marketing and events, content, and partnerships in close alignment with the VP Sales and sales team

 - Lead and develop the existing UK marketing team alongside scaling the US



Qualifications & Competencies



 - B2B marketing experience at a SaaS company with an enterprise or mid-market motion - you've marketed complex products with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders

 - Product marketing and category framing is your strongest gear, you know how to take a multi-product platform and make it mean something to a specific buyer in a specific vertical

 - You've built or scaled a marketing function at an early stage, not just operated one. You're comfortable without a playbook and energised by the opportunity to create one

 - Strong US B2B marketing judgment, with experience building brand and pipeline in the US market

 - Proven people leader who develops and stretches their team, not just manages it

 - Bonus: sector experience in hospitality - or a clear track record of getting up to speed in a new vertical fast



Benefits

 - Share options

 - 20 days PTO + sick days

 - 401k contributions, employer match up to 2%

 - Comprehensive health cover via Aetna

 - Enhanced parental leave & pay

 - Annual all expenses paid team retreats

 - The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

 - Professional development budget

 - Unlimited free books

jobs.description:
Location:  This is a remote-based role that requires flexibility and willingness to travel within a specified region and for company-related purposes as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success.

We are seeking driven and customer-focused Account Specialists to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. These individuals will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.

• Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.

• Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.

• Partner with Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Patient Services, and Medical teams to optimize customer and patient outcomes.

• Support launch execution, including pre-launch planning and post-launch adoption strategies.

• Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.

• Maintain a high level of product, disease state, and market knowledge.

• Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies.

How You Work

• You think in terms of systems, not silos.

• You balance rigor with speed, knowing when each matters most.

• You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.

• You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.

• You are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving impact for patients.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.

• Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.

• Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.

• Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.

• Experience selling into hospital systems, IDNs, and institutional accounts is a strong plus.

• Understanding of specialty pharmacy and hub services models.

• Demonstrated track record of strong, consistent performance against quota and territory goals.

• Evidence of execution against target metrics with year-over-year improvement.

• The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary

$160,000—$192,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.
