jobs.title: Manager, Regulatory Affairs (Clinical Labeling)
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Manager, Regulatory Affairs (Clinical Labeling), is responsible for the development, maintenance, and oversight of Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) labeling (also referred to as “Clinical Labeling”, “Special Access Scheme labeling”, “Compassionate Use labeling”, “Early Access Program labeling”, etc.) for Telix’s investigational products used in global clinical trials. This role ensures that all IMP labeling complies with applicable global regulatory requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), and company standards while supporting supply chain execution and study timelines.

The Manager, Regulatory Affairs (Clinical Labeling), serves as a key cross-functional partner to Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Quality, and other internal stakeholders and external vendors to develop and manage labeling documents that support investigational products throughout the clinical development lifecycle. Provides strategic direction and operational oversight for IMP labeling activities throughout the product development lifecycle, partnering with the Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs (Labeling/Ad-Promo).

Key Accountabilities:

• Leads the creation, revision, review, agreement, and maintenance of Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) labeling (also referred to as “Clinical Labeling”, “Special Access Scheme labeling”, “Compassionate Use labeling”, “Early Access Program labeling”, etc.) and Calibration Labeling for Telix’s investigational products.

• Collaborates with internal stakeholders (e.g., Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Quality) and external partners (e.g., Contract Research Organizations, Contract Manufacturing Organizations, translation vendors, artwork vendors, packaging vendors) for input, review and approval of IMP labeling.

• Ensures label content accurately reflects approved protocol requirements, product characteristics, storage conditions, and country-specific requirements.

• Ensures regulatory compliance with applicable local and regional laws and regulations and internal policies governing IMP labeling, including requirements for the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Asia-Pacific, and other participating countries. These requirements include, but are not limited to, EU Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR) and Annex VI requirements, EU GMP Annex 13 requirements, U.S. FDA requirements, ICH GCP guidelines, and country-specific IMP labeling requirements.

• Provides labeling expertise during protocol development, clinical study start-up, amendments, and country expansion activities.

• Coordinates translation activities and verification of multilingual labeling content.

• Coordinates review and approval of artwork for IMP labeling in the compliance system.

• Manages version control and change management for IMP documentation in accordance with regulatory expectations.

• Supports submission of IMP labeling where submission or notification is required.

• Evaluates new regulatory requirements and industry trends impacting IMP labeling; assesses the impact of changing regulations on existing and future studies.

• Supports regulatory inspections and audits by providing IMP documentation and subject matter expertise.

• Serves as the regulatory point of contact for IMP labeling for assigned products, resolving issues independently and escalating complex matters as appropriate.

• Contributes to maintaining efficient IMP labeling processes by using standardized templates, checklists, and workflows.

• Identifies process improvements, best practices, and tools to enhance the efficiency and quality of IMP labeling.

• Assist with other labeling activities and special projects, whether clinical or commercial in nature, as assigned by management, to support departmental objectives, business priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in life sciences.

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, global labeling, clinical, or clinical operations, including at least 2 year of experience in Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) labeling (“Clinical Labeling”).

• Experience supporting IMP (clinical) labeling for clinical trials across multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions.

• Knowledge of IMP lifecycle management.

• In-depth understanding of relevant international, national, and regional regulatory and/or clinical frameworks, processes, and requirements.

• Strong understanding of GMP, GCP, EU CTR, Annex VI, Annex 13, and FDA IMP requirements.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and labeling management systems. Working knowledge of Veeva is desired

Key Capabilities:

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world.  We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: QA Inspektor HK
jobs.description:
Kvalita u nás není jen kolonka v tabulce. Je to jistota, že zákazník dostane přesně takové potraviny, jaké by si sám vybral v obchodě.

Do našeho týmu proto hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á bude přímo ve skladu hlídat kvalitu zboží – od chvíle, kdy k nám dorazí, během jeho skladování až po cestu k zákazníkovi.

Pokud máš dobré oko pro detail, jsi pečlivý/á a nebojíš se říct, když něco není v pořádku, tahle práce by Ti mohla sednout. Předchozí zkušenosti z kvality jsou výhodou, ale důležitější je pro nás spolehlivost, zodpovědnost a chuť dělat věci pořádně.



Co Tě u nás čeká

 - Budeš kontrolovat kvalitu zboží při příjmu a hlídat, zda odpovídá našim standardům.

 - Průběžně zkontroluješ produkty také během skladování a oddělíš zboží, které požadovanou kvalitu nesplňuje.

 - Výsledky kontrol budeš jednoduše zaznamenávat, aby bylo vždy dohledatelné, co a kdy se kontrolovalo.

 - Pokud narazíš na problém, předáš ho nadřízenému a pomůžeš s jeho řešením.

 - Budeš se podílet na zavádění nápravných opatření, aby se stejné problémy zbytečně neopakovaly.

 - Čeká Tě práce přímo v provozu skladu, včetně chladírenských prostor.
   
   

Hodíš se k nám, pokud:

 - máš smysl pro detail a přesnost,

 - je na tebe spoleh a umíš dodržovat nastavené postupy,

 - dokážeš jasně komunikovat a upozornit na problém,

 - nevadí Ti směnný provoz,

 - zvládneš práci ve skladovém prostředí včetně chladnějších prostor,

 - poradíš si s mobilem, aplikacemi a jednoduchým zadáváním dat,

 - a umíš fungovat jako součást týmu.
   
   

Co je výhodou, ale ne podmínkou

 - SŠ vzdělání v oblasti potravinářství, zemědělství nebo příbuzném oboru.

 - Zkušenost ze skladu, maloobchodu, potravinářské výroby nebo kontroly kvality.

 - Základní znalost angličtiny.
   
   

Co Ti nabízíme:

 - Hrazené obědy ve výši 115 Kč.

 - Příspěvek na ošatné – 86 Kč navíc ke každé odpracované směně.

 - Slevy na nákupy na Rohlíku — členství v Xtra zdarma a cashback na tvé vlastní nákupy.

 - Lidský přístup a zaškolení — první dny s tebou projde zkušený kolega, který ti všechno ukáže a nenechá tě v tom plavat.

 - Tým, který drží při sobě — budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem si pomáhají a táhnou za jeden provaz.
   
   

Proč právě tahle práce?

Výsledek svojí práce uvidíš každý den. Pomáháš rozhodovat o tom, jaké zboží se dostane až k zákazníkovi. Když něco není v pořádku, máš možnost to zachytit dřív, než produkt opustí sklad.

Hledáme někoho, komu záleží na tom, aby věci byly udělané správně – protože právě díky takovým lidem můžeme zákazníkům doručovat potraviny v kvalitě, kterou od Rohlíku očekávají.

jobs.title: Advanced Social Work Practitioner
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Advanced Social Work Practitioner for its client at Nottinghamshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly skilled practitioner to work within a fast-paced hospital setting, supporting adults with complex care and support needs across urgent and emergency care pathways.

The successful candidate will play a key leadership role within the team, supporting safe and timely hospital discharges, reducing delays, and promoting positive outcomes for individuals and their careers. Working closely with health professionals, multidisciplinary teams, community services, and partner agencies, you will provide expert social work practice, support complex decision-making, and contribute to the ongoing development of high-quality strengths-based practice across the service.

This role requires an experienced practitioner with a strong understanding of hospital discharge pathways, the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, and Discharge to Assess guidance. You will also support the operational management of the team through supervision, coaching, performance management, and deputising for the Team Manager when required.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Managing complex cases involving adults with care and support needs within urgent and emergency care settings.

• Undertaking Care Act 2014 assessments, reviews, support planning, and risk assessments to facilitate safe and effective discharge planning.

• Applying the Mental Capacity Act 2005, including complex Mental Capacity Assessments and Best Interest decision-making.

• Supporting timely hospital discharge through effective application of Discharge to Assess principles and pathways.

• Working collaboratively with hospital clinicians, therapists, community services, care providers, carers, and partner agencies to coordinate support arrangements.

• Promoting strengths-based practice that maximises independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes for individuals and their families.

• Assessing, managing, and mitigating risks whilst ensuring defensible and proportionate decision-making.

• Supporting the reduction of delayed transfers of care by proactively identifying and resolving barriers to discharge.

• Providing expert social work advice, guidance, and professional leadership within the multidisciplinary team.

• Supervising, coaching, mentoring, and supporting Social Workers and other Adult Social Care practitioners to improve practice and performance.

• Supporting the management team in driving service improvements, quality assurance activity, and professional development.

• Monitoring and supporting performance management processes, promoting accountability and best practice across the team.

• Chairing multidisciplinary meetings, discharge planning meetings, safeguarding discussions, and professional forums.

• Deputising for the Team Manager as required and contributing to operational leadership within the service.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant case records, assessments, reports, and professional documentation.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care, including hospital-based social work and complex case management.

• Hospital Discharge Experience: Extensive experience working within Hospital Discharge, Urgent Care, Emergency Care, or Discharge to Assess pathways.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and Department of Health Discharge to Assess guidance.

• Leadership Experience: Experience providing supervision, coaching, mentoring, and professional support to colleagues.

• Performance Management: Experience supporting quality assurance, performance improvement, workforce development, and strengths-based practice.

• Multi-Agency Working: Proven ability to work effectively alongside NHS professionals, community services, providers, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, report-writing, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Specialist Qualifications: Holding one or more of the following is highly desirable: Best Interests Assessor (BIA) Practice Educator (Full Award), Approved Mental Health Professional (AMHP)

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice, continuous improvement, and high standards of professional leadership.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

jobs.title: Engineering Support Lead
jobs.description:
ENGINEERING SUPPORT LEAD

Location: San Francisco · Full time


ABOUT COMPOSIO

Composio builds the AI-native automation layer for software teams: SDKs, runtimes, and platform tooling that let developers compose, evaluate, and operate agentic workflows and AI-powered products. Our systems must be reliable at scale - agents must act correctly, integrations must be robust, and integration needs to be an autonomous, observable function that accelerates engineering rather than slowing it.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an Engineering Support Lead who is already doing technical support work and is ready to build the function for the AI era. You know the reality of a live queue, difficult escalations, customer communication, and coaching support engineers. Now you want to build the team, standards, and systems that make great support repeatable as Composio grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay close to customers and cases while hiring and developing the team, running support across locations, and using AI to help people resolve more problems well.


THE FRONTIER YOU'LL WORK ON

 - AI can gather context, suggest a diagnosis, and draft a reply. A strong support leader knows how to bring those capabilities into a real queue, check their quality, and keep a person accountable for the customer's outcome. You will shape that system.

 - Every difficult case is product signal. You will turn recurring failures across auth, SDKs, integrations, and agent workflows into fixes, clearer docs, better tools, and fewer future tickets.

 - Support must scale across time zones without losing ownership. You will build the coverage, handoffs, coaching, and escalation paths that make the experience consistent for customers and sustainable for the team.


WHAT WILL YOU DO?

 - Own the support queue end to end: triage, technical investigation, customer updates, escalation, and confirmation of resolution.

 - Lead complex enterprise cases. Reproduce failures across APIs, OAuth, SDKs, third-party integrations, and agent workflows; give Engineering a clear diagnosis and stay accountable while a fix ships.

 - Build the operating model across San Francisco and Bangalore, including queue ownership, shift handoffs, incident communication, and coverage that matches our commitments.

 - Set useful response and follow-up targets by customer tier and severity. Review case quality, unresolved work, customer outcomes, and the reasons customers contact us again.

 - Hire, onboard, and coach technical support engineers. Run case reviews, give direct feedback, and create paths for people to grow in support and engineering-adjacent work.

 - Bring AI into the daily support workflow. Use Composio and work with our applied AI engineers to improve intake, context gathering, investigation, drafting, and follow-up; measure quality and keep clear human ownership when a workflow fails.

 - Build a demand and capacity view that informs staffing and coverage decisions before the queue falls behind.

 - Work with FDE, Product, and Engineering to turn patterns in customer cases into product fixes, self-serve guidance, and better developer experience.


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for someone whose career is already rooted in technical support and who can show evidence of the following:

 - Operate support today. You currently lead or play a senior role in a technical support function. You have owned live cases, escalations, queue health, and the quality of customer communication.

 - Build a support organization. You have hired or coached support engineers, improved how a team works, set clear ownership and service standards, and can show how customer outcomes changed.

 - Go deep technically. You can inspect requests and logs, reproduce an ambiguous failure, reason about APIs and authentication, and work effectively with engineers on a durable fix.

 - Earn customer trust. You write clearly under uncertainty, give useful next steps, and stay with a customer through resolution rather than treating an internal handoff as closure.

 - Lead people and operations. You can design coverage across locations, run an escalation calmly, and make staffing decisions using evidence rather than ticket counts alone.

 - Be ready for AI-led support. You use AI tools in your own work and can identify where they will make support better, how to check their output, and when a person must take over. You are eager to build this into the team's daily practice.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with a developer platform, API product, cloud infrastructure, or an integration-heavy product.

 - Experience building support automation, agent workflows, evaluations, or human review systems.

 - Experience reading or shipping Python or TypeScript fixes while working in support.

 - Familiarity with OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, MCP, and support tools such as Plain, Zendesk, or Intercom.

 - Experience building a team that spans the US and India.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Physical AI Communications
jobs.location: Livingston, NJ / New York, NY / Sunnyvale, CA / San Francisco, CA / Bellevue, WA
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do:

The Communications team at CoreWeave is responsible for how the world understands the infrastructure powering the AI era. We work with reporters, analysts, customers, and partners to explain what our platform makes possible — and to keep the story grounded in what the technology actually does. Physical AI is one of the fastest-moving frontiers we support: the robotics companies, autonomous vehicle programs, industrial manufacturers, and scientific research teams building AI that perceives, reasons, and acts in the real world. Nearly all of it depends on compute, simulation, and data infrastructure like ours, and almost none of it has a settled public vocabulary yet. This role owns that story.

About the Role:

As Communications Manager, Physical AI, you will be the first dedicated communications owner for CoreWeave’s Physical AI business. You will define the narrative for an emerging category, build the proof points that make it credible, and run the media and thought-leadership program that puts it in front of customers, partners, and the press. You will work directly with the leaders of Physical and Scientific AI, with technical experts across product and engineering, and with the customers building on our platform — owning the work from strategy through execution rather than handing it to an agency. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role on an eight-person Communications team, with real influence over how an entire category gets defined.

In this role, you will:

• Own the Physical AI communications strategy — narrative, core messaging, proof points, and priority media map — and keep it consistent across leaders, launches, and external coverage.

• Lead communications for product, partner, and customer announcements, from integrated launch plan through earned-media outreach and post-launch measurement.

• Build and run an executive visibility and thought-leadership program for Physical AI leadership, spanning interviews, keynotes, bylines, podcasts, and industry events.

• Create a repeatable pipeline of customer and partner stories across robotics, autonomous systems, industrial applications, and scientific AI.

• Develop and sustain relationships with business, technology, and trade reporters covering AI infrastructure, robotics, and autonomy.

• Write the material the program runs on — press releases, pitches, blogs, bylines, briefing documents, talking points, Q&A, and messaging frameworks.

• Serve as communications counsel to Physical AI leaders on announcement strategy, timing, risk, and issues management, partnering with Legal and Policy as needed.

• Partner with Product Marketing, Content, Social, Brand, Sales, Business Development, Partnerships, Analyst Relations, and Investor Relations so one narrative holds across every channel.

• Measure program performance — coverage quality, message pull-through, share of voice — and use it to sharpen the next cycle.

Who You Are:

• 7+ years of B2B technology communications experience — in-house, agency, or a combination — including direct ownership of an earned media program.

• Demonstrated track record leading integrated product, partner, or customer launches end to end: strategy, cross-functional coordination, writing, pitching, and measurement.

• Demonstrated experience writing and placing press releases, pitches, bylines, blogs, and executive talking points on technical subject matter.

• Established relationships with business and technology media, or a documented record of building a beat from scratch in an emerging category.

• Experience providing direct communications counsel to senior executives, including announcement strategy, spokesperson preparation, and issues management.

• Experience translating technical subject matter — infrastructure, hardware, AI/ML, simulation, or comparable — into accurate narratives for non-specialist audiences.

• Experience owning multiple concurrent workstreams to deadline in a fast-moving environment, with hands-on execution rather than agency dependence.

• Experience with communications measurement, including coverage analysis, message pull-through, and share of voice.

Preferred:

• Experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, simulation, digital twins, industrial technology, scientific computing, or AI cloud infrastructure.

• Experience supporting technical founders, engineers, researchers, or product leaders as spokespeople.

• Global communications experience, including major industry events such as GTC, CES, Hannover Messe, or ICRA.

• Experience with analyst relations, policy communications, content strategy, or investor communications.

• A mix of in-house and agency experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds — even if you don’t check every box. Here are a few qualities we’ve found make someone successful on this team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

• You’re curious about how AI moves out of the data center and into machines that operate in the physical world.

• You’re an expert at finding the story inside technical work without overstating it — you ground narratives in customer evidence and business outcomes.

• You love owning a category before the market has agreed on what to call it.

• You have the judgment and the standing to tell a senior leader when an approach won’t land, and a better one to offer instead.

• You build structure where none exists yet and are comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $149,000 to $198,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Vedoucí týmu skladníků
jobs.description:
Opatovice nad Labem | krátký/dlouhý týden | 12hodinové směny



🚀 Rohlík otevírá úplně nový sklad v Opatovicích nad Labem. A hledáme nové kolegy, kteří budou u jeho rozjezdu od prvního dne.

Nejde o nástup do skladu, kde už je všechno roky zajeté. Budeš u toho, když nový provoz rozjíždíme, nastavujeme jeho každodenní fungování a postupně vychytáváme procesy tak, aby všechno šlapalo, jak má.

Hledáme nové kolegy, kteří se nebojí provozu, umí si udržet přehled a dokážou zorganizovat práci i lidi kolem sebe.

Pokud tě baví prostředí, kde se pořád něco děje, a nechceš trávit celý den za stolem, čti dál.




📦 CO BUDEŠ MÍT NA STAROSTI?

Budeš přímo v centru dění skladu. Podle aktuální situace budeš hlídat, kde je potřeba přidat, přesunout lidi nebo změnit priority tak, aby celý provoz běžel plynule.

Konkrétně tě čeká:

 - řízení toku skladu a rozložení práce během směny,

 - operativní organizace lidí a jejich přesouvání tam, kde jsou právě potřeba,

 - dohled nad klíčovými místy provozu a rychlé řešení vzniklých situací,

 - spolupráce s kolegy z příjmu, expedice a dalších částí skladu,

 - práce s provozními čísly a jejich převádění do konkrétních kroků,

 - hledání možností, jak nové procesy zjednodušovat a zlepšovat.

Poznáš přitom celý proces – od příjezdu zboží do skladu až po okamžik, kdy hotovou objednávku přebírá kurýr.




👀 KOHO HLEDÁME?

Nemusíš mít za sebou deset let v logistice. Důležitější pro nás je, jak přemýšlíš a jak funguješ mezi lidmi.

Sedneme si, pokud:

 - se dokážeš rychle rozhodnout a nezalekneš se dynamického provozu,

 - umíš si udržet klid a přehled, i když se kolem tebe děje několik věcí najednou,

 - dokážeš přirozeně zorganizovat lidi a jasně jim vysvětlit, co je potřeba udělat,

 - máš férový přístup a zároveň se nebojíš převzít odpovědnost,

 - čísla pro tebe nejsou strašák a umíš je spojit s tím, co se skutečně děje v provozu,

 - přemýšlíš nad tím, jak věci dělat jednodušeji a lépe.

Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky, výroby, retailu, gastronomie nebo jiného rychlého provozu je určitě výhodou. Pokud jsi ale šikovný/á a máš zkušenost s koordinací lidí odjinud, rádi se s tebou potkáme také.




⏰ JAK BUDEŠ PRACOVAT?

Čeká tě režim krátký/dlouhý týden a 12hodinové směny.

A počítej s tím, že tohle není kancelářská pozice. Většinu směny budeš tam, kde se něco děje – přímo v provozu mezi lidmi.




🥐 CO ZA TO DOSTANEŠ?

Kromě možnosti být u rozjezdu úplně nového skladu Rohlíku nabízíme:

 - Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma včetně 10% cashbacku v kreditech na další nákupy,

 - možnost placeného volna pro odpočinek a regeneraci,

 - dotované obědy,

 - kávu, čerstvé ovoce a další občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma,

 - 86 Kč na ošatné za každou odpracovanou směnu,

 - odměny za pochvaly od kolegů, které můžeš proměnit například za vouchery do Alzy nebo Notina,

 - příspěvek na Multisport kartu,

 - firemní akce a společné oslavy úspěchů.




💚 PROČ NASTOUPIT PRÁVĚ TEĎ?

Protože nový sklad se otevírá jen jednou.

Můžeš přijít ve chvíli, kdy se tým teprve tvoří, procesy se nastavují a tvůj názor i tvoje práce mohou ovlivnit, jak bude celý sklad v budoucnu fungovat.

A než se nový provoz naplno rozjede, rádi ti ukážeme i naše už fungující robotické sklady v Praze.

Chceš být u toho od začátku? Ozvi se nám. Nemusíš psát dlouhý motivační dopis – stačí nám dát vědět, kdo jsi, a rádi se s Tebou spojíme.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, HPC
jobs.description:
About Ossium

Ossium’s mission is to improve the health, vitality, and longevity of human beings through bioengineering. We develop, manufacture, and bank cell therapy products that apply the power of stem cell science to revolutionize treatment for patients with blood, immune, and orthopedic diseases.  At Ossium, we empower our employees, maintain the highest standards of operational excellence, and are a force for good.

About the Job

The Operations Manager, HPC leads the hematopoietic progenitor cell (HPC) production team that turns organ donor vertebral bodies into bone marrow and other cell therapy products. You will own the HPC value stream at our Indianapolis facility, from donor intake and allocation to cell processing and cryopreservation, and the supervisors and operators who run it across shifts. You will also lead the cross-functional Core Team that ensures reliable production of HPC, Marrow and work closely with Tissue Production, MSAT, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain. This is a hands-on leadership role in a cleanroom environment: you will spend real time on the floor, and you will also own the metrics, the investigations, and the plan for scaling the team.

Required Qualifications

• BS/BA in a technical field or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of manufacturing or related experience

• 3+ years in a formal people-leadership role

• Working knowledge of aseptic technique, cleanroom operations, and cGTP/cGMP requirements

• Experience owning deviations, investigations, and CAPAs, including root cause analysis

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present results to cross-functional stakeholders

• High level of attention to detail and the ability to operate with organization and urgency in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree in a relevant scientific discipline

• Direct experience managing teams in an aseptic manufacturing environment

• Trained in statistical process control and continuous improvement tools and methodologies

• Experience supporting FDA or other regulatory and accreditation inspections

• Experience with process validation and technology transfer from development into routine production

• Familiarity with lean or tiered daily management practices

Key Responsibilities

• Own daily HPC production output from donor intake through cryopreservation and initial inventory, ensuring every gift is used for its authorized purpose

• Manage HPC Production Supervisors across shifts, ensuring processes are scheduled with appropriately trained and qualified personnel

• Serve as operator, verifier, or trainer during clinical production as needed

• Develop and report production metrics such as throughput, yield, right-first-time documentation, deviation rate, and cycle time, and drive action where targets are missed

• Perform technical review of production batch records and ensure traceability of donor products through final disposition

• Write and oversee event reports, investigations, risk assessments, and CAPAs, including effectiveness checks

• Lead operational changes through project management, document creation, batch record revision, and risk assessment

• Serve as hiring manager for HPC production roles and oversee onboarding, qualification, and ongoing training for the team

• Serve as Core Team Leader for HPC, Marrow: own the Core Team charter, lead the daily meeting, set the agenda for weekly meetings, and drive cross-functional alignment across Production, Quality, Engineering, and MSAT

• Accountable for the Core Team balanced scorecard covering safety, quality, process control and capability, variability reduction, throughput, supply chain planning, productivity, training, and equipment reliability

• Keep the HPC process in control, capable, and compliant, prioritizing effectiveness before efficiency, and lead periodic formal process reviews and Annual Product Review feedback

• Establish the Core Team floor presence schedule and ensure development plans are in place for frontline supervisors and staff

• Partner with Tissue Production, MSAT, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Facilities on shared suites, materials, equipment, and process improvements

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to work in a moderately noisy environment

• Must be able to work around biohazardous materials and chemicals

• Required to work the majority of the shift aseptically in a controlled environment with limited breaks. This environment requires special gowning (ie. over the head, face, hands, feet and body).

• Must be able to lift, push, pull and/or carry up to 50 lbs

• Must have sufficient manual dexterity, hand/finger coordination, wrist mobility, wrist stability, and grip strength to handle, feel, grasp, manipulate, and operate objects, manual and power tools, equipment, and controls safely and accurately.

• Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, squat, balance, climb, stoop, kneel, crouch and reach with arms.

We offer a full slate of employee benefits including:

• Competitive salaries

• Stock options

• 401(k) matching

• Medical, dental and vision coverage

• Four weeks of PTO accrued (vacation & sick time) annually + 11 company holidays

• Employer paid life insurance and long term disability

• Gym membership/recreational sports reimbursements

The product portfolio will include da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies, Instruments and Accessories and Digital Solutions including Intuitive Hub, My Intuitive and SIMNOW.

This position will work collaboratively with Iberia and EU marketing, sales and ecosystem functions to drive utilization in targeted procedures for both portfolios.

You will have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills that will drive a collaborative and adaptable approach across business functions to execute on the commercial strategies.

• Build and leverage product management skillsets to manage the existing da Vinci Systems, Advanced Technology, I&A and Digital portfolios.

• Integrate the digital portfolio into the commercial teams, to drive awareness and adoption of the entire Intuitive Ecosystem in alignment with business goals.
• Engage key customers to create and develop reference centers to accelerate technology adoption and utilization of da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies and Digital solutions.
• Create clinical and economic reference stories (QTIs) and marketing collateral that articulates the value proposition associated with Intuitive’s technologies.
• Develop analytical, scalable tools to monitor the portfolio, competition, and opportunities, in collaboration with the Sales Operations Team, to leverage data that informs marketing and sales strategies and opportunities.
• Identify and scale best demonstrated practices through Key Opinion Leaders and the Field Sales team to improve regional variation in technology adoption and utilization.
• Identify and develop Product Champions for existing and newly launched products across surgical specialties.
• Collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders and European Product Marketing to develop localized value propositions and messaging for Intuitive’s technologies.
• Partner with European and Regional Marketing and Sales at conferences and tradeshows, Executive Education Events, Market Development Events, and Key Customer events, to deliver impactful product demonstrations (test-drives), technology presentations, and ensure the key product messaging is included in Intuitive-sponsored presentations and customer interactions.
• Grow Energy and Stapling utilization across the Spain & Portugal and support sales by implementing new sales tools and collateral.
• Develop and maintain procedural knowledge and key surgeon relationships by attending cases and collaborating with Regional and EU Marketing.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in life science or business discipline.
• Chartered Institute of Marketing or Advanced Diploma preferred.
• 8+ years’ experience within a medical device or therapeutic company.
• 4+ years of Clinical/Product marketing experience within a medical device or therapeutic company.

ABOUT WOODSTOCK LEGAL SERVICES:

Woodstock Legal Services isn’t your typical law firm. We’re breaking the mold – ditching the jargon, delivering expert advice, and doing things differently in the legal world. We've gathered our wisdom from years of legal experience and paired it with a willingness to break the mold.

At Woodstock, you’ll be part of a people-first culture where ideas are welcomed, collaboration is second nature, and your contribution really matters. We invest in our internal teams because we know they’re the engine that keeps everything running and we’re proud of the culture we’ve built together.

 

About Woodstock Legal Services & Lawhive Partnership

The Woodstock vision was to create a law firm that felt different, one where lawyers had true freedom and flexibility within a community of grade A lawyers and the best operational and regulatory support on offer - all while ensuring our clients remain our constant focus.

Since 2014, Woodstock has grown into a thriving community of lawyers, built on the principle that legal practice can be both professional and personal. We set out to create a place where lawyers have the freedom to shape fulfilling careers, and where clients benefit from clear, expert advice delivered with genuine care.

That vision remains at the heart of everything we do. By joining the Lawhive Group, we are strengthening this vision - combining the trusted relationships and values that define Woodstock, with innovative tools that ease the pressures of legal work. This means our lawyers can dedicate more time to what matters most: guiding and supporting our clients.



The Role 

We’re on the lookout for a bright, proactive, and organised Business Operations Manager to support our wider team. This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are the same. One minute you’ll be helping plan a company event, the next you’ll be supporting our onboarding process, chasing a tech issue, or pulling together documents for compliance.

You’ll be exposed to everything from HR and culture to finance, IT, events and operations – and you’ll learn a huge amount along the way. If you love being helpful, are happy to roll your sleeves up, and thrive in a busy environment, this could be a brilliant next step for you.



Responsibilities:

Culture & People

 - Help onboard new starters (employees and consultants), arranging welcome packs and training materials.

 - Assist with internal engagement initiatives, events and wellbeing campaigns.



Compliance & Risk

 - Support document management, compliance deadlines, and help maintain records for insurance, SRA requirements, and CQS accreditation.

 - Get involved in reviewing and updating internal policies.



IT & Tech

 - Be the friendly go-to for basic IT support and troubleshooting (don’t worry, you’ll have help).

 - Support the rollout of new software and systems across the firm.



Operations & Facilities

 - Help with everyday office coordination and estate management – from restocking supplies to chasing contractors or making the office look great for a client visit.

 - Support health and safety processes.

 - Governance and Risk support

 - HR admin



Finance & Accounts Support

 - Liaise with the accounts team to gather reports, track expenses, and assist with finance-related tasks and compliance.

 

Project & Event Support

 - Help organise internal projects, team events, and firm wide initiatives.

 - Support the marketing team with event logistics and operations admin.



About You

 - Some office, admin or customer service experience (but we’re open-minded!)

 - Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

 - Great communication - friendly, clear, and happy speaking with all sorts of people

 - A natural helper - someone who loves ticking things off and making life easier for others

 - A keen learner with a proactive, can-do attitude

 - Comfortable with tech, MS Office, and happy picking up new systems

 - Discreet, professional, and trustworthy with sensitive information



Benefits

✈️ 33 days’ annual leave (25 + bank holidays) plus your birthday off

🎄 Extended Christmas holiday

💰 Pension contribution

☮️ Give back - support a good cause with a charity day each year

⛳️ Regular socials/team events

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
If you’ve been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision of a world where doing good is built into everything we do, then you’ve found the right place.

Backed by General Catalyst, the same investors behind Stripe and Airbnb, we’re building something truly extraordinary.




OUR MISSION

Our mission at Goodstack is to revolutionize how the world does good 🌎.

As a fast growth, AI-native social impact startup, we power global change through technology. We enable companies to seamlessly integrate positive impact into what they do through a unified platform while supporting nonprofits in gaining access to cutting-edge technology and finding new funding streams.

Global brands, including Google, OpenAI, TikTok, LinkedIn, HSBC, Atlassian and Twilio - as well as thousands of nonprofits, including the Red Cross, Cancer Research, and Oxfam - use Goodstack to make a difference.

In 2025 alone, we facilitated $5 billion in donations to good causes. But this is just the beginning. We're building the world’s leading platform that powers donations to nonprofits globally.

To keep our momentum and deliver consistently high value to our partners, we need incredible people to help us on our journey – we need you 🫵




JOIN US AS CUSTOMER SUCCESS ASSOCIATE!

We are seeking a proactive, revenue-driven Customer Success Associate (CSA) to own the end-to-end customer journey for AgentPro, our AI-powered grant writing platform. You will ensure clients maximize value from our AI tools while coordinating with our grant delivery team to drive NPS, account retention, and growth.


AS CUSTOMER SUCCESS ASSOCIATE, YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

 - Onboard new accounts, lead product enablement sessions, and drive feature adoption so clients regularly use AgentPro's self-serve AI capabilities.

 - Act as the primary interface between clients and internal grant delivery specialists to ensure deadlines, quality benchmarks, and service agreements are consistently met.

 - Monitor usage metrics to mitigate churn risks, manage renewal pipelines, and surface expansion or upsell opportunities within existing accounts.

 - Serve as the key escalation point for client inquiries, friction points, and complaints, resolving operational issues or triaging technical bugs to internal teams efficiently.

 - Collect customer feedback and NPS data systematically, translating client insights into actionable product and delivery recommendations.


THIS ROLE IS A PERFECT MATCH FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE:

 - Any experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Services, preferably within nonprofits, B2B SaaS, AI/automation tools, or tech-enabled services.

 - Strong stakeholder management ability with clear written and verbal communication.

 - Proven experience handling client escalations, triaging issues under pressure, and driving fast resolutions.

 - Highly organised and detail-oriented.

 - Comfortable learning AI workflows and guiding clients on software self-sufficiency.


KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS):

 - Net Promoter Score (NPS).

 - Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Retention Rate (GRR), and Renewal Rate.

 - Monthly Active Users (MAU), self-service feature utilization rate, and Time-to-First-Value (TTFV).

 - Ticket triage response/resolution time and on-time grant delivery completion rate.




🇺🇸 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT UPON JOINING OUR TEAM

💰 Salary reviews and share options becoming an integral part of our growth and share in the company's success

💝 Goodstack’s Workplace Giving

⚕️Private Health Insurance

 🍽 On Tuesday, lunch is on Goodstack

🌞 $300 Brighten your day annual budget

🤓 $1,200 Learning & development annual budget

📚 Goodstack library

⭐️ Paid days off to volunteer for non-profit causes

🎤 Paid days to attend conferences

🥳 Paid day off on your birthday!

🌴 25 days annual leave, plus paid public holidays

💙 Paid sick leave

🧘🏽 Paid wellness leave

⚖️ Flexible working hours

🖥️ WFH budget upon joining

🌳 Ecologi Carbon Offsetting

🙌 … and so much more



ABOUT US

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.

Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.

Let's do this! 💜




OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We take pride in our diverse and growing team representing 20+ nationalities across 5 continents 🌍! Our continued expansion provides us with opportunities to embrace and celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, essential to our success. We actively seek and welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A team that represents the world that we are trying to support is a wiser, more knowledgeable and stronger one. We’re excited for you to bring your experience, yourself and your special lemon twist https://goodstack.io/blog to Goodstack to propel us forward in striving to create a better world for us all.

jobs.title: Medical Advisor Operations
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and pragmatic Medical Affairs professional to join AbbVie as a Medical Advisor Operations. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring medical materials meet all applicable legislation, regulations, and CGR guidelines. You will act as a subject matter expert in the material review process, collaborate closely with internal stakeholders. You will support the efficient execution of Medical Affairs activities and you will also help maintain and continuously improve Medical NL Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions, ensuring they remain aligned with evolving requirements and best practices. Your responsibilities will include:

Compliance:

• Serve as the primary contact person for medical review of materials.
• Establish and foster effective relationships with key stakeholders to facilitate seamless collaboration in the material review process.
• Be the content expert for the material review system and continuously improve system knowledge of medical and brand team partners.
• Ensure adequate understanding and knowledge of medical compliance within the teams involved in the approval process of materials.
• Provide regular training and/or case discussions to ensure knowledge of the teams stays up to date.
• Ensure Medical NL SOPs and WIs are in accordance with the latest legislation, self-regulation codes and internal procedures.
• Continuously work with key stakeholders to improve knowledge of legislation and self-regulation codes and increase agility in the material review process.

Medical Operations:

• Provide operational support to Medical functional priorities in alignment with the Head of Medical Operations & Patient Experience.
• Process Pre-Approval Access (PAA) requests, ensuring timely actions by different functions, timely release of investigational product and compliance with procedures and legislation.
• Maintain the local medical onboarding program so it aligns with local business needs and builds on existing MHI, CEX and HR resources.
• Keep medical peers updated on changes to affiliate SOPs, work instructions and guidelines.
• Actively identify opportunities to enhance efficiency of our medical processes and implement process improvements.
• Perform periodic monitoring to check adherence to Medical NL procedures.
• Where possible, be part of international initiatives in design and improvement of current and new systems.

We are looking for a person who has:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in pharmacy, life sciences or equivalent.
• Experience in material review and in-depth knowledge of CGR guidelines, legislation and regulations.
• Experience as medical advisor in the healthcare/pharmaceutical industry
• Fluent in Dutch and English (written/spoken).
• Excellent capabilities with standard IT office tools
• Strong analytical skills
• Pragmatic can-do attitude
• Flexible
• High level of accuracy and attention to detail
• Excellent interpersonal skills
• Seeks to simplify and remove bureaucracy
• Raises the bar and is never satisfied with the status quo

jobs.title: Account Specialist (Northern Cal)
jobs.description:
Location:  This is a remote-based role that requires flexibility and willingness to travel within a specified region and for company-related purposes as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success.

We are seeking driven and customer-focused Account Specialists to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. These individuals will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Do

• Execute territory business plans to achieve and exceed sales goals.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.

• Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.

• Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.

• Partner with Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Patient Services, and Medical teams to optimize customer and patient outcomes.

• Support launch execution, including pre-launch planning and post-launch adoption strategies.

• Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.

• Maintain a high level of product, disease state, and market knowledge.

• Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies.

How You Work

• You think in terms of systems, not silos.

• You balance rigor with speed, knowing when each matters most.

• You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.

• You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.

• You are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving impact for patients.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.

• Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.

• Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.

• Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.

• Experience selling into hospital systems, IDNs, and institutional accounts is a strong plus.

• Understanding of specialty pharmacy and hub services models.

• Demonstrated track record of strong, consistent performance against quota and territory goals.

• Evidence of execution against target metrics with year-over-year improvement.

• The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

To round out our world-class total rewards package, we provide annualized base salary in the range listed below.  This range reflects the base salary the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary

$160,000—$192,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to careers@praxismedicines.com.

Praxis does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

jobs.title: Sales Executive  - INK Hotel Amsterdam MGallery Collection
jobs.description:
Jij kent de hotelwereld van binnen en van buiten – en misschien nog belangrijker: zij kennen jou. Je weet precies hoe je sterke relaties opbouwt én benut, met een scherp commercieel instinct. Herken je jezelf hierin? Dan ben jij misschien wel de perfecte aanvulling op ons commerciële team!

The Script

Als Sales Representative krijg jij energie van het binnenhalen van nieuwe business en het sluiten van deals. Hospitality zit in jouw DNA en de Amsterdamse markt kent geen geheimen voor jou. Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opsporen én binnenhalen van nieuwe leads, met een specialisatie in corporate contracting.

Naast het aantrekken van nieuwe klanten, onderhoud je met plezier je eigen accounts en bestaande relaties. Je vertegenwoordigt INK Hotel Amsterdam op nationale beurzen en organiseert evenementen die klanten aan ons binden. Een standaard kantoorbaan is niks voor jou: liever bestel je na elke beurs een nieuwe lading visitekaartjes.

Een lege RFP-sheet? Geen sprake van. Jij bruist van de ideeën voor op maat gemaakte salestrajecten.

Je werkt in een compact, goed op elkaar ingespeeld team met een Sales & Marketing Manager, Marketing Executive, Reservations Representatives en een stagiaire. Jij denkt mee, helpt collega’s waar nodig en draagt bij aan gezamenlijke successen – want bij INK winnen we als team.

Collega’s en vrienden omschrijven jou als nieuwsgierig, reislustig en vol ontdekkingsdrang. Je bent een luisterend oor én een overtuigend spreker: onderhandelen is jouw tweede natuur.

Nog steeds aan het lezen?

Mooi! Dan wil je vast weten hoe het is om te werken als Sales Representative bij INK Hotel Amsterdam.

Allereerst kom je terecht in een hecht en divers team waar we zorgzaam, vastberaden en respectvol met elkaar omgaan. We creëren samen een veilige werkomgeving waarin iedereen verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen. Creativiteit en eigenheid krijgen volop ruimte, en we stimuleren het nemen van gedurfde beslissingen.

Persoonlijke groei vinden we belangrijk. We staan stil bij wat er in jouw leven speelt en bieden een uitgebreid trainingsprogramma aan.

Wil je meer weten? Wij kunnen niet wachten om je te ontmoeten!

Tick the box!

Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Sales Representative die met ons samen het verhaal van INK Hotel nóg succesvoller maakt. Herken jij jezelf in onderstaande punten? Dan willen we jou leren kennen:

• Je hebt een afgeronde commerciële hbo-opleiding.
• Je hebt ongeveer één tot drie jaar werk- of stage-ervaring in een salesfunctie.
• Je hebt een goede kennis van – en bij voorkeur een netwerk binnen – de hospitalitybranche in Amsterdam.
• Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels op zakelijk niveau.
• Je bent zelfverzekerd en hebt een flinke dosis doorzettingsvermogen.

What do you get from us?

• Een salaris volgens salarisschaal VI van de horeca cao – met een extra boost: Accor verhoogt deze schaal met maar liefst 7,5%!
• Korting op hotelovernachtingen en dineren bij alle Accor-hotels wereldwijd.
• 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis – tijd genoeg om zelf ook nieuwe plekken te ontdekken.
• Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 5 kilometer.
• Regelmatig gezellige borrels met je collega’s.
• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
• Altijd blijven leren: via de Accor Academy krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Sounds good?

We behandelen alleen sollicitaties die voorzien zijn van een CV én motivatiebrief. Heb je vragen? Neem dan gerust contact op met onze afdeling Human Resources via telefoonnummer 020 - 555 17 04 of stuur een e-mail via de sollicitatiebutton.

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager - Dallas, TX
jobs.description:
At Cortland, we operate with a forward-thinking approach that challenges conventional norms and actively seeks insights beyond traditional industry boundaries. As a recognized leader in the multifamily sector, our focus on performance, innovation, and disciplined execution continues to drive strong growth and market leadership. We are committed to building a best-in-class organization by empowering top talent with the resources, autonomy, and support needed to deliver results and advance their careers in a high-performance environment.

Role Overview

As a Regional Marketing Manager, you motivate and empower community teams while developing and executing lead‑generation campaigns, marketing programs, and strategic initiatives that support the multifamily communities in your portfolio.  Your work increases prospective resident engagement, strengthens brand presence across markets, and enables on‑site teams to convert leads more efficiently. You help ensure consistent marketing performance, elevate resident and prospect experience, and drive alignment between community operations and Cortland’s overall marketing strategy.  Your impact will result in higher‑quality leads, improved occupancy, stronger revenue performance, and more cohesive marketing execution across the portfolio—all contributing to Cortland’s growth and market leadership.

• Analyze submarket trends and results to develop a strategic marketing and advertising plan designed to drive qualified sales and leads

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

What You'll Own:

• Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them

• Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning

• Quality of your code and the areas you touch

• Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain

• Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform

• Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What You'll Do:

Feature Development

• Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently

• Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform

• Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated

• Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards

• Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly

• Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts

• Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

Production Ownership & Incident Response

• Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution

• Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution

• L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen

• Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build

• Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

Code Quality & Testing

• Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought

• Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive

• Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

• Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration

• Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools

• You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment

• L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use

• L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

Collaboration

• Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers

• Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions

• L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

• Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.

• Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

• L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.

• L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.

• L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.

• L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

On-Call:

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our Values are:

• Commit to Excellence

• Find a Way

• Help Each Other

• Keep Growing

• Data First

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.
