jobs.title: Live Operations Specialist - Gaming Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At i3D.net http://i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.


WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS

As a Live Operations Specialist - Gaming Infrastructure, you’ll be the first line of defense in keeping our services running smoothly for some of the biggest names in gaming. Whether it’s troubleshooting live incidents, monitoring systems, or tackling full-stack issues, your work ensures players worldwide have seamless gaming experiences.

This isn’t your typical NOC role - you’ll deal with everything from servers and networks to software and DDoS protection. What you do directly impacts millions of users globally.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Proactive Monitoring & Incident Management:

 - Keep live systems running 24/7, spotting and fixing issues before customers notice.

 - Troubleshoot problems across servers, networks, and software layers.

 - Update customers during incidents and resolve issues quickly.

 - Analyze root causes and escalate to teams or vendors if needed.

 - Provide hands-on support for remote data centers when required.

Change Management:

 - Manage planned and emergency changes affecting services.

 - Notify customers about maintenance and updates.

Continuous Improvement:

 - Automate routine tasks to save time and reduce errors.

 - Keep processes and documentation up to date and efficiently.




LOCATION & SHIFT STRUCTURE

This role is based in Alpharetta, Georgia, operating from our local office and your home office. You’ll work closely with colleagues in Rotterdam (the Netherlands) to ensure 24/7 service continuity.

 - Sunday to Wednesday or Wednesday to Saturday 

 - Day Shift: 10:00am to 8:00pm 

 - Evening Shift: 3:00pm to 1:00am

 - Hybrid: You’ll work from our Alpharetta office two days per week, depending on your shift rotation:
   
   - Sunday to Wednesday rotation: Tuesday and Wednesday 
   
   - Wednesday to Saturday rotation: Wednesday and Thursday


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR

 - You’re independently handling incidents and improving first-call resolution rates.

 - Tickets? Done fast, keep customers happy, and systems run smoothly.

 - You’ve shared ideas that make the team’s workflow more efficient.

 - You’ve picked up new tools and skills, leveling up your expertise.


YOUR PROFILE

 - NOC/LiveOps/Networking Expertise: You have at least 3 years of experience in a NOC, LiveOps, networking or similar operational role, handling live incidents, monitoring critical systems, and ensuring service uptime.

 - Strong Troubleshooter: You know Linux and Windows servers, logs, hardware alerts, and networking devices like routers and switches. You also understand the OSI model or DOD model and can explain (and ideally troubleshoot) APIs.

 - Customer Focused: You’re great at solving issues while keeping customers informed and happy.

 - System Sherlock: You thrive on solving tricky technical issues and finding root causes.

 - Location: We’re located in Alpharetta, Georgia, and you already live within a 40-mile radius of our office. 

 - Shift Ready: You’re comfortable working on a rotating shift schedule, including evenings and weekends and, of course, getting paid extra for it!


WHY JOIN US?

 - Global Exposure: We operate our own international backbone network, with a presence in over 60 locations worldwide.

 - State-of-the-Art Technology: Work with cutting-edge service providers and data center equipment.

 - Competitive Perks: Enjoy great pay, an annual bonus, 15 vacation days (excluding national holidays), travel allowance, and a premium-free pension.

 - Skill Development: Level up with career guidance and education reimbursement.

 - Gaming Perks: Get lifetime access to Ubisoft’s game library and two free games every year.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Editor)
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

We're building a best-in-class editor for ecommerce conversion, and we need someone to lead that team through it, not just staff it. This is a hybrid role: half technical team lead, half AI-native product thinker.

You won't just write code faster with AI tools. You'll understand how AI behaves inside a page builder — what it should generate, suggest, or automate for someone building a landing page or funnel to convert better — and you'll propose and build those features yourself. You'll also run the team: unblock engineers, make the calls when priorities conflict, and be the person who ships when no one else can.

This is not a hand-off role, and it's not a pure IC role either. You're accountable for the team's output and for your own.

What You'll Own:

• Technical direction for the editor, including how AI shows up inside the product (generation, layout suggestions, content assist, personalization — whatever we decide moves conversion)

• The team's delivery: sprint output, unblocking, code review quality, and stepping in to build when the team is stretched

• Incident response and production health for the editor

• Ramping and mentoring the rest of the team, including their AI tool usage

What You'll Do:

Team Leadership & Delivery

• Own sprint planning, task breakdown, and prioritization for the Editor 2.0 team

• Unblock engineers daily — technical blockers, ambiguous requirements, cross-team dependencies

• Personally pick up critical-path work when the team is short-handed — this role carries load, it doesn't just delegate it

• Run point on code review standards and technical decisions for the team's scope

AI-Native Product Judgment

• Understand how AI features behave inside a visual page/funnel builder — not just "use

• Copilot to write code faster," but "what should an AI content-suggestion feature do when a merchant drops a new block into their page, and does it actually help them convert"

• Propose concrete features: what AI should generate, what it should leave alone, where it fails silently vs. loudly

• Push back on AI-feature ideas that sound good in a slide but won't survive contact with real page-building workflows or move conversion

Code Quality & Testing

• Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought

• Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive

• Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

AI-Augmented Development

• Use AI coding tools daily — this is a baseline expectation, not a differentiator

• Set the standard for the team: what AI-assisted workflows actually save time vs. add cleanup work

• You understand everything you or the team ships — AI accelerates, it doesn't absolve you of the review

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

Must Haves

• 6+ years professional software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years in a lead or de facto lead capacity — owned technical direction for a team, not just senior IC work

• Hands-on experience in PHY

• Hands-on experience building consumer-facing web products at scale — page builders, website/funnel editors, or similarly complex WYSIWYG/visual editing tools strongly preferred

• Demonstrated track record shipping AI-powered product features, not just using AI coding tools

• Experience working directly with a PM on roadmap and feature definition, not just executing tickets

• Comfortable being the primary escalation point for production issues on their product area

Success Metrics:

First 30 days

• Ships their first meaningful feature to production and is running point on the team's sprint cadence

• Has proposed at least one concrete AI-feature idea grounded in real conversion data, not just intuition

Ongoing / steady-state

• Team ships against roadmap without the lead becoming the single point of failure — work continues if they're out for a week

• At least one AI-native feature they drove goes from idea → shipped, with a measurable lift in conversion (or a clear, honest read on why it didn't move the number)

• Engineers on the team are visibly leveling up their own AI-assisted workflows because of this person's standards, not just their own output

What This Role Is Not

• Not a pure people-manager role — this person writes code and ships features

• Not a "prompt AI tools all day" role — the AI fluency is table stakes, the differentiator is product judgment about AI inside the product

• Not a role for someone who needs a fully-scoped ticket queue — they should be generating the roadmap items together with the product manager, not just executing them

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our Values are:

jobs.title: [アルバイト] PC初期設定&アカウント管理
jobs.description:
アイデンティティセキュリティ基盤「JOSYS」について

Josysは、企業内のあらゆる認証情報（アイデンティティ）を統合的に管理・防御する、AI駆動のアイデンティティセキュリティ基盤です。従業員・業務委託先のアカウントに加え、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、人・AI・システムを横断して増加する認証情報を一元的に可視化し、守ります。

ダークウェブ起点の認証情報漏洩・感染端末の検知、AIエージェントの自動発見と管理、ポリシーにもとづくAIの自律型セキュリティ対応を中核に、SaaS統合管理で培ったアクセスガバナンスやライセンス最適化の機能を統合。権限管理やリスク対応を自動化し、セキュリティ人材不足のなかでも運用負荷を抑えながら、組織全体のアイデンティティを守ります。

Josysは、"すべてのアイデンティティ、すべてのアプリケーションを、AIで守る"ことを通じて、日本企業が安心して事業活動を行える環境づくりを推進してまいります。




解決する課題

コロナ以降、リモートワークが普及した結果、ITデバイスとSaaSはコロナ前に比べ爆発的に増加しました。今後はハイブリッドワークの更なる普及が想定され、ITデバイスとSaaSの管理の重要性がさらに増していくことは自明となっています。一方で、普及の速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これは日本だけでなくグローバルで発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。

ポストコロナのITガバナンス強化に今最も必要とされているのは、IT資産の "唯一の真実 (Single Source of Truth)" を作り、実現させることです。ジョーシスはこの世界を実現するサービス・ソリューションを提供しています。




日本発グローバル企業への挑戦

海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。




業務概要

幕張オペレーションセンター（WBG内）にて、クライアント企業のパソコン初期設定（キッティング）やクラウドサービスのアカウント管理（ID発行・削除など）を担当いただくオペレーションスタッフを募集します。

マニュアル完備かつ電話対応一切なし（チャットコミュニケーション主体）のため、未経験からでも安心してスタートできる環境です。子育てやプライベートと両立しながら、IT分野でのキャリアステップを目指せます。




業務内容詳細

クライアント企業のコーポレートIT（情報システム部）を支えるバックオフィス業務をご担当いただきます。

 - クラウドサービスのアカウント発行・管理
   
   - Google Workspace、Notion等、各種クラウドツールのアカウント作成・権限設定（専用管理画面でのシンプル入力作業）

 - PC初期設定（キッティング）
   
   - 新規導入PCのセットアップ、各種指定ソフト（メール・セキュリティ等）のインストール・設定作業

 - チャットツールを用いた業務連携
   
   - クライアントおよび社内メンバーとの連絡・業務進捗報告（Slack等のチャットツールを使用／電話対応なし）




このポジションの魅力

未経験からITの知識・スキルが身につく

 - マニュアルと先輩の丁寧なフォローがあるため、専門知識ゼロからITオペレーションのスキルを習得できます。最先端のAIを活用した業務効率化ノウハウに触れられる環境です。

充実した就労環境と福利厚生

 - 海浜幕張（WBG）の海が見える開放的なオフィス環境。服装・髪型・ネイル・ひげ自由で、自分らしく働けます。

 - 毎日のランチ代をサポートする「チケットレストラン（食事補助）」、フリードリンク（コーヒー・ウォーターサーバー完備）など待遇も充実。

ライフスタイルに合わせた柔軟な働き方

 - 急なお子様の体調不良や学校行事等によるシフト変更も、チームでカバーし合える安心のカルチャーです。都心と逆方向の「下り通勤」のため混雑ストレスもありません。

明確なキャリアアップ・正社員登用パス

 - 「一般スタッフ」からスタートし、「チームリーダー」、さらには「専門職（プリセールス/オンボーディング等）」や「正社員」への登用実績が多数あります。


求める経験


必須（MUST）

 - 基本的なPC操作ができる方（文字入力・タイピング、Web検索、ファイル保存ができるレベル）

 - 正確かつ丁寧にコツコツと業務を進めることが得意な方


歓迎（WANT）

 - Excel / Google スプレッドシートを用いたデータ編集・整理の経験

 - テクニカルサポート、ヘルプデスク、カスタマーサポート、事務等の経験

 - チームでのコミュニケーションや連携を大切にできる方


求める人物像

 - 今はアルバイトからスタートし、将来的にリーダーや正社員を目指してステップアップしたい方

 - 指示通りにこなすだけでなく、「もっと効率化できるのでは」と改善に関心を持てる方


勤務条件・待遇

 - 雇用形態： アルバイト・パート（※試用期間：3か月／条件変更なし）

 - 給与： 時給 1,200円 〜 2,500円

 - 昇給制度あり

 - 正社員登用実績あり ※ご経験やご志向に応じて、最初から正社員でのご提案を行う場合もございます

 - 勤務時間： 9:30〜18:30 の間（シフト制） ★現在、フルタイム（1日8時間・週5日など）でしっかり働き、将来的なキャリアアップを目指したい方を歓迎しています

 - 休日・休暇 完全週休2日制（土日祝）、夏季休暇、年末年始休暇

 - 勤務地： 幕張オペレーションセンター 千葉県千葉市美浜区中瀬2-6-1 ワールドビジネスガーデン（WBG）マリブウエスト 9F （JR京葉線「海浜幕張駅」徒歩4分）

 - 福利厚生・手当

 - 交通費支給（規定あり）

 - 各種社会保険完備（健康保険、厚生年金、雇用保険、労災保険）

 - チケットレストラン（食事補助制度）

 - コーヒーメーカー、ウォーターサーバー完備

 - 服装 / 髪型 / 髪色 / ネイル / ひげ自由




働く環境（MAKUHARI OPERATION CENTER）

海浜幕張は、都心と逆方向の「下り通勤」ゆえ、混雑の少ない通勤環境と、落ち着いた街並みが特徴です。

駅周辺には大型商業施設や飲食店も充実しており、少し歩けば海も近く、ゆとりある環境で仕事に集中できます。

慌ただしい都心から少し距離を置きながら、長期的に高いパフォーマンスを発揮しやすい環境です。

オペレーションは、単なる“裏方”ではありません。

サービス品質を支え、事業をスケールさせる重要な基盤です。

これまで現場で培ってきた経験を、今度は「事業を形づくる力」として活かしてみませんか。

幕張から、一緒に次のJosysをつくっていける方をお待ちしています。

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Onsite Recruitment Coordinator is responsible for providing client site support to the talent acquisition process lifecycle, from candidate attraction to post-hire activities. Additionally, the Onsite Recruitment Coordinator facilitates a variety of onsite logistical, relationship management, and customer service activities to service a client program or team.

Responsibilities:

As a Cielo Onsite Recruitment Coordinator supporting GE Vernova, you will be responsible for service excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. You will act as a brand ambassador, focusing on delivering exceptional talent while providing proactive and timely communication. This role supports high-volume production and logistics hiring within manufacturing environments.

• Work Location: Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India
• Work Setup: 3 days onsite
• Language(s): Proven ability to manage stakeholder relationships and deliver recruitment activities, with working proficiency in Gujarati and English for daily business communication
• Work Hours: Standard working hours aligned with business needs

Duties and Responsibilities

• Cultivate and manage relationships with current and potential hiring leaders as an onsite representative.
• Manage candidate and client onsite communications and utilize client location knowledge and discretion to coordinate set-up of interview rooms, including materials distribution, and act as a recruitment contact during interview process.
• Meet and greet interviewers and candidates, including briefing candidates with a review of the role, interview format, and client details.
• Facilitate and grow professional relationships with local universities/colleges and technical programs as well as other resources to share client career paths and hiring needs.
• Assist in the creation of recruitment marketing plans specific to client location with local recruitment and candidate generation expertise.
• Act as liaison with the client to resolve daily operational issues.
• Showcase a high level of understanding and become fully engrained in the client organization including relationships with client stakeholders and organizational structure to further demonstrate “We Become You”.
• Provide professional recruitment resource for visitors, vendors, and candidates as necessary.

• Coordinate background, drug, and reference checking processes.
• Arrange candidate travel, transportation, and accommodation.

• Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, including Outlook, required.
• Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
• Ability to work in dynamic and constantly changing environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYMBIOTIC

 

Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.

By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.

As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.


Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund http://Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.



See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi http://symbiotic.fi

 


OUR PEOPLE

 

We’re a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.

We’re looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Lead the product design function collaborating closely with Leadership, Engineering, Product and Marketing teams 

• Design the full user journey for Symbiotic's product stack making onchain complexity legible and optimising for clean user flows.

• Surface risk, exposure, and returns so users understand what they're committing to and what happens when conditions change.

• Run user research. You'll interview users, watch how they actually behave, and turn what you find into concrete feature scopes engineering can build from.

• Partner closely with Engineering to define problems, weigh tradeoffs, and design within real protocol constraints rather than around them.




WHO YOU ARE



• Deep on-chain fluency: wallets, approvals, signing, gas, transaction lifecycle, chain latency — and a working understanding of how each one constrains what's designable.

• You've shipped a DeFi product to real users, and you can point to it

• A portfolio showing end-to-end product work — systems-level thinking alongside obsessive detail.

• Track record of operating autonomously in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with limited oversight.

• Comfortable without scaffolding: no design team, no design system to inherit, no one queuing your work.

• You run your own research rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

• Excellent cross-functional communication — you can partner closely with Engineering and hold a position under scrutiny.

• Deep fluency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows.

jobs.description:
About ThriveCart

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location

Remote (Latin America)

Job Overview:

You'll own quality end-to-end for ThriveCart's e-commerce platform — test strategy, automation, defect prevention, and production health monitoring. This isn't a click-through-test-cases role: you own quality for your domain.

AI is a core part of the workflow here, not a bonus skill — for generating test cases, creating test data, drafting test plans, and accelerating automation. What we're hiring for is judgment: knowing which tests actually matter, understanding risk, and thinking critically about AI-generated output.

This description spans L1–L4. Interview depth and expectations scale with level — see Qualifications & Expectations by Level below.

What You'll Own:

Test Strategy & Planning

• Own the quality strategy for your features and domain: test plans, risk assessment, coverage decisions

• Flag ambiguities and testability gaps during requirements review, before code is written — shift-left quality

• Define acceptance criteria in partnership with Product

• Balance manual exploration with automated regression coverage

• Document test plans, coverage decisions, and known risk areas for async visibility across the team

Test Automation

• Write and maintain automated tests (API, integration, end-to-end) using the team's frameworks

• Keep automation suites fast, reliable, and maintainable — flaky tests are yours to fix, not ignore

• Maintain CI/CD integration for test execution

• L3+: Design and evolve the overall test automation architecture

Production Quality & Incident Response

• Monitor features in production using observability tools — quality doesn't end at release

• Respond to dev-escalations and incidents with urgency: assess blast radius, run targeted regression testing, help isolate root cause, communicate findings clearly

• L3+: Own incident response from the quality side — lead triage, coordinate regression testing, write post-mortems with defect analysis, drive preventive fixes

• L4+: Coordinate all QA activity during major incidents, communicate to stakeholders, ensure systemic fixes are validated before release

AI-Augmented QA (Expected, Not Optional)

• Use AI tools daily: generating test cases and data, drafting test plans, analyzing bug patterns, accelerating automation writing

• AI will generate more test cases than you need — prioritize ruthlessly based on risk

• Review all AI-generated test output critically: AI has no product context, you do

• L3+: Teach junior QAs effective AI workflows for testing; establish team AI quality standards

• L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate tools, measure impact on coverage and velocity

Defect Advocacy & Communication

• Write clear, reproducible bug reports that developers can act on immediately

• Advocate for quality: flag risks before release, document known issues, be explicit about what is and isn't tested

• L3+: Partner with Product and Engineering on quality metrics, track trends

Collaboration

• Work closely with developers to improve testability at the code level

• Help developers write better unit tests by identifying untested scenarios

• L3+: Mentor L1/L2 QAs on testing mindset, automation skills, and risk thinking

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

• Testing: API testing (Postman/REST clients), browser automation (Playwright), unit/integration test frameworks

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions (tests run on every PR)

• Observability: AWS CloudWatch, application logs, metrics dashboards

• Platform stack: PHP/TypeScript, Ruby/TypeScript, MariaDB, Redis, AWS

• Playwright is our standard framework for browser automation — what matters most is strong testing fundamentals

Must-haves:

• Strong testing fundamentals — test strategy, test case design, risk-based prioritization

• Hands-on automation experience with Playwright

• Comfortable with API testing (Postman/REST clients) and reading application logs

• Already using — or genuinely motivated to use — AI tools in a QA workflow

• Clear written communication: bug reports and test plans others can act on without a meeting

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience testing an e-commerce, payments, or subscription platform

• Familiarity with PHP, TypeScript, or Ruby codebases

• AWS/CloudWatch or similar observability tooling

• GitHub Actions or another CI/CD pipeline

Qualifications & Expectations by Level

• L1 (Junior QA) — 0–1 yrs: Executes test plans, writes simple automation with guidance, reports bugs clearly. Bootcamp, internship, or early professional QA experience is fine — we're hiring for rigor and curiosity over tenure. Uses AI to learn faster and generate test cases; validates all AI output.

• L2 (QA Engineer 1) — 1–3 yrs: Has independently owned quality for a feature or product area — not just extended someone else's test plan or suite, but built one. Writes comprehensive test plans and automation, and responds to incidents with targeted testing.

• L3 (Senior QA) — 3–6 yrs: Has led incident response from the QA side and mentored other QAs. Owns quality strategy for complex projects, improves automation architecture and infrastructure, and uses AI to multiply output rather than just speed up individual tasks.

• L4 (Lead QA) — 6+ yrs: Has set QA standards or practices for a team, not just followed them. Serves as the quality authority for a domain, drives major incident response, and partners with leadership on quality metrics and AI tooling strategy.

Success Metrics

• 30 days: First test plan written and approved, first automated tests in CI pipeline, understands the most critical user journeys

• 60 days: Independently owning quality for a feature, automation suite stable, first incident response contribution

• 90 days: Contributing to test strategy discussions, handling dev-escalations independently in your area

On-Call

Shared rotation with engineering (~1 week/month after ramp-up). QA on-call focuses on blast radius assessment and regression testing during incidents.

Career Path

Junior QA → QA Engineer 1 → Senior QA → Lead QA → Head of Quality

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

• Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.

• User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.

• Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.

• Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: Premium Cash Officer
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Being close to our customers and agents is fundamental for us. If you thrive on customer interaction and have a knack for managing liquidity, the Premium Cash Officer position might be a perfect fit. As a Premium Cash Officer within our premium agency, your primary responsibility would be overseeing the agency's operations.

In this role, you’ll;

• Manage cash in and out between the Safe and PCA accounts.

• Hold end-of-day bill counting and produce a daily bill counting statement.

• Ensure that all cash management transactions are correctly recorded in the treasury system.

• Promptly request sufficient funds to ensure rebalance with agents/clients.

• Ensure transactions with cash-in-transit companies (Cash in/Cash out).

• Report discrepancies or challenges encountered by Premium Cash Assistants.

• Report fake bills to management.

• Ensure that furniture and materials are in good use and that the office is well secured.

• Manage and, if needed, escalate relevant feedback to management that may impact the agency's activity.

Key details

• Location: Kinshasa or Congo Central.

• Work authorization in DRC is required.

• This is a permanent position.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience as a cashier in cash management, reconciliation, liquidity management, cash handling, or delivery.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or an equivalent.

• Strong proficiency in French.

• Previous experience in front-office customer service or in the banking sector.

• Be very vigilant, detail-oriented, and have strong integrity.

• Knowing Wave products is an added value.

• Speaking English and a local language is an added advantage.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.

• Love owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.

• Are intellectually curious and creative in the way you go about tackling problems.

• Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination.

• Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Specialist, Americas
jobs.location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States; Palo Alto, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Ahrefs

Ahrefs is an all-in-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.

We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We’re multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast-moving, low-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.

The role

We’re looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs.

That’s the whole job, and it’s a big one. You’ll take a brand-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you’re who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days.

You’ll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It’s a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong.

This role is based out of one of our offices, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). You can be based in whichever you have the legal right to work in, but this is an on-site role. You’ll serve customers across the Americas.

What you’ll do

• Run hands-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works.

• Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing.

• Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers.

• Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can’t to the right people internally.

• Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first.

• Feed real customer friction back to Product.

Must have

• 3-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands-on post-sale role at a SaaS company.

• Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You’ve owned a go-live, not just supported one.

• Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847.

• The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing.

• Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

• The ability to figure things out independently.

• AI must be a part of your daily workflow.

• A “first do it, then do it right, then do it better” mentality. The tenth implementation should be faster or smoother than the first.

Nice to have

• Working knowledge of SEO: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks. You don’t need to be a practitioner, but you should know what a customer means when they say their crawl budget is a problem.

• Hands-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform.

• Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale.

• Experience working next to an account management or CS function.

What success looks like

In 6 months: you’ll be running enterprise implementations independently, start to finish. Account Managers will be routing technical questions to you by default rather than escalating them upward.

In 1 year: you’ll be the person who knows more about how enterprise customers deploy Ahrefs at scale than anyone else in the company. You’ll have a clear process and a view of where implementation should be automated rather than repeated.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we’ll let you know.

Location: Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

jobs.title: Social Content and Community Manager
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Social Content and Community Manager to shape how Harvey shows up in the feed and in the conversations that happen around it. You'll turn launches, product news, and company thinking into sharp, native content across our owned channels and our employees' channels. When we amplify a moment, it should land everywhere our people and audiences are.

You'll also own Harvey's social communities day to day. That means managing DMs, comments, and mentions; moderating and growing our community spaces; sending questions and opportunities to the right teams; and starting conversations that draw people toward Harvey. This role combines craft and community. It's for someone who writes fast and well, runs engaged communities with care and good judgment, and understands that on social, the caption, the reply, and the timing are the work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Write scroll-stopping copy for Harvey's owned channels (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and emerging platforms), tuned to what performs on each.

 - Write copy for employee and advocacy channels to power company amplification. Give the team ready-to-post language that makes company moments land while keeping a consistent Harvey point of view.

 - Turn a single launch or announcement into a set of channel-native posts, threads, and replies that work together across audiences.

 - Work closely with the Social Manager to plan, draft, and deliver social creative and campaign content.

 - Keep a steady content calendar that balances planned campaigns with timely, real-time posts.




COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT

 - Own the social inbox: monitor and respond to DMs, comments, and mentions across Harvey's channels quickly, warmly, and with good judgment.

 - Build and maintain response guidelines, tone standards, and saved replies for common questions so Harvey's voice stays consistent at scale.

 - Set up and run triage and escalation paths. Route customer support issues, sales inquiries, press requests, partnership opportunities, and sensitive or legal matters to the right internal teams, and close the loop.

 - Moderate Harvey's social communities and comment sections. Enforce community guidelines and deal with spam, trolling, and negative sentiment calmly and consistently.

 - Proactively join relevant conversations across the legal, legal tech, and AI communities to build relationships, raise Harvey's profile, and spot opportunities.

 - Find, engage, and grow a network of customers, advocates, and creators. Highlight their stories and user-generated content where appropriate and approved.

 - Run social listening to track brand mentions, sentiment, competitor activity, and emerging trends, and share key insights with Marketing, Product, Comms, and Customer Success.

 - Act as the first line of defense on social for brand safety. Flag potential issues early and help carry out response plans during sensitive or fast-moving moments.
   
   
   
   
   MEASUREMENT AND OPTIMIZATION

 - Track and report on content performance and community health, including engagement, response times, sentiment, follower growth, and conversation volume.

 - Use performance and engagement data to sharpen content, hooks, and response approach over time.

 - Share recurring themes from the community, such as questions, feedback, and pain points, to inform content strategy, product messaging, and FAQs.
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 3+ years in social content, community management, or a similar role, ideally at a high-growth tech, AI, or legal-focused company, or in a fast-moving brand or agency environment.

 - Exceptional short-form writing and editorial judgment, with a portfolio of content and community engagement that earned attention.

 - Hands-on experience managing a brand's social inbox and online communities, including moderation, escalation, and response workflows.

 - A real feel for internet culture, online communities, and what makes content and conversations travel.

 - Range as a voice chameleon: you can write as the brand and for employees without losing the through-line.

 - Comfort living in the replies and handling DMs, comments, and mentions with speed, warmth, and good judgment, including difficult or sensitive exchanges.

 - Sound judgment about confidentiality, customer privacy, and when to escalate rather than respond.

 - Ability to move quickly on real-time moments while keeping quality and brand safety high.

 - Strong organization and follow-through. You can manage a high volume of conversations and requests without dropping threads.

 - Experience with social management, scheduling, and listening tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Brandwatch, or similar).

 - Comfort using analytics and engagement data to decide what you write and how you engage next.

 - A collaborative approach and experience working across Marketing, Comms, Customer Success, Sales, and Legal.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in legal tech, enterprise SaaS, or similar B2B spaces.

 - Background in copywriting, journalism, or editorial.

 - Experience running an engaged personal or brand account.

 - Experience building or managing a professional community, advocacy program, or creator/ambassador program.

 - Experience supporting crisis or issues management on social.

 - Interest in AI and responsible communication.





COMPENSATION

$112,000 - $154,000 USD

jobs.title: Facilities Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Thndr is scaling Facilities Management from a reactive support function into a structured, professional operation.

As a Facilities Coordinator, you’ll be the execution arm of the FM team - owning the day-to-day operations that keep our offices running smoothly. You’ll be the go-to person for maintenance requests, vendor follow-ups, workplace issues, supplies, and day-to-day facilities needs across our floors.

You’ll work closely with the FM Manager, taking ownership of the operational details and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, while giving the wider FM team more room to focus on strategic projects such as space planning, access control, compliance, and workplace improvements.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, responsive, proactive, and comfortable dealing with multiple small fires while keeping the bigger picture in view.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the day-to-day facilities helpdesk and ticketing queue - logging, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving requests within SLA.

 - Coordinate with vendors and contractors across cleaning, maintenance, security, catering, and other workplace services to ensure issues are resolved on time and to the expected standard.

 - Conduct regular walkthroughs across all floors to identify maintenance, safety, cleanliness, or workplace issues before they escalate.

 - Follow up with vendors on schedules, quotations, service quality, and issue resolution, including negotiating basic service terms when needed.

 - Support the procurement of facilities supplies and consumables, including inventory tracking, stock checks, and reordering.

 - Assist with office moves, seating changes, minor space setups, and other workplace changes.

 - Maintain accurate records of facilities assets, contracts, vendors, maintenance schedules, inventory, and ongoing requests.

 - Support the execution of FM initiatives under the FM Manager’s direction, such as access control rollouts, AV setups, fire safety requirements, and other workplace projects.

 - Act as the on-the-ground point of contact for employees on facilities-related questions and requests.

 - Keep track of open issues and follow through with the relevant stakeholders until they are fully resolved.

 - Help the FM team move from reactive firefighting toward a more proactive and structured way of managing workplace operations.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 1–3 years of experience in facilities, office management, workplace operations, or operations coordination.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple open tasks simultaneously without losing track of details.

 - A strong ownership and follow-up mindset - you don’t just raise a request, you make sure it gets resolved.

 - Comfortable working with vendors and contractors and negotiating basic service terms when needed.

 - Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, particularly for tracking inventory, tickets, budgets, and operational data.

 - Clear and professional communication skills in both Arabic and English.

 - Comfortable being physically present on-site and responding to real-time workplace issues.

 - Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm when priorities change or unexpected issues come up.

 - A proactive mindset - you notice problems, flag them early, and take action without waiting to be asked.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working within a structured Facilities Management or Workplace team.

 - Experience managing a facilities helpdesk, ticketing system, or SLA-based service requests.

 - Experience working with multiple vendors and contractors.

 - Experience supporting office moves, seating plans, or workplace projects.

 - Exposure to access control, AV, fire safety, or other workplace systems.

 - Experience in a corporate, fintech, technology, co-working, hospitality, or facilities-services environment.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We’re building Facilities at Thndr into a structured operation that enables everyone else to do their best work.

The Facilities Coordinator is at the center of that transformation. You’ll own the day-to-day execution that keeps our offices running — from getting a maintenance issue resolved, to making sure supplies are available, to coordinating vendors and supporting workplace projects.

This role gives you the opportunity to build real ownership across workplace operations while working closely with an experienced FM team and seeing the impact of your work every day.

If you’re someone who likes getting things done, keeping operations organized, solving problems on the ground, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this is your chance to help build the operating backbone of Facilities at Thndr.




WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry - In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience - Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering - Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

JOB OVERVIEW

Provide services and support as a Senior Health Physicist II [ProSidian Strategic Resourcing and Professional Staff Augmentation for Health Physics (HP) Solutions and Services] aligned with the Health Physics (HP) Functional Area / Swim Lane / Category Discipline in the Nuclear And Environmental Management Industry Sector.

This role focusses on Human Capital | Project Management | Engineering | Environmental | Compliance | Risk Management | IT Effectiveness | Business Process | Training Knowledge Management Solutions for clients such as Savannah River Mission Completion, LLC (SRMC) | SRMC Supply Chain / Procurement supporting the Liquid Waste Program under DOE prime contract 89303322DEM000068 Generally Located In Aiken, South Carolina and across the Southeast | South Atlantic | CONUS Region (Of Country/World) Working On-Site (Client Site).

Provide Health Physics (HP) Services and Solutions as a ProSidian Engagement Team Member working in a capacity that Supports health physics activities through planning, analysis, coordination, documentation, compliance, quality assurance, and stakeholder support..  Lead radiological design and control decisions that minimize exposure and protect workers, communities, and the environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES - Senior Health Physicist II | Health Physics (HP) [L00400]

Safety is a primary responsibility in each job performed. Obtain safety training, obey safety rules, and make safety an integral part of each task. Take necessary steps to stop work if continuing the activity is unsafe or will create and unsafe condition.

• Applies advanced radiological Engineering and health physics principles learned through formal education and significant work experience for multiple large facilities/projects.
• Provides advanced technical, operational, and regulatory guidance on the company’s Radiological Protection issues.
• Performs complex assessments, calculations, and/or monitoring to determine the proper radiological controls and shielding required to meet or exceed company/regulatory standards, while considering the economic impacts.
• Prepares technical documentation and models to support calculations.
• Stays current on facilities, Project s, processes, and regulatory procedures.
• Serves as subject matter expert (SME) for radiation protection procedures that perform complex radiological calculations, calibrations, data reviews, regulatory reviews, and assessments.
• Performs research and analyzes new equipment to developed cost-effective solutions and improvements.
• Manages (tracking, estimating, etc.) and communicates changes to assigned schedule.
• Conducts peer review of complex tests and calculations for validity.
• Provides briefings, presentations, technical papers, reports, and lectures to company’s internal stakeholders.
• Represents the group in meetings based on familiarity with Code of Federal Regulations, DOE Orders, 5Q RadCon Manual and Site Engineering Standards.
• Reviews and approves design drawings to ensure verified calculations have been included.
• Performs field walk downs as deemed necessary to ensure implementations are performed to calculated design.
• Functions as Radiological Engineer/Health Physicist lead or (SME) within company.
• Performs hazard assessments by conducting Engineering evaluations for Project s deemed to have detrimental effects to the company if proper radiological controls are not implemented.
• May guide less experienced professionals.
• Other duties as assigned. The responsibilities provided above are intended to describe the primary elements of the job as a whole and not describe any one position in its entirety.

Desired Qualifications For Senior Health Physicist II | Health Physics (HP) [L00400] Candidates:

• Master’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physics or applicable science or Engineering discipline from an accredited college or university and 3+ years relevant professional experience OR;
• Bachelor’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physic

Education / Experience Requirements / Qualifications

• Master’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physics or applicable science or Engineering discipline from an accredited college or university and 3+ years relevant professional experience OR;
• Bachelor’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physics or applicable science or Engineering discipline from an accredited college or university and 5+ years relevant professional experience
• US Citizen
• Master’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physics or applicable science or Engineering discipline from an accredited college or university and 3+ years relevant professional experience OR;
• Bachelor’s degree in nuclear Engineering, health physic

This position aligns with functional and technical requirements in the Nuclear And Environmental Management Sector and Senior Health Physicist II Candidates principally support Health Physics (HP) Functional Area / Swim Lane / Category Disciplines.

Skills Required

• Primarily focused on Management and Financial Consulting, Acquisition and Grants Management Support, and Business Program and Project Management Services initiatives and aligned with Program Support activities Health Physics (HP) Functional Area Activities.
• Advanced dose and shielding analysis; ALARA; radiological design; contamination control; technical bases; DOE/ANSI requirements; mentoring

Competencies Required

• Senior scientific judgment; conservative decision making; safety leadership; communication; technical authority

Ancillary Details Of The Roles

• SRMC Job Grade: 68
• Client preferred qualifications:
• - Masters of Science degree in Nuclear Engineering, Health Physics or related Engineering or scientific discipline
• Thorough knowledge of health physics concepts, principles and techniques; general knowledge of related disciplines.
• Working knowledge of Code of Federal Regulations, DOE Orders, and ANSI standards that provide guidance and requirements for radiation protection programs.
• Familiarity with MCNP, SCALE, Origen ARP, MicroShield, and HOTSPOT codes.

Other Details

Provides technical guidance in support of company radiological designs and modifications. Calculates, analyzes, establishes, and incorporates proper radiological protection controls to prevent or minimize adverse effects to onsite personnel, the surrounding public, and the environment.

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Specialist (Ukrainian language proficiency required)
jobs.description:
Who Are We?
Welltech is a global wellness technology company with Ukrainian roots. Our mission is to build and scale wellness apps globally through state-of-the-art, tech-driven performance marketing.

We are one of the most established players in the wellness app space, and we are accelerating. Over 25.5 million people across the world use our apps — Muscle Booster, Yoga-Go, and WalkFit — to build healthier habits, move more, and feel better every day. Every subscription represents a real person making a real change in their life, and we take that seriously.

With 500+ people across hubs in Cyprus, Ukraine, Poland, Spain, and the UK, we combine the scale of a market leader and the drive of a team that's just getting started.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you'll take ownership of core treasury operations that are essential to the smooth running of a global business. You'll work across banking, KYC, liquidity support, and treasury administration, while also acting as a reliable backup across broader treasury activities. Beyond day-to-day treasury operations, you'll have the opportunity to lead and implement automation and AI initiatives that improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of treasury processes. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to deepen their expertise in true treasury work while also driving meaningful process and technology improvements in an international environment.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 


BANKING AND TREASURY OPERATIONS

 - Manage relationships with banking partners across multiple jurisdictions

 - Support bank onboarding, account opening, account maintenance, and related documentation

 - Coordinate KYC and other compliance requirements with financial institutions

 - Administer banking platforms, including user access, signatories, and security controls


CASH AND LIQUIDITY MANAGEMENT

 - Monitor daily cash positions across the group

 - Support cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning

 - Help ensure efficient allocation of funds across entities and markets

 - Partner with internal teams on cash planning and payment-related activities


INVESTMENTS, FX, AND REPORTING

 - Support short-term liquidity placements in line with treasury policies

 - Assist with monitoring investment activity, performance, and reporting

 - Support foreign exchange transactions and track currency exposures

 - Prepare treasury reports for management and key stakeholders, including cash position, liquidity, and forecast reporting


SYSTEMS, CONTROLS, AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

 - Help administer and improve the Treasury Management System

 - Ensure bank connectivity, user management, and data quality are maintained

 - Support internal and external audit requests related to treasury activity

 - Identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, strengthen controls, and increase automation

 


REQUIRED SKILLS:

 


MUST HAVE:

 - 3+ years of experience in treasury or a closely related finance function

 - Hands-on experience with banking operations, cash management, and cash flow forecasting

 - Experience managing KYC, bank documentation, and bank relationship support

 - Understanding of payment flows, approval processes, ERP-driven finance operations, and treasury controls.

 - Identify and lead opportunities to improve treasury processes, strengthen controls, and implement automation and AI solutions.

 - Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial data and reporting

 - Ukrainian fluency is mandatory and English proficiency B2 is essential.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in an international or multi-entity business

 - Exposure to foreign exchange, short-term investments, or a Treasury Management System

 - Familiarity with international banks and multi-jurisdiction operations
   
    

 


CANDIDATE JOURNEY

⭕️ Recruiter call --> ⭕️ Meet a team member --> ⭕️ Skills assessment--> ⭕️ Meet the Leadership team

jobs.title: Retail Assistant - Midland
jobs.description:
Want to kick-start your career? Join our outstanding retail team as a Store Assistant at ALDI! No retail know-how needed. We're looking for people with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn!

Our stores are open every day, including weekends and holidays – there's never a dull moment with plenty of variety. We do supermarkets a bit differently, you’ll get to experience all areas of the store rather than just be in one area, giving you lots of variety.

Store Assistants are the backbone of our retail stores and keep our stores running by:

• Being a customer service superstar and serving customers at the registers with a smile.
• Keeping shelves stocked with products so that our customers can find all their favourites.
• Being an expert in stock handling by making sure our products are in date and listed at the right price.
• Creating eye-catching displays of our ALDI special buys.
• Keeping the store tidy, organised and looking great.

• Enjoy a fantastic hourly rate of $32.76 + shift allowances.
• Full weekend availability will be advantageous.
• Join a top-notch retail team – we're an "Employer of Choice" seven times over.
• Be part of a company with purpose - we’re committed to sustainability for our planet, positively impacting our communities, supporting our farmers and suppliers and giving our customers a richer life for less.
• Average of 15- 25 hours per week.
• Our team aren’t casuals - benefit from permanent part-time perks, including paid leave, parental leave and sick leave.
• Start your retail career with us with extensive training and career opportunities with over 80% of our store management roles filled internally.
• Work in a friendly and supportive environment with small teams.
• Boost your well-being with the MyALDI Wellbeing program with discounted access to Fitness Passport and health insurance.
• Support during life’s most important moments including paid parental leave, superannuation on parental leave, up to 5 days paid compassionate leave, natural disaster leave, emergency services leave etc.
• Need support? Our confidential Employee Assistance Program is available to you and your family, free of charge.
• Don't worry about aches and pains – we offer free physiotherapy for non-work-related issues.

At ALDI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and identities. To learn more, please visit aldicareers.com.au

With the opportunity to make a real difference to real people, ALDI is a place you’ll feel proud to work.

jobs.title: Data Collection Analyst (Support)
jobs.description:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?

• Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
• Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
• The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
• Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.

Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Working in Fast Data Support, the focus of the department is to assure the quality of the product collected by the Scouts, being the first line of quality control and a support for the all the Scouts across the globe.

Being a Supporter Multi Sport is mainly about maintain the focus around the Data Collection from Scouts, controlling the quality of the product, being able to support the Scouts and be the 1st Level of Support, managing the quality of the product. As a Supporter you must be able to switch from one sport to the other and easily adapt to the particularities of it without compromising the quality of the product. You will also be part of projects relevant to the Fast Data world, actively participating and providing ideas for the upcoming projects.

Responsibilities:

Transform visual sports information inputs into Data

Correcting and adjusting scores and statistics during the game confirming the correctness of events

Supporting scouts and comparing Scouts data to live tickers and tv pictures

Communicating with a team of Scouts, Supporters and Administrators

Work and collaborate on the projects running on the Fast Data world

Required Qualifications:

Fluent English

In-depth sports knowledge

Good organizational skills

Ability to work under pressure on a fast-paced environment

Team player but also able to work independently.

Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

jobs.title: Immigration Attorney
jobs.description:
Salary: $150,000 - $175,000 + share options + bonus

Location: New York City, Austin, Arizona




ABOUT LAWHIVE

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.

We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter. 

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

 



THE ROLE

As an Immigration Attorney at Lawhive, you will manage a high-volume portfolio of immigration matters focused on the Immigration needs of families and small businesses, such as Family Petitions, Adjustments to Status, Naturalization, Fiancé Visas, TN and E2 Visas as well as general advisory work. In addition to core immigration work, you will partner closely with our Product and Engineering teams, acting as a subject matter expert to help shape our AI-powered legal platform. Acting as a key part of the feedback loop between our users and tech teams, you will advise on key product features and workflows to help ensure our tools reflect real-world immigration practice. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on immigration work and is excited about the impact of AI on the legal system.

 - Manage a portfolio of immigration matters from start to finish

 - Advise clients on legal merits, potential outcomes, and next steps.

 - Prepare & file a wide range of different US visa applications

 - Define limited scope product offerings for small business and family Immigration needs.

 - Assist in collaborating with co-counsel on matters that require local or in-person representation as needed.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert, partnering with our Product and Engineering teams to review and provide feedback on product features for Lawhive’s AI platform, affecting immigration matters

 - Advise on edge cases, risk scenarios, and regulatory considerations

 - Participate in user testing, feature scoping, and documentation reviews




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Excellent organisational skills to manage a high volume caseload

 - Successful track record working with clients that need immigration help

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - A strong interest in AI and how it can be used to improve the legal system

 - Empathy and patience when dealing with questions

 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

 - Ability to work independently and in a team environment

 - Highly motivated, proactive, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

 - Previous experience in a start-up or scale-up environment considered a bonus




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Introductory call with our Talent team

 - Technical interview with our US Managing Director 

 - Values interview with our Head of AI & Co-Founder

 - We offer!




BENEFITS

 - 🩺 Healthcare benefits: 'Premium' plan with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

 - ✈️ Vacation: 20 days + 11 Federal holidays + 1 day of Birthday leave

 - 💰 401k: Matching contribution up to 2% of salary

 - 💰 Equity: Options in Lawhive LTD




DIVERSITY AT LAWHIVE

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team. We’re not yet where we want to be but as we scale we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

jobs.title: Sales Director- NORAM (Relocation to Dallas)
jobs.description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.



What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.



That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.



About the Sales Director- NORAM role...

The Sales Director- NORAM will be responsible for developing and executing strategic go-to-market plans to drive revenue growth and market share.

This leadership role requires a visionary strategist with a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitor landscape, and customer needs. The Regional Sales Director will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product, and revenue operations, to ensure alignment and successful execution of regional strategies.



What you have...

 - Experience in the hotel tech sector

 - Extensive senior leadership experience in sales, ideally overseeing multiple geo-based segments within a high-growth SaaS sales environment.

 - Proven ability to build, manage, and scale a high-performing sales team to achieve significant revenue growth.

 - In-depth understanding of the markets, familiarity with local cultures, and business environments.

 - Strong business acumen, including the ability to study market intelligence data and translate into actionable strategies and sales plans.

 - Outstanding communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels of the organisation.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the flexibility to adapt quickly to changing priorities and market conditions.
   
   

What you'll do...
