jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Accounting & Ledger Systems
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve the ledger systems behind our clients' balances, trading positions, and financial reporting. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering and accounting — designing the double-entry ledger primitives that other engineering teams build on, and making sure new products are designed with financial correctness in mind from day one rather than retrofitted after launch.

This is a rare role for someone who genuinely understands accounting fundamentals and wants to apply that knowledge to hard distributed-systems problems in a live financial platform.

What You'll Do

• Design and extend our core ledger — accounts, postings, and the account-type/ledger structures that every financial product is built on.

• Own the chart-of-accounts and reporting surface that connects engineering data to financial statements and downstream reporting.

• Work across the boundary between on-chain data and off-chain books: balance verification, reconciliation, and proof-of-reserve style mechanisms.

• Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to make sure new features correctly model legal entity ownership, ledger placement, pricing, and reconciliation paths — before they ship, not after.

• Design data models that can absorb new financial products (margin, lending, staking, tokenized assets, and more) cleanly, without repeated painful migrations.

What We're Looking For

• Real, working knowledge of accounting fundamentals: double-entry bookkeeping, chart-of-accounts design, financial statements (P&L, balance sheet), and what reconciliation and audit actually require in practice.

• 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning data-model design for systems where correctness is the product, not just uptime.

• Strong instincts for extensible system design — schemas and APIs that can grow with new requirements instead of requiring repeated rework.

• Comfort reading and critiquing technical designs across multiple systems, not just writing your own.

• Strong cross-functional communication — you'll work directly with Finance, Data Engineering, and Product on shared designs.

Nice to Have

• Experience in crypto or blockchain infrastructure — on-chain balance models, custody, or wallet architecture.

• Experience with event-driven or Kafka-based service architectures.

• Prior experience in an embedded "accounting architecture" or financial-systems design-review role at a fintech or crypto company.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

• Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options

• 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents

• Up to 4% 401k company match

• Paid parental leave, Paid vacation

• Free commuter/parking pass

• Free custom lunches and snacks

• Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs

• Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

jobs.title: Data Scientist, B2B Generalist
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Data Scientist to help build OpenAI's B2B ecosystem and go-to-market data science capability. You will turn ambiguous commercial questions into evidence, recommendations, and operating decisions that help OpenAI understand where to focus as our B2B business expands.

OpenAI's B2B motion is growing quickly across products, customer segments, markets, and field teams. This role will partner with leaders across GTM, Revenue, Product, Finance, RevOps, Strategy, and Data Science to answer questions tied to international strategy, monetization, product penetration, field deployment, customer opportunity, and organizational design.

This is a founding-style opportunity within the broader GTM Data Science organization. The team and stakeholder model are still evolving, so you should be energized by building structure in ambiguity, helping define how the team works, and helping shape the bench around a high-priority commercial area.

In this role, you will bring data science craft, consulting-style problem solving, practical AI fluency, and strong business judgment to help senior leaders make better B2B decisions.

In this role, you will:

 - Structure ambiguous B2B and go-to-market questions into clear operational plans, identifying the decision at stake, the evidence needed, and how insights will translate into action.

 - Lead strategic deep dives across international expansion, monetization, product penetration, customer segmentation, field deployment, ecosystem dynamics, and organizational design.

 - Analyze product usage, customer behavior, adoption patterns, sales and field activity, pipeline and revenue signals, and market context to identify the drivers of B2B growth.

 - Partner closely with GTM, Revenue, Product, Finance, RevOps, Strategy, and Data Science leaders to turn analysis into prioritization decisions, field plays, investment choices, and operating cadences.

 - Communicate complex findings to executives and cross-functional partners with crisp recommendations, transparent assumptions, and clear tradeoffs.

 - Bring practical AI fluency to the work, using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, synthesize evidence, improve workflows, and identify new ways data science can support business decision-making.

 - Help define the operating model for an emerging B2B data science capability, including how the team frames problems, engages stakeholders, evaluates opportunities, and turns insights into GTM action.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Senior-level experience in a quantitative role such as Data Science, Product Analytics, Decision Science, Growth Analytics, Strategy Analytics, or a related field.

 - Strong business judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous analytical work into decisions that business leaders can act on.

 - Experience working on B2B,, GTM or commercial strategy, monetization,, product growth, or similarly complex business problems.

 - Strong technical fluency with analytical tools such as SQL and Python, or equivalent experience using data to answer open-ended business questions.

 - Ability to connect data across product, customer, sales, revenue, market, and operational contexts to form a coherent view of the business.

 - Consulting-style problem solving: you can structure a broad question, identify the highest-leverage analysis, manage uncertainty, and communicate a practical recommendation.

 - Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership. You can influence senior leaders, field teams, product partners, operators, and other data scientists with clear evidence and balanced judgment.

 - Comfort operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-changing environment where the team, roadmap, and stakeholder model are still taking shape.

 - Practical AI fluency and curiosity about how modern AI tools can improve analytical workflows, strategic synthesis, and decision support.

 - Experience in strategy consulting followed by data science work in technology, or data science work within a consulting analytics practice, is a strong plus.

 - An advanced degree is welcome but not required. We care most about your ability to combine analytical rigor, business judgment, and action-oriented communication.

jobs.title: Senior Security Application Engineer
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our New York City office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

We are seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to lead the technical execution of our product security strategy. This role focuses on securing high-growth FinTech and Web3 digital asset platforms by building end-to-end security programs and integrating automated security controls directly into the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has a deep engineering background, hands-on experience defending complex cloud environments, and a passion for securing blockchain-adjacent technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead comprehensive threat modeling and product security architecture reviews in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Integrate security automation into CI/CD pipelines utilizing SAST, DAST, and continuous vulnerability management tools.

• Architect and implement secure-by-default cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and Kubernetes.

• Design and deploy robust encryption services, key management systems (KMS), and advanced data protection controls across distributed environments.

• Oversee operational security initiatives including corporate bug bounty programs, incident response workflows, and regular penetration testing engagements.

• Secure next-generation AI-integrated applications by establishing input/output validation protocols and LLM guardrails.

• Engineer proactive defenses to safeguard platform infrastructure against sophisticated adversaries and nation-state-level threats.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience engineering and scaling end-to-end security programs for high-growth startups.

• Proven background securing platforms within FinTech, Web3, and digital asset ecosystems.

• Strong engineering proficiency in distributed systems, microservices, and languages such as Python or Java.

• Hands-on mastery of container security, Kubernetes orchestration, and AWS infrastructure hardening.

• Practical knowledge of implementing technical controls to meet SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance standards.

• Deep expertise in securing AI/ML lifecycles, MLOps frameworks, and agentic AI platforms.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect- Sydney
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Based in Sydney, as a Senior Solutions Architect in GitLab's ANZ team, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab prospects and customers in the region, helping them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll guide organisations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy.

You will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.

What you'll do

• Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the full lifecycle.

• Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, proof of concept or proof of value ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.

• Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across ANZ to shape and execute account strategies that support new customer acquisition and expansion.

• Build and deepen relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.

• Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.

• Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.

• Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.

• Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.

What you'll bring

• Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.

• Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.

• Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.

• Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.

• Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.

• Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.

• Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

• Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.

About the team

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organisation and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across ANZ. The team helps customers realise the full value of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding customers through digital transformation. We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer. The team is focused on helping customers modernise end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a rapidly evolving AI and DevSecOps landscape.

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Growth and Development Fund

jobs.title: Data Center Global Repairs Program Support
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Repairs Lead within the Data Center Infrastructure organization, you will define and manage the end-to-end hardware repair program across Anthropic's growing fleet of data centers. You will be accountable for repair turnaround time and the compute returned to service across every site, covering server, GPU/accelerator, network, and optics break-fix, RMA and reverse logistics with OEMs and ODMs, and the spares and repair inventory that keeps repair SLAs achievable. As a subject matter expert in hardware operations, you will develop scalable repair processes and quality targets, set the standards that site operations partners and repair vendors execute against, and turn failure trends into fixes which are driven upstream with engineering and equipment partners. If you are experienced in at-scale datacenter hardware operations, are passionate about HPC data centers, & enjoy working in complex, fast-paced environments, we welcome you to apply.

Responsibilities Include:

• Define the global repair strategy including repair SLAs, prioritization rules, escalation paths, and reporting methods, and drive standardization across all sites.

• Own repair turnaround time and repair backlog across the fleet evidenced by Anthropic-owned ticket and telemetry dashboards you help develop.

• Author and improve procedures for triage, break-fix, return-to-service validation, and train site operations partners on how to execute them.

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. jobs.title: Czech Language Transcription Expert
jobs.description:
Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Lupin.
 
 
Project Lupin aims to help improve AI-powered speech recognition models 
 
 
In this project, participants contribute by checking and modifying the audio segmentation and transcription. The transcriptions generated will contribute to the development of improved AI-powered speech recognition models. 
 
 
Project Benefits
 
-Flexible hours – Work on your own schedule 
-Remote – Work from anywhere
-Fair pay globally – Always above minimum wage in your market
-Scalable earnings – The more you work, the more you earn
 
 
Task Summary
You will listen to real audio recordings and produce precise, verbatim transcripts — capturing not just what was said, but how it was said. That means every “uh,” every repeated word, and every trailing sentence matters. Your work will include:
        • Verbatim transcription with a target of 98%+ accuracy 
        • Timestamping segments with less than 500ms deviation 
        • Speaker labeling for conversations with 2 to 8 participants 
        • Event annotation for non-speech elements (e.g., laughter, background noise, unintelligible audio)
 
 
Requirements
 
Native-level fluency in Czech including familiarity with regional accents and informal speech
Strong listening comprehension and attention to detail.
 Ability to produce verbatim transcriptions, including stutters, repetitions, and filler words.
Experience in transcription, annotation, or linguistics is an advantage.
Comfortable using browser-based tools (training will be provided).
 Reliable internet connection.
Access to a laptop or desktop computer (mobile devices are not supported).
Reliable availability for minimum 10+ hours per week.
 
 
 
Please Note
This project follows a first-come, first-served approach and operates with demographic quotas to ensure fair and balanced representation across all participant groups. As a result, some individuals may not receive a task assignment if their group has already been filled.
 
 
This role is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join the CrowdGen Community as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you will receive an email from CrowdGen regarding the creation of an account using your application email address. You will need to log in to this account and reset the password, complete the setup requirements, and proceed with your application for this project-based role.
 
 
Join us in shaping the future of voice AI. Your participation in Project Lupin will directly help improve how technology understands and responds to real human speech.

jobs.title: Lead Propulsion Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Lead Propulsion Test Engineer to build and lead the team responsible for testing the propulsion hardware that flies on every Apex spacecraft. Your team will own the test infrastructure used to develop, characterize, qualify, and acceptance test thrusters, flow controllers, PPUs, and integrated propulsion systems, from development test stands through production-scale vacuum test capability.

This is a hands-on technical and people leadership role. You will grow and develop a team of test engineers and technicians, own the design and buildout of propulsion test infrastructure, and be accountable for test capacity, throughput, data quality, and safety. As Apex scales propulsion production, you will build the systems, processes, and infrastructure that allow test to scale with it.

Responsibilities: 

 - Build, lead, and develop a team of propulsion test engineers and technicians, setting a high bar for safety, technical rigor, execution, and ownership.

 - Own the design, build, and operation of test stands for thrusters, flow controllers, PPUs, and integrated propulsion systems, including fluid and electrical GSE, instrumentation, diagnostics, data acquisition, and controls.

 - Own Apex’s propulsion vacuum test infrastructure, including chambers, pumping systems, thermal and cryogenic capability, instrumentation, maintenance, and capacity planning.

 - Develop scalable acceptance test (ATP) infrastructure and processes that support high-rate propulsion production.

 - Own propulsion test capacity, scheduling, throughput, data quality, and turnaround across development, qualification, and production test campaigns.

 - Establish and enforce test safety standards for vacuum, high-pressure, high-voltage, and other hazardous operations, including procedures, training, and test readiness reviews.

 - Partner with Environmental Test and Ground Software to standardize test tooling, automation, data acquisition, and infrastructure across Apex.

 - Work closely with propulsion component teams, propulsion module teams, Systems Engineering, Production, Quality, and Facilities to define test requirements and ensure results are traceable and actionable.

 - Support development testing, qualification, production acceptance, launch campaigns, and anomaly resolution, including leading root-cause investigations when issues arise.

 - Own test infrastructure budgets, vendors, build-vs-buy decisions, and long-term capacity planning as propulsion production scales.

Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 10+ years of test engineering experience with significant experience testing propulsion, vacuum, or other high-energy hardware.

 - Experience designing, building, and commissioning test stands or test facilities, including instrumentation, data acquisition, controls, and GSE.

 - Hands-on experience with vacuum test facilities, including pumping systems, chamber operations, and vacuum instrumentation.

 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and/or technicians.

 - Strong understanding of test safety for vacuum, high-pressure, high-voltage, and hazardous operations.

 - Experience owning test schedules, capacity, throughput, and data quality for complex hardware programs.

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to work across design engineering, software, production, quality, facilities, and leadership.

 - Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual) as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15).

Nice to Have:

 - Master’s or Ph.D. in a related engineering field.

 - Experience testing electric propulsion hardware, including thrusters, cathodes, flow controllers, or PPUs.

 - Experience with plasma or plume diagnostics, thrust measurement, and electric propulsion performance characterization.

 - Experience building or scaling test infrastructure for high-rate hardware production, including production acceptance testing.

 - Experience with automated test systems, standardized data acquisition, and ground software.

 - Experience with environmental testing, including vibration, TVAC, or EMI/EMC.

jobs.title: Electrical Estimator
jobs.description:
At PEARCE, we've got a career for you!

Pearce is a leading technology-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce-services.com.

Your Impact

Pearce is seeking an experienced Electrical Estimator to support our Critical Power organization by developing accurate, detailed, and competitive estimates for turn-key electrical projects. This role will focus on critical power installations, including Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, generators, structured cabling, and electrical service and maintenance work.

The Electrical Estimator will review project requirements, perform detailed take-offs, conduct site walk-throughs, develop comprehensive cost estimates, and prepare proposals that clearly identify labor, materials, equipment, subcontractor, and other project costs. This individual will partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Project Management to develop technically sound and profitable solutions from initial opportunity through project award.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, hands-on estimating experience, and the ability to evaluate complex project requirements in critical power and mission-critical environments.

Core Responsibilities

• Develop complete and detailed estimates and proposals for UPS systems, generators, critical power infrastructure, structured cabling, and electrical service and maintenance projects.

• Prepare itemized pricing for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, freight, travel, contingencies, and other project-related costs.

• Perform detailed quantity take-offs and develop complete project cost estimates for regional and national opportunities.

• Review electrical drawings, specifications, scopes of work, RFPs, bid documents, and customer requirements to determine project scope and pricing.

• Conduct site walk-throughs and assessments to evaluate existing conditions, verify quantities, identify installation challenges, and gather information necessary to develop accurate estimates.

• Obtain and evaluate vendor and subcontractor quotes based on pricing, availability, lead times, and project requirements.

• Identify scope gaps, project risks, exclusions, assumptions, and potential cost impacts during the estimating process.

• Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Project Management to clarify technical requirements and develop appropriate project solutions.

• Support change-order pricing, value engineering, and scope revisions throughout the bidding and project lifecycle.

• Maintain organized estimating files, take-offs, proposal documentation, vendor pricing, and historical cost information.

• Assist with bid reviews and handoffs to project teams following award.

• Maintain awareness of current material, equipment, and labor costs to support accurate and competitive pricing.

• Travel to customer locations, project sites, and company offices regionally and nationally as required.

Core Experience

• Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from an accredited four-year college or university is required.

• Proven experience in electrical estimating, preferably involving critical power, UPS systems, generators, data centers, mission-critical facilities, structured cabling, and/or electrical service and maintenance projects.

• Demonstrated experience performing detailed quantity take-offs and developing comprehensive project estimates.

• Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, power distribution, installation methods, construction practices, and applicable industry codes and standards.

• Experience reviewing electrical drawings, specifications, RFPs, bid packages, and technical documentation.

• Ability to evaluate labor requirements, material quantities, equipment needs, subcontractor costs, and project risks.

• Experience obtaining and evaluating vendor and subcontractor pricing.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook, as well as estimating and take-off software.

• Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple estimates and priorities while meeting demanding bid deadlines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document estimates, assumptions, exclusions, and proposal requirements.

• Ability and willingness to conduct on-site assessments and travel regionally and nationally as required.

• Valid driver’s license required.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT LATENT

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform. Our clinical AI streamlines prior authorizations, appeals, and 340B compliance, so patients start therapy faster and care teams spend less time on paperwork.

We raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital, with General Catalyst, McKesson Ventures, Conviction, and Y Combinator. 60+ health systems run on Latent, including Yale New Haven, Mount Sinai, UCSF, and Ochsner. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and build products that directly improve patient care.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Recruiter who can independently own searches from pipeline development through close. This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable sourcing their own candidates, managing inbound, partnering closely with hiring managers, and ultimately being accountable for hiring outcomes—not just recruiting activity.

Within your first 3–6 months, we expect you to build and manage healthy pipelines across your roles and consistently drive an average of 2–3 hires per month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own searches end-to-end. Partner with hiring managers to define the profile and interview process, build the pipeline, manage candidates through interviews, and close.

 - Build your own pipeline. Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound or referrals.

 - Create clarity with hiring managers. Develop a strong understanding of what great looks like, use candidate data and market feedback to sharpen the profile, and keep searches moving when there is ambiguity.

 - Manage pipeline health. Know where every search stands, identify gaps early, and take action before a pipeline becomes a problem.

 - Deliver consistent hiring outcomes. Build toward an average of 2–3 hires per month while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality.

 - Help us get better. Bring judgment and ideas to how we source, interview, close, and operate as a recruiting team as Latent continues to scale.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience recruiting for software and technology companies, with a strong understanding of how to identify and engage talent in competitive technical markets.

 - Strong sourcing ability. You know how to build a pipeline from scratch and aren't dependent on inbound candidates or agencies to deliver.

 - Experience owning searches end-to-end, including intake, sourcing, candidate management, hiring manager partnership, offer, and close.

 - High ownership and accountability.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly while still exercising good judgment.

 - Strong communicator who can build trust with candidates and hiring managers without overcomplicating things.




NICE TO HAVE

 - A mix of agency and in-house recruiting experience, particularly at high-growth startups.

 - Experience recruiting across different company stages—from early-stage startups to larger technology companies.

 - Experience joining a company during a period of rapid growth and helping build recruiting processes without adding unnecessary complexity.




WHY JOIN LATENT

 - Backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator

 - Work alongside a high-caliber team building products our healthcare partners love

 - Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare

 - Real ownership and visibility

 - High-impact role on a small, fast-growing team

 - Join at a stage where recruiting has a direct impact on the trajectory of the company and you'll have meaningful ownership over how we build the team




BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

jobs.title: Senior Customer-Led Growth Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LATENT

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform. Our clinical AI streamlines prior authorizations, appeals, and 340B compliance, so patients start therapy faster and care teams spend less time on paperwork.

We raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital, with General Catalyst, McKesson Ventures, Conviction, and Y Combinator. 60+ health systems run on Latent, including Yale New Haven, Mount Sinai, UCSF, and Ochsner. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and build products that directly improve patient care.




THE ROLE

We've built 60+ partnerships across the top health systems in America. Faster medication access, more patients served, denials dropping. The wins are happening. The stories haven't caught up.

That's the job. Turn our customer base into the most cited proof bank in healthcare AI, and run the campaigns that convert that proof into pipeline. A hybrid role between customer marketing and demand gen.

This role reports to the VP of Brand. The cycle: find, produce, distribute, activate. Customer voice in, qualified demand out.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 1. Find the stories, the data, the proof. Go inside our 45+ partner systems to find the wins worth writing up: clinical, operational, financial. Build the customer interview process (who to talk to, what to ask, how to capture it). Pull the data from Partner Experience to turn a story into a verifiable result. Keep a customer-quote and stat library every campaign can pull from. Define the story formats: case study, video, data, exec testimonial, peer reference.
    

 2. Make the content. Get the existing case studies into circulation across web, sales, and ABM. Make the video case studies alongside the Creative Lead. Build a simple production pipeline (creators, editors, partner approvals). Use AI to turn one story into everything: paid ads, nurture emails, sales narrative, social posts, web pages, in days not weeks.
    

 3. Launch the campaigns that drive demand. Run three 360 campaigns a year, each built around one partner story, distributed across web, paid, ABM, market partners, and sales. Map every story to ICP segment, persona, and funnel stage so it drives pipeline, not impressions. Own the work from brief to launch: narrative, formats, audience, creative, distribution, measurement. Partner with Growth on the demand programs that turn customer stories into pipeline. Measure customer-led campaigns against pipeline contribution, not engagement.
    

 4. Run customer webinars and events. Run customer-led webinars. Co-design small dinners, roundtables, and peer sessions that pull buyers into the room. Shape what customers do at our biggest events (agenda, presenters, attendee mix). Use customer voice to set the agenda and curate the guest list. Feed event outputs (quotes, clips, learnings) back into content and campaigns. Partner with PMM and Growth on event narrative, follow-up, and pipeline conversion.
    

 5. Build the customer reference roster for sales. Build the reference roster and keep it current: who'll talk to whom, when, on what topic. Coordinate executive references for late-stage deals. Track how often each customer gets asked, and protect their time.
    

 6. Make customer voice the default everywhere. Make customer voice the default proof point in every Growth and PMM campaign. Partner with PR and comms to feed customer stories into media placements and analyst briefings. Use AI to speed up transcription, drafting, variants, and distribution. One interview, ten outputs.
    


HOW WE WORK

We're a small marketing team that uses AI to punch way above its weight. Speed and impact over team size.

 - We use AI to accelerate every function, not as a side experiment.

 - We work shoulder to shoulder with growth, product marketing, brand and creative, sales, partner experience, and RevOps.

 - We move fast, scale with AI, and run a lot of experiments.

 - This role is for someone excited to rethink how customer marketing and demand gen converge, not replicate the traditional B2B playbook.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - A steady monthly output of case studies.

 - Every active campaign anchored by a real customer voice.

 - Customer-led campaigns we can trace to pipeline.

 - Customer-led events that consistently fill the room with the right buyers.

 - A reference roster sales actually trusts, cited in every late-stage deal we win.

 - Video, written, and data case studies powering paid, ABM, email, and events. Not sitting on a shelf.




YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF

 - You've spent 6 to 8 years across customer marketing, demand gen, content, or campaign roles in B2B, and you've shipped case studies and run the paid and email work that distributes them.

 - You think of customer voice as a demand engine, not a project.

 - You can find the line that turns a complicated win into a simple story, then build the campaign around it.

 - You're comfortable interviewing executives, clinicians, and operators. Equally comfortable in CRM, paid platforms, and analytics.

 - You use AI to produce more, faster. One interview powers ten outputs.

 - You treat customer time as the most expensive resource in the company.

 - You're an operator first. You ship, you don't just plan.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Network
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM


Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands
   


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the network critical path for every site activation, from structured cabling and optics through switch and router delivery, circuit turn-up, and vendor integration, so network is never the reason a site goes live late.

 - Define the network readiness gates, acceptance criteria, and sign-offs that move a site from construction into production, and hold each one across the fleet rather than renegotiating them site by site.

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've run network deployment or infrastructure delivery programs at scale, where a missed turn-up date cost capacity rather than a slipped status report.

 - You know networks well enough to hold engineers and vendors to a schedule credibly: structured cabling and optics, carrier circuit timelines, switch and router deployment, and what actually drives integration slip.

 - You've built activation or readiness frameworks from nothing, defining the gates and acceptance criteria yourself rather than running a process someone else designed.

 - You quarterback across engineering, deployment, supply chain, and external partners without owning any of them, and you're the person other teams call when a workstream is stuck.

jobs.title: Propulsion Test Technician
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex Space is seeking a Propulsion Test Technician to support hands-on testing of spacecraft propulsion hardware, including thrusters, flow controllers, and power processing units (PPUs). You’ll be responsible for setting up, executing, and tearing down tests, operating test stands and vacuum chambers, maintaining test equipment, and working closely with engineers to keep propulsion testing safe, reliable, and moving at production rate.

Responsibilities:

 - Set up, execute, and tear down propulsion tests on thrusters, flow controllers, PPUs, and related propulsion hardware.

 - Operate propulsion test stands, vacuum chambers, pumping systems, instrumentation, and data acquisition equipment.

 - Install and remove test articles, including fluid connections, electrical interfaces, sensors, instrumentation, and associated GSE.

 - Perform pre-test checkouts to verify hardware configuration, instrumentation, and test setup are correct and safe to operate.

 - Execute test procedures and monitor hardware, instrumentation, and facility systems throughout testing.

 - Perform routine and preventive maintenance on test stands, vacuum chambers, pumps, instrumentation, and GSE.

 - Troubleshoot test equipment and hardware issues alongside test and propulsion engineers to minimize downtime.

 - Monitor equipment health and identify potential failures or maintenance needs before they impact testing.

 - Maintain test cells, tooling, equipment, and consumables to ensure systems are organized, calibrated, and ready to run.

 - Maintain accurate test logs, as-run documentation, configuration records, and equipment maintenance history.

 - Provide feedback to engineering on test procedures, tooling, equipment, and processes to improve safety, reliability, and efficiency.

 - Follow safety requirements for vacuum systems, pressurized systems, high-voltage hardware, and other hazardous operations.

 - Support qualification and acceptance testing at production rate as Apex scales spacecraft manufacturing.

Requirements:

 - High school diploma or equivalent.

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in a test, lab, manufacturing, maintenance, or similar technical environment.

 - Hands-on experience using hand tools, power tools, torque tools, fasteners, tubing and fittings, and electrical cabling.

 - Ability to read and follow technical procedures, engineering drawings, schematics, and work instructions.

 - Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and equipment issues.

 - Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate test and maintenance documentation.

 - Safety-first mindset and ability to work around pressurized systems, high voltage, vacuum equipment, and other hazardous operations.

 - Ability to work effectively with engineers and technicians in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

 - Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual) as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15).

Nice to Haves:

 - Technical or vocational training, military technical experience, or an associate degree in a relevant field.

 - Experience operating vacuum chambers, vacuum pumps, or other test and laboratory equipment.

 - Experience installing and troubleshooting test instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems.

 - Experience with fluid systems, pressurized gases, propellant systems, or high-voltage electrical hardware.

 - Experience supporting propulsion, aerospace, or spacecraft test operations.

 - Experience with qualification, acceptance, or production-rate testing.

 - Familiarity with preventive maintenance and calibration practices for test equipment and instrumentation.

 - Experience working under range safety or hazardous operations requirements.

jobs.title: Lead Propulsion Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Lead Propulsion Integration Engineer to own the propulsion modules that fly on our spacecraft, from initial vehicle requirements through design, integration, servicing, and launch.

You will lead the engineers responsible for turning spacecraft and mission requirements into complete, flight-ready propulsion modules. That includes tank selection and sizing, module structure and mounting, feed-system architecture and routing, electrical and fluid interfaces, and ensuring the final design meets mass, cost, power, structural, and vehicle-level requirements.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set the architecture and engineering standards for propulsion module integration, develop the team, and stay close to the hardware as we scale production. Your team will also own spacecraft propellant servicing, including fill and drain operations, ground support equipment, procedures, and range compliance.



Responsibilities: 

 - Lead and develop the propulsion module integration team, setting a high bar for technical rigor, ownership, and execution.

 - Own propulsion module architecture across Apex's spacecraft platforms, including tank selection, module structure, mounting, feed-system routing, and vehicle interfaces.

 - Translate vehicle and mission requirements into complete propulsion module designs, including propellant and delta-v budgets.

 - Deliver flight-ready modules within allocated mass, cost, and power while meeting vehicle requirements and ICDs.

 - Ensure module structures and interfaces meet structural, environmental, and verification requirements.

 - Own spacecraft propellant servicing, including fill/drain operations, procedures, ground support equipment, and safe execution.

 - Ensure hazardous servicing operations meet applicable range requirements, including SSCMAN 91-710, and maintain required safety documentation and approvals.

 - Drive design for manufacturing, integration, test, and serviceability so propulsion modules can be built and processed efficiently at production rate.

 - Partner closely with systems, structures, thermal, avionics, power, propulsion component teams, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and program management.

 - Support vehicle integration, test, launch campaigns, and anomaly resolution, including leading root-cause investigations when issues arise.

 - Communicate technical status, risks, trades, and plans to engineering and company leadership.

Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace, propulsion engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 10+ years of experience in spacecraft propulsion, mechanical/fluid systems, propulsion integration, or related hardware development.

 - Experience leading engineers as a technical lead, people manager, or both.

 - Strong experience with propulsion module and feed-system design, including tank sizing and selection, structural integration, fluid routing, and component selection.

 - Experience owning hardware against vehicle-level requirements, ICDs, and mass, cost, and power budgets.

 - Hands-on experience with spacecraft propellant servicing, including fill/drain operations, procedures, and ground support equipment.

 - Working knowledge of range safety requirements for hazardous spacecraft operations.

 - Proven experience taking flight propulsion hardware from design through build, integration, test, and launch.

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to represent propulsion in vehicle-level technical and program decisions.

 - Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual) as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15).

Nice to Have: 

 - Master's degree in mechanical, aerospace, propulsion engineering, or a related field.

 - Experience with both chemical and electric propulsion systems and propellant servicing, including xenon or krypton loading.

 - Experience transitioning propulsion modules or feed systems into serial or high-rate production.

 - Experience authoring hazardous operations procedures and supporting range approval processes.

 - Familiarity with propellant compatibility, cleanliness, and contamination control requirements.

 - Experience owning subsystem schedule, budget, and technical risk.

WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

LOCATION

ABOUT NEN CREATIVE

Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.

Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.

We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Creative Operations Manager to own staffing, capacity planning, and resource operations across our creative studio.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, creative leads, and company leadership to make sure every project has the right team in place at the right time. You'll maintain a clear view across active and upcoming work, identify capacity constraints and scheduling conflicts, and help the studio make better staffing decisions as priorities shift.

A major part of this role is resource management, but you'll also help improve the systems and workflows behind how our studio operates. As we grow, you'll identify where our processes are breaking down and build better ways to plan, staff, track, and coordinate creative work.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and excited by both solving today's scheduling problems and building better systems for tomorrow.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


RESOURCE & CAPACITY MANAGEMENT

 - Own resource planning across all active and upcoming creative projects

 - Maintain a clear, up-to-date view of team availability, workload, project schedules, and upcoming capacity

 - Identify capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they become problems

 - Track utilization and help leadership understand where the team is over- or under-capacity

 - Anticipate future resource needs based on the studio's pipeline and upcoming work


PROJECT STAFFING & SCHEDULING

 - Match projects with the right internal team members based on skills, experience, availability, and project needs

 - Partner with Creative Producers and creative leads to understand staffing needs and build the right project teams

 - Support staffing for new business opportunities and incoming projects before work kicks off

 - Manage staffing changes as project scopes, timelines, and priorities shift

 - Coordinate internal staffing across shoots and maintain visibility into the studio-wide shoot calendar


CREATIVE OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS

 - Build and maintain the systems, trackers, and dashboards used for resource and project planning

 - Improve how projects are planned, staffed, kicked off, tracked, and handed off across the studio

 - Identify recurring bottlenecks or operational issues and develop practical solutions

 - Create clearer, more consistent processes for Creative Producers and creative teams

 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and reduce unnecessary coordination

 - Help leadership understand the operational impact of upcoming work before commitments are made
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5 years of experience in creative operations, resource management, project coordination, creative production, or a related field

 - Strong understanding of creative production workflows, including pre-production, shoot execution, and post-production

 - Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail

 - Naturally proactive — you see potential problems before someone has to point them out

 - Strong people skills and the ability to build trust with creatives, project leads, and leadership

 - Comfortable managing multiple priorities and constantly changing timelines

 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

 - Able to make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information

 - Resourceful, persistent, and comfortable working without a rigid playbook

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets, project management tools, and quick to learn new systems

 - Naturally interested in finding better ways for teams to work
   
   


WHY JOIN US

 - Play a central role in how a fast-growing creative studio operates

 - Work across a wide range of production projects for ambitious technology companies

 - Help build the staffing, planning, and operational systems the company will use as it scales

 - Work closely with Creative Producers, creative leadership, and company leadership

 - Take ownership of an important function with visibility across the entire studio

 - Remote-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment

 - Healthcare coverage, PTO, and company holidays

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 - Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 - Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 - Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 - Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 - Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 - Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 - Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 - Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 - Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 - Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 - Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Engineering or highly technical product background.

 - Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 - Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
   
    


OUTCOME

 - Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 - Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 - Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 - AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 - Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 - Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
   
    


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

 1. Online assessment or practical task

 2. Technical interview

 3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

T:0’s mission is to make finance run itself. We are turning accounting into autonomous infrastructure that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so the people who own the outcome can stop worrying about busy work and start focusing on strategic decisions. We're a small, elite, builder-focused team inside Airwallex, moving at startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure and distribution behind us.



What you’ll do

You own what we say about T:0 and who we say it to — and then you write it, ship it, and put it in front of customers. This is a production role as much as a thinking role. In a given week you might rewrite the homepage, cut a two-minute product walkthrough, draft the newsletter, build a competitive one-pager for a live deal, and interview three customers. The positioning work matters enormously but it only matters once it exists somewhere a customer can see it. You'll work directly with our CEO, Product teams, Chief of Staff, Growth Marketer, and Founding GTM hire.



This role is based in San Francisco.



Responsibilities:

 - Own the ICP and know the customer better than anyone here. Run customer interviews and win/loss conversations continuously, not as a quarterly project. Sit in on sales calls. Turn what you hear into messaging that lands, and tell the product team what you're learning.

 - Own positioning and messaging. Build the core narrative — what T:0 is, why it matters, why it's different — and the frameworks that keep the website, sales deck, launches, and content saying the same thing. Then test it: real message testing against real prospects, not internal debate.

 - Write the website. You own the copy on every page. Our Growth Marketer owns the page builds, the tests, and the traffic — you own the words.

 - Make product content. Product walkthroughs, explainers, demo videos, launch assets. Scrappy and fast in-house is the default; we'll bring in outside help when something genuinely needs production polish. You should be comfortable recording a clean screen walkthrough yourself.

 - Run product launches. Build a repeatable launch motion and run it — narrative, assets, internal enablement, timing, and a real read on whether the launch worked.

 - Own the blog and SEO content strategy. Decide what we should rank for, write the briefs, and write the pieces that matter. Growth handles technical SEO and distribution.

 - Write the T:0 newsletter. Growth grows the list; you make it worth reading.

 - Own competitive. Know who we're up against, keep the comparison current, and arm the sales team with something they can actually use on a call.

 - Build sales enablement materials. One-pagers, objection handling, competitive battlecards, demo narratives. Our Founding GTM hire runs enablement with the Airwallex sales org — you build what they run.

 - Own pricing and packaging. Partner with the CEO and Product on how we price, what's in each tier, and how we explain it.

 - Collect and use customer proof. Quotes, reviews, case studies, logos. Get them, and get them in front of buyers.
   
    

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

Minimum qualifications:

 - 5+ years in product marketing, or an adjacent role where you personally owned positioning and shipped the assets that came out of it.

 - You're an exceptional writer. This is the single highest bar in the process. We'll ask for samples and a short written exercise.

 - A track record of high output. We'll ask you to walk us through what you shipped in a recent 90-day stretch — we're looking for volume and velocity, not one flagship deliverable.

 - You've done real customer research and can show how a specific insight changed specific messaging.

 - You can hold your own on a technical product. You don't need a finance or accounting background, but you need to be someone who gets deep on how things work rather than staying at the surface.

 - You operate without a brief. Nobody here will hand you a prioritized queue.



Preferred qualifications:

 - Fintech, accounting, or founder-finance-stack experience.

 - You've been the first or only product marketer somewhere.

jobs.title: Data Analyst I
jobs.description:
About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

Job Description

The Data Support team is dedicated to reactive, issue-resolution, and troubleshooting efforts to ensure seamless core data integration between a client’s Student Information System and our Products. As a Data Analyst, you will obtain, adjust, and validate data imported from other systems into Renaissance products.   As such, part of their work involves working directly with customers to obtain the data we need.  They must be detail-oriented and able to spot data problems or inconsistencies and determine proper remediations.

In this role as a Data Analyst I, you will be responsible for:

• Managing and troubleshooting data integration: Resolve SIS-to-product integration issues, write and update extract scripts, and configure import processes to ensure seamless data flow.

• Performing database operations: Execute updates, merges, deletions, and imports within established parameters while maintaining data integrity.

• Ensuring data quality: Conduct thorough quality control checks, investigate discrepancies, and resolve data errors resulting from integration failures.

• Supporting customers: Respond to escalated data support cases, provide guidance on ETL processes and data specifications, and delivery clear status updates on issue resolution.

• Collaborating effectively: Partner with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams to address complex data integration challenges and business rule requirements.

Qualifications

For this role as a Data Analyst I, you should have:

• Associate degree, preferably in Computer/Data Science, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or similar field; or equivalent combination of skills and experience.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and manipulation.

• Foundational technical knowledge including basic ETL processes, SQL querying, sFTP servers, and file path navigation (Linux/Mac OS and Windows).

• Strong analytic mindset with exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex data issues.

• Collaborative approach with willingness to actively engage across cross-functional teams.

• Excellent customer support skills with strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and internal teams.

• Growth mindset with curiosity and eagerness to learn new technology and continuously develop technical skills.

• Experience writing scripts using SQL.

• Familiarity with tools such as Postman, SFTP clients, and API testing tools.

• Previous experience in data analysis, integration, or technical support roles.

Bonus Points:

• Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or similar field; or equivalent combination of skills and experience.

• Product knowledge of Renaissance products, particularly DnA, eduCLIMBER, and FastBridge.

• Experience with educational technology or working in K-12 educational environments.

jobs.title: Creative Resource Manager
jobs.description:
LOCATION

Must be based in the United States. LA/SF/NY preferred

 


ABOUT NEN CREATIVE

Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.

Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.

We're looking for a Creative Resource Manager to own staffing, capacity planning, and scheduling across our creative studio.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, creative leads, and company leadership to make sure every project has the right team in place at the right time. You'll maintain a clear view across active and upcoming work, understand where the team has capacity, identify conflicts before they become problems, and help us make smart staffing decisions as priorities shift.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and comfortable managing many moving pieces at once. You'll sit across the entire studio and become the source of truth for who is working on what, when, and where capacity is becoming constrained.




WHAT YOU'LL DO




RESOURCE & CAPACITY MANAGEMENT

 - Own resource planning across all active and upcoming creative projects

 - Maintain a clear, up-to-date view of team availability, workload, project schedules, and upcoming capacity

 - Identify capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they become problems

 - Track utilization and help leadership understand where the team is over- or under-capacity
